rb: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
y: It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.
gs: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
c: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.
rs: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
e: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
frlg: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
dp: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
pt: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
hgss: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
bw: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
b2w2: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
xy: Dieses Pokémon trägt von Geburt an einen Samen auf dem Rücken, der mit ihm keimt und wächst.
A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
oras: Bisasam macht gern einmal ein Nickerchen im Sonnenschein. Auf seinem Rücken trägt es einen Samen. Indem es Sonnenstrahlen aufsaugt, wird der Samen zunehmend größer.
Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
lgpe: Es kommt tagelang ohne Nahrung aus, da es in den Samen auf seinem Rücken Nährstoffe speichert.
It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon trägt von Geburt an einen Samen auf dem Rücken, der im Laufe der Zeit keimt und wächst.
There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

rb: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
y: The bulb on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
gs: Exposure to sun light adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
c: The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs nutrients. The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma when it blooms.
rs: There is a bud on this Pokémon’s back. To support its weight, IVYSAUR’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it’s a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
e: To support its bulb, IVYSAUR’s legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.
frlg: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
dp: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
pt: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
hgss: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
bw: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
b2w2: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
xy: Es trägt eine Knospe auf seinem Rücken. Nimmt es Nahrung zu sich, soll aus der Knospe eine große blühende Blume werden.
There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
oras: Bisaknosp hat eine Knospe auf seinem Rücken. Beine und Rumpf sind kräftig genug, um sein Gewicht zu tragen. Wenn es lange in der Sonne liegt, ist das ein Anzeichen dafür, dass die Knospe bald blüht.

There is a bud on this Pokémon’s back. To support its weight, Ivysaur’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it’s a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
lgpe: Die Knospe auf seinem Rücken wächst, indem sie Nährstoffe absorbiert. Kurz vor der Blüte sondert sie einen Duft ab.
The bud on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
swsh: Sobald die Knospe auf seinem Rücken groß wird, kann Bisaknosp nicht mehr auf zwei Beinen stehen.
When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

rb: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
y: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
gs: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
c: As it warms it self and absorbs the sunlight, its flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.
rs: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
e: VENUSAUR’s flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
frlg: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
dp: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
pt: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
hgss: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
bw: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
b2w2: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
xy: Es spreizt die breiten Blätter seiner Blüte, um seinen Körper mit Sonnenenergie zu durchfluten.
By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
oras: Bisaflor hat eine Blume auf seinem Rücken. Wenn sie viel Nahrung und Sonne aufnimmt, verfärbt sie sich bunt. Der Duft der Blume mildert die Emotionen der Menschen.
There is a large flower on Venusaur’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
lgpe: Die große Blume auf seinem Rücken absorbiert Sonnenlicht und kann dieses in Energie umwandeln.
The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
swsh: Es nutzt Solarenergie als Nahrung und bringt so seine große Blume zum Blühen. Es geht dorthin, wo die Sonne scheint.
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

rb: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
y: The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.
gs: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
c: If it's healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigor ously, even if it gets a bit wet.
rs: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is enjoying itself. If the Pokémon becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
e: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
frlg: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
dp: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
pt: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
hgss: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
bw: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
b2w2: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
xy: Die Flamme auf seiner Schweifspitze zeigt die Lebensenergie an. Ist es gesund, leuchtet sie hell.
The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
oras: Die Flamme auf seiner Schweifspitze zeigt seine Gefühlslage an. Sie flackert, wenn Glumanda zufrieden ist. Wenn dieses Pokémon wütend wird, lodert die Flamme gewaltig.
The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is enjoying itself. If the Pokémon becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
lgpe: An sehr stillen Orten kann man seine brennende Schwanzspitze ganz leise lodern hören.
The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon bevorzugt heiße Dinge. Bei Regen soll seine Schwanzspitze dampfen.
It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

rb: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
y: Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may blow out bluish- white flames.
gs: It is very hot headed by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
c: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
rs: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
e: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
frlg: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
dp: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
pt: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
hgss: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
bw: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
b2w2: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
xy: Es schlägt im Kampf mit seinem Schwanz nach seinen Gegnern. Anschließend zerfetzt es die Gegner mit seinen scharfen Klauen.
It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
oras: Gnadenlos besiegt Glutexo seine Gegner mit seinen scharfen Klauen. Wenn es auf starke Gegner trifft, wird es wütend und die Flamme auf seiner Schweifspitze flackert in einem bläulichen Ton.

Charmeleon mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
lgpe: Kämpft es länger gegen starke Gegner, so gerät es in Aufregung und spuckt manchmal gleißend helle, bläuliche Flammen.
Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may breathe out bluish-white flames.
swsh: Es ist brutal veranlagt. Im Kampf schlägt es mit seinem brennenden Schweif um sich und schlitzt Gegner mit seinen scharfen Klauen auf.
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

rb: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
y: When expelling a blast of super hot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
gs: If CHARIZARD be comes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a whitish- blue color.
c: It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its fire increases as it gains exper ience in battle.
rs: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
e: A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
frlg: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
dp: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
pt: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
hgss: If CHARIZARD becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a light blue shade.
bw: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
b2w2: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
xy: Wenn dieses Pokémon einen Strahl glühenden Feuers speit, leuchtet seine Schwanzspitze auf.
When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
oras: Glurak fliegt durch die Lüfte, um starke Gegner aufzuspüren. Sein heißer Feueratem bringt alles zum Schmelzen. Aber es richtet seinen Feueratem nie auf schwächere Gegner.

Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
lgpe: Wenn es einen Strahl glühenden Feuers speit, lodert die rote Flamme an seiner Schwanzspitze noch intensiver.
When this Pokémon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinem Feueratem Felsen schmelzen. Es verursacht ab und zu Waldbrände.
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

rb: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
y: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
gs: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prod ding fingers will bounce off it.
c: When it feels threatened, it draws its legs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
rs: SQUIRTLE’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this Pokémon to swim at high speeds.
e: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.
frlg: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.
dp: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
pt: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
hgss: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.
bw: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
b2w2: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
xy: Es zieht sich in seinen Panzer zurück und greift dann mit Wasserstrahlen seine Gegner an.
It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
oras: Schiggys Panzer dient nicht nur zum Schutz. Die runde Form und die Furchen auf der Oberfläche verringern den Widerstand im Wasser, sodass dieses Pokémon sehr schnell schwimmen kann.
Squirtle’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this Pokémon to swim at high speeds.
lgpe: Es greift seine Beute aus dem Wasser heraus mit einem Wasserstrahl an. Bei Gefahr zieht es sich in seinen Panzer zurück.
Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
swsh: Zieht es seinen langen Hals in seinen Panzer zurück, verspritzt es Wasser mit unbändiger Kraft.
When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

rb: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
y: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
gs: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
c: Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, making it quite popular among older people.
rs: Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as WARTORTLE ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon’s toughness as a battler.
e: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon’s toughness in battle.
frlg: This Pokémon is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.
dp: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
pt: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
hgss: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
bw: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
b2w2: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
xy: Bei Gefahr zieht dieses Pokémon seinen Kopf ein. Die Schwanzspitze ragt jedoch aus dem Panzer heraus.
When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
oras: Schillok hat einen langen, buschigen Schweif, dessen Farbe intensiver wird, wenn es altert. Die Kratzer auf seinem Panzer zeugen von seiner Kampfkraft.

Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as Wartortle ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon’s toughness as a battler.
lgpe: Wenn es einen Schlag auf den Kopf bekommt, zieht es sich in seinen Panzer zurück. Seine Schwanzspitze ragt jedoch ein wenig heraus.
When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
swsh: Es gilt als Symbol für Langlebigkeit. Sehr alte Exemplare erkennt man daran, dass ihr Panzer mit Algen übersät ist.
It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

rb: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
y: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
gs: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can with stand the recoil of the water jets it fires.
c: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.
rs: BLASTOISE has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
e: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
frlg: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
dp: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
pt: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
hgss: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.
bw: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
b2w2: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
xy: Es begräbt seine Gegner mit seinem enormen Körpergewicht. Wenn es in einer aussichtslosen Lage steckt, zieht es sich in seinen Panzer zurück.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
oras: Turtok besitzt Wasserdüsen, die aus seinem Panzer herausragen. Diese sind sehr präzise. Es kann Wassergeschosse so genau verschießen, dass es damit aus fast 50 m leere Dosen trifft.

Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
lgpe: Nachdem es einen Gegner anvisiert hat, greift es mit einem Wasserstrahl an, dessen Druck höher ist als der eines Feuerwehrschlauchs.
Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
swsh: Es begräbt seine Gegner mit seinem enormen Körpergewicht. Wenn es in einer aussichtslosen Lage steckt, zieht es sich in seinen Panzer zurück.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

rb: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
y: If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.
gs: For protection, it releases a horri ble stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
c: It crawls into foliage where it camouflages itself among leaves that are the same color as its body.
rs: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this Pokémon releases a terrifically strong odor.
e: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.
frlg: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.
dp: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
pt: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
hgss: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
bw: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
b2w2: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
xy: Als Schutz vor Feinden sondert es einen übel riechenden Gestank mit seinen Antennen ab.
For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
oras: Raupy ist sehr gefräßig, es kann Blätter verschlingen, die größer sind als es selbst. Seine Antennen sondern einen übel riechenden Gestank ab.
Caterpie has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this Pokémon releases a terrifically strong odor.
sm: Es versucht, angreifende Vogel-Pokémon mit dem Gestank aus seinen Antennen in die Flucht zu schlagen. Das gelingt ihm aber nicht immer.
When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.
lgpe: Berührt man die Fühler auf seinem Kopf, so versucht es sich zu schützen, indem es einen penetranten Geruch absondert.
If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.
swsh: Als Schutz vor Feinden sondert es einen übel riechenden Gestank mit seinen Antennen ab.
For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

rb: This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
y: Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.
gs: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it pre pares to evolve. It stays motion less in the shell.
c: This is its pre- evolved form. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
rs: The shell covering this Pokémon’s body is as hard as an iron slab. METAPOD does not move very much. It stays still because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the hard shell.
e: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A METAPOD does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.
frlg: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
dp: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
pt: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
hgss: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.
bw: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
b2w2: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
xy: Der stahlharte Panzer schützt seinen zarten Körper. Es wartet geduldig auf seine Entwicklung.
A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
oras: Der Panzer dieses Pokémon ist hart wie Stahl. Safcon bewegt sich kaum, da es das weiche Innere unter seiner harten Schale auf seine Entwicklung vorbereitet.
The shell covering this Pokémon’s body is as hard as an iron slab. Metapod does not move very much. It stays still because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the hard shell.
sm: Sein harter Panzer birgt ein weiches Inneres. Um zu vermeiden, dass dieses versehentlich ausläuft, bewegt es sich kaum.
Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn’t move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.
lgpe: Um sich zu schützen, härtet es eifrig seinen Panzer, doch wenn es heftige Treffer einsteckt, wird sein Inneres entblößt.
Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.
swsh: In diesem Zustand wartet es auf die Entwicklung. Es kann nur seinen Panzer erhärten, daher bewegt es sich nicht, um nicht angegriffen zu werden.
It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

rb: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
y: Its wings, covered with poisonous powders, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.
gs: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
c: It flits from flower to flower, collecting honey. It can even identify distant flowers in bloom.
rs: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can even search out, extract, and carry honey from flowers that are blooming over six miles from its nest.
e: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.
frlg: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this Pokémon can fly about even in rain.
dp: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
pt: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
hgss: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
bw: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
b2w2: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
xy: Es liebt Blütenhonig. Es findet selbst Blumen, die sehr wenig Pollen haben.
It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
oras: Smettbos größte Fähigkeit ist das Aufspüren köstlichen Blütenhonigs. Es findet sogar Honig in Blumen, die fast 10 km von seinem Nest entfernt blühen.
Butterfree has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can even search out, extract, and carry honey from flowers that are blooming over six miles from its nest.
sm: Bei genauerer Betrachtung zeigt sich, dass seine zwei großen Augen jeweils aus einer Vielzahl an kleineren Augen bestehen.
Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.
lgpe: Da die hochgiftige Staubschicht auf seinen Flügeln wasserabweisend ist, kann es auch bei Regen umherfliegen.
Its wings, covered with poisonous powder, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.
swsh: Wenn es sehr schnell mit den Flügeln schlägt, setzt es hochgiftigen Flügelstaub frei.
In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

rb: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
y: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

swsh: Je stärker die Elektrizität ist, die Pikachu produziert, desto weicher und elastischer sind seine Backentaschen.
Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
pla: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

lgpe: Wenn sich in seinem Körper Elektrizität anstaut, wird es aggressiv. Man kann es auch im Dunkeln leuchten sehen.
When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
swsh: Sein langer Schweif dient ihm zur Erdung. So bleibt es von der lähmenden Wirkung von Hochspannung selbst verschont.
Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
pla: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
oras: Sandans Körper kann sehr viel Wasser aufnehmen, sodass es auch in der Wüste überleben kann. Dieses Pokémon rollt sich zusammen, um sich vor Feinden zu schützen.
Sandshrew’s body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This Pokémon curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
sm: Es kann sich blitzschnell durch die Wüste fortbewegen, indem es sich zu einem Ball zusammenrollt.
It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through the desert by rolling at high speeds.
lgpe: Der Körper dieses Pokémon ist sehr trocken. In kalten Nächten wird sein Körper von Tau überzogen.
Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
swsh: Es badet sehr gern im trockenen Sand. Dadurch befreit es seinen Körper von Schmutz und Feuchtigkeit.
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

rb: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
y: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
gs: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
c: Adept at climbing trees, it rolls into a spiny ball, then attacks its enemies from above.
rs: SANDSLASH’s body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
e: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.
frlg: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.
dp: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
pt: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
hgss: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
bw: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
b2w2: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.
xy: Wenn es schnell gräbt, können seine Stacheln und Krallen abbrechen. Sie wachsen binnen eines Tages nach.
If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
oras: Sandamers Körper ist übersät mit spitzen Stacheln, die eigentlich Hauthärtungen darstellen. Einmal im Jahr fallen die alten Stacheln aus und werden durch neue ersetzt.
Sandslash’s body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
sm: Seine Krallen und Stacheln sind scharf, aber auch spröde und brechen oft ab. Sie wachsen jedoch innerhalb eines Tages wieder nach.
Although they are sharp, its claws and spikes often break off. They grow back the next day, so it is not bothered by the temporary loss.
lgpe: Es greift Gegner mit seinen scharfen Klauen an. Brechen diese im Kampf ab, wachsen sie binnen eines Tages nach.
It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
swsh: Je trockener das Gebiet ist, in dem Sandamer lebt, desto härter und glatter fühlen sich die Stacheln an seinem Rücken an.
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.

rb: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

gs: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely po tent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
c: Small and very docile, it pro tects itself with its small, poison ous horn when attacked.
rs: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
e: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small- bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

Nidoran♀ has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
lgpe: Es hat ein sanftes Gemüt und meidet den Kampf, doch da aus seinem kleinen Horn Gift austritt, ist trotzdem Vorsicht geboten.
A mild-mannered Pokémon that does not like to fight. Beware—its small horn secretes venom.
swsh: Sie sind geruchsempfindlicher als Nidoran♂. Auf Nahrungssuche folgen sie der Windrichtung, die sie mit ihren Tasthaaren ermitteln.
Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

rb: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
y: When resting deep in its burrow, its thorns always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.
gs: When feeding its young, it first chews and tender izes the food, then spits it out for the offspring.
c: It has a docile nature. If it is threatened with attack, it raises the barbs that are all over its body.
rs: When NIDORINA are with their friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. This Pokémon appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
e: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.

When Nidorina are with their friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. This Pokémon appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
lgpe: Während es sich in seinem Bau aufhält, zieht es seine Stacheln stets ein. Damit signalisiert es, dass es entspannt ist.
When resting deep in its burrow, its barbs always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.
swsh: Man geht davon aus, dass sich das Horn auf ihrem Kopf zurückgebildet hat, damit sie ihre Jungen nicht beim Füttern verletzen.
The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.

Tough scales cover the sturdy body of this Pokémon. It appears that the scales grow in cycles.
swsh: Sie sind eher defensiv als offensiv veranlagt. Mit ihren panzerartigen Schuppen schützen sie ihre Jungen vor jeglichen Angriffen.

It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

Nidoran♂ has developed muscles for moving its ears. Thanks to them, the ears can be freely moved in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon’s notice.

The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

c: It is easily agitated and uses its horn for offense as soon as it notices an attacker.
rs: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
e: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

rb: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
y: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.
gs: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
c: It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.
rs: NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
e: A NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
frlg: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.
dp: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
pt: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
hgss: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
bw: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
b2w2: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

Nidoking’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
lgpe: Dank seiner stahlharten Haut kann es Gegner besonders effektiv rammen. Mit seinem Horn spaltet es sogar Diamanten.
Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.
swsh: Gerät es in Rage, ist es nur schwer aufzuhalten. Doch vor einem Nidoqueen, mit dem es schon viele Jahre verbracht hat, zeigt es sich friedlich.
When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

rb: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
y: Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.
gs: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
c: Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot, for some reason, on the night of a full moon.
rs: On every night of a full moon, groups of this Pokémon come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
e: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.
frlg: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.
dp: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
pt: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of CLEFAIRY dancing under a full moon.
hgss: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
bw: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

oras: In Vollmondnächten sammeln sich einige dieser Pokémon, um zu spielen. Wird es Tag, kehrt Piepi zu seinem Zufluchtsort in den Bergen zurück und schläft eingekuschelt neben seinen Artgenossen ein.
On every night of a full moon, groups of this Pokémon come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
sm: Dank seiner verspielten Art und seines süßen Aussehens ist es bei Jung und Alt sehr beliebt. Dieses Pokémon ist jedoch selten.
Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.
lgpe: Wegen seines reizenden Aussehens und Wesens ist Piepi beliebt, aber man sieht es nur selten, da es anscheinend nicht viele Exemplare gibt.
Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.
swsh: Eine Ansammlung von Piepi bei Vollmond tanzen zu sehen, soll ein glückliches Leben verheißen.
It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
pla: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

rb: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
y: They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.
gs: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
c: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.
rs: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
e: A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
frlg: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
dp: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
pt: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
hgss: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
bw: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
b2w2: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they’re usually found in quiet places.

Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.
oras: Pixi bewegt sich fort, indem es leicht mit den Flügeln schlägt. Durch seinen federnden Gang kann es sogar über Wasser gehen. Bei Mondschein unternimmt es Spaziergänge auf Seen.
Clefable moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
sm: Es zeigt sich Menschen nur ungern und führt zusammen mit anderen Artgenossen ein abgeschiedenes Leben tief in den Bergen.
They don’t like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.
lgpe: Dieses feenhafte Pokémon scheint sein Reich mit großem Eifer zu schützen. Es zeigt sich den Menschen nur selten.
They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.
swsh: Ein feenhaftes und scheues Pokémon, das sofort die Flucht ergreift, wenn es Menschen wahrnimmt.
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
pla: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

rb: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
y: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
gs: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
c: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxur ious coat of fur.
rs: At the time of its birth, VULPIX has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this Pokémon receives plenty of love from its TRAINER. The six tails become magnificently curled.
e: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o’-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.
frlg: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
dp: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
pt: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
hgss: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
bw: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
b2w2: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.
xy: Dieses Pokémon hat bei seiner Geburt nur einen Schweif, der sich mit zunehmendem Alter aufspaltet.
When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
oras: Vulpix kommt mit einem weißen Schweif zur Welt. Dieser teilt sich sechsfach, wenn das Pokémon von seinem Trainer viel Zuneigung bekommt. Seine sechs Schweife kräuseln sich schließlich.
At the time of its birth, Vulpix has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this Pokémon receives plenty of love from its Trainer. The six tails become magnificently curled.
sm: Sein Fell und seine Schweife sind so hübsch, dass es sich großer Beliebtheit erfreut. Letztere spalten sich mit zunehmendem Alter weiter auf.
Its beautiful fur and tails have made it very popular. As it grows, its tails split to form more tails.
lgpe: Sein Fell und sein Schweif sind wunderschön. Beim Heranwachsen spaltet sich sein Schweif in mehrere Teile auf.
Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
swsh: In seiner Jugend hat es sechs hinreißende Schweife. Während es wächst, kommen noch weitere neue Schweife hinzu.
While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
pla: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

rb: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
y: According to an enduring legend, 9 noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokémon.
gs: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
c: It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
rs: NINETALES casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This Pokémon is said to live for a thousand years.
e: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that shines like gold.
frlg: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
dp: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
pt: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
hgss: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
bw: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
b2w2: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.
xy: Es hat neun lange Schweife und sein Fell glänzt gülden. Man sagt, es soll 1 000 Jahre alt werden.
It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
oras: Vulnona sendet einen unheimlichen Lichtstrahl aus seinen hellroten Augen aus, um totale Kontrolle über die Gedanken seines Gegners zu erlangen. Man sagt, dieses Pokémon könne 1 000 Jahre leben.
Ninetales casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This Pokémon is said to live for a thousand years.
sm: Einer Legende nach entstand dieses mystische Pokémon, als einst neun Zauberer mit heiligen Kräften zu einem verschmolzen.
Legend has it that this mystical Pokémon was formed when nine saints coalesced into one.
lgpe: Einer Sage nach ist Vulnona die Wiedergeburt der Seelen von neun edlen Zauberern, die miteinander verschmolzen sind.
According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokémon.
swsh: Man sagt, es lebe 1 000 Jahre und jedem seiner Schweife wohnen übernatürliche Kräfte inne.
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
pla: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

rb: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
y: Uses its alluring eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
gs: If it inflates to SING a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
c: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.
rs: JIGGLYPUFF’s vocal chords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This Pokémon uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
e: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF’s song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.
frlg: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
dp: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
pt: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
hgss: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
bw: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
b2w2: Looking into its cute, round eyes makes it start singing a song so pleasant listeners can’t help but fall asleep.
xy: Es fesselt die Gegner mit seinen großen, runden Augen und versetzt sie in Schlaf, indem es eine beruhigende Melodie singt.
It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
oras: Pummeluffs Stimmbänder können die Tonlage seiner Stimme beliebig variieren. Dieses Pokémon benutzt diese Fähigkeit, um seine Gegner mit monotonem Gesang in Tiefschlaf zu versetzen.
Jigglypuff’s vocal cords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This Pokémon uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
sm: Es kann tief einatmen und seinen Bauch mit Luft füllen, um ein sonderbares Lied anzustimmen. Wer dieses hört, schläft auf der Stelle ein.
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.
lgpe: Es betört Gegner mit seinen Kulleraugen und singt ihnen dann ein mysteriöses, wohlklingendes Lied vor, das sie in den Schlaf lullt.
Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
swsh: Sein Lungenvolumen übersteigt das der meisten anderen Pokémon. Es singt so lange Schlaflieder, bis seine Gegner eingenickt sind.
Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

rb: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
y: Its body is full of elasticity. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.
gs: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.
c: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.
rs: WIGGLYTUFF has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this Pokémon’s eyes, it is quickly washed away.
e: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.
frlg: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.
dp: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
pt: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
hgss: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
bw: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
b2w2: Its fine fur feels so pleasant, those who accidentally touch it cannot take their hands away.
xy: Sein Fell ist so flauschig, dass, wenn zwei zusammenstehen, sie nicht getrennt werden möchten.
Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
oras: Knuddeluff hat handtellergroße Augen, die immer mit Tränenflüssigkeit bedeckt sind. Gerät Staub in die Augen dieses Pokémon, so wird dieser sofort ausgespült.
Wigglytuff has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this Pokémon’s eyes, it is quickly washed away.
sm: Pünktlich zum Wechsel der Jahreszeiten streift es sein kuschelig weiches Fell ab. Der Stoff, der sich daraus spinnen lässt, gilt als Luxusgut.
It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.
lgpe: Knuddeluff verfügt über einen sehr elastischen Körper. Es kann sich mit einem tiefen Atemzug zu schier grenzenloser Größe aufblasen.
Its body is very elastic. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.
swsh: Je mehr Luft es einatmet, desto größer wird es. Ist es verärgert, bläst es seinen Körper enorm auf und schüchtert so seine Gegner ein.
The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

rb: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
y: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for ob jects in its way.
gs: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its sur roundings.
c: During the day, it gathers with others and hangs from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.
rs: ZUBAT remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
e: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.
frlg: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
dp: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
pt: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
hgss: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.
bw: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
b2w2: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surroundings while it flies.
xy: Obwohl es keine Augen hat, kann es Hindernisse mithilfe von Ultraschallwellen wahrnehmen.
Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
oras: Tagsüber bleibt Zubat an einem dunklen Ort und bewegt sich kaum. Wenn es dem Sonnenlicht längere Zeit ausgesetzt wird, zieht es sich Verbrennungen an seinem Körper zu.
Zubat remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
sm: Tagsüber schläft es in Höhlen. Da es keine Augen hat, erschließt es sich seine Umgebung im Flug durch das Aussenden von Schallwellen.
It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.
lgpe: Zubat stößt während des Fluges Ultraschalllaute aus, um Hindernisse zu orten.
Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.
swsh: Über den Mund stößt es Ultraschallwellen aus, um seine Umgebung zu erkunden. So kann es selbst in engen Höhlen geschickt umherfliegen.
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
pla: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

rb: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
y: It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and suck blood.
gs: However hard its victim's hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
c: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.
rs: GOLBAT loves to drink the blood of living things. It is particularly active in the pitch black of night. This Pokémon flits around in the night skies, seeking fresh blood.
e: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokémon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.
frlg: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.
dp: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.
pt: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
hgss: However hard its victim’s hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
bw: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
b2w2: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.
xy: Dieses Pokémon saugt dem Gegner selbst dann noch Energie ab, wenn es zu schwer zum Fliegen wird.
Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
oras: Golbat hat es auf das Blut von Lebewesen abgesehen. Im Schutze der Nacht wird es besonders aktiv. Dieses Pokémon fliegt durch die Nacht, um nach frischem Blut zu suchen.
Golbat loves to drink the blood of living things. It is particularly active in the pitch black of night. This Pokémon flits around in the night skies, seeking fresh blood.
sm: Seine dicken Reißzähne sind im Inneren hohl wie Strohhalme und zerbrechlich. Sie sind das Produkt seiner Entwicklung zum Blutsauger.
Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.
lgpe: Golbat nähert sich schnell und lautlos an. Mit seinen spitzen Zähnen beißt es zu und saugt seinen Opfern Blut ab.
It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and to suck blood.
swsh: Das Blut anderer Lebewesen ist seine Leibspeise. Man sagt, dass es das abgesaugte Blut manchmal mit hungrigen Artgenossen teilt.
It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.
pla: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

rb: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
y: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.
gs: Awakened by moon light, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
c: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bath ing in moonlight.
rs: During the daytime, ODDISH buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.
e: This Pokémon grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.
frlg: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.
dp: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
pt: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
hgss: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
bw: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
b2w2: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
xy: Tagsüber versteckt es sich in der kalten Erde, um die Sonne zu meiden. Es wächst im Mondschein.
During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
oras: Am Tage vergräbt sich Myrapla im Boden, um mit seinem ganzen Körper Nahrung aufzunehmen. Je fruchtbarer der Boden ist, desto glänzender werden seine Blätter.
During the daytime, Oddish buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.
sm: Wenn sich der Mond zeigt, taucht es aus dem Boden auf. Über fruchtbarer Erde schüttelt es seinen Kopf und verstreut Samen.
lgpe: Es wird oft mit Unkraut verwechselt. Versucht man, es aus der Erde zu ziehen, stößt es einen fürchterlichen Schrei aus.
It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.
swsh: Wird es vom Mondschein getroffen, bewegt es sich. Nachts wandert es weite Wege, um seine Samen zu verstreuen.
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

rb: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
y: Smells incredibly foul! However, around 1 out of 1,000 people enjoy sniffing its nose- bending stink.
gs: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
c: The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.
rs: GLOOM releases a foul fragrance from the pistil of its flower. When faced with danger, the stench worsens. If this Pokémon is feeling calm and secure, it does not release its usual stinky aroma.
e: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.
frlg: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
dp: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
pt: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
hgss: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
bw: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
b2w2: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
xy: Dieses Pokémon sondert einen übelriechenden Geruch ab. Trotzdem halten einige Leute es im Haus.
Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
oras: Duflor produziert einen ekelerregenden Gestank aus dem Stempel seiner Blume. Wenn es in Gefahr gerät, wird der Gestank noch unerträglicher. Wenn sich dieses Pokémon in Sicherheit befindet, stößt es keinen Gestank aus.
Gloom releases a foul fragrance from the pistil of its flower. When faced with danger, the stench worsens. If this Pokémon is feeling calm and secure, it does not release its usual stinky aroma.
sm: Aus seinem Mund tropft übelriechender Honig. Bekommt man etwas davon ab, haftet sein Gestank selbst nach 10 Waschgängen noch an.
lgpe: Es riecht unglaublich widerlich. Trotzdem gibt es unter tausend Menschen mindestens einen, dem der Gestank gefällt.
Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
swsh: Sein Stempel sondert einen unglaublich faulen Gestank ab. Dieser stechende Geruch kann selbst bis zu 2 km entfernte Gegner bewusstlos machen.
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

rb: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
y: Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.
gs: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
c: By shaking its big petals, it scat ters toxic pollen into the air, turning the air yellow.
rs: VILEPLUME’s toxic pollen triggers atrocious allergy attacks. That’s why it is advisable never to approach any attractive flowers in a jungle, however pretty they may be.
e: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.
frlg: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.
dp: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
pt: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
hgss: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
bw: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
b2w2: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
xy: Je größer die Blütenblätter, desto mehr giftige Pollen sind in der Blüte enthalten.
The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
oras: Giflors giftige Pollen rufen böse allergische Anfälle hervor. Deshalb ist es ratsam, sich keiner schönen Blume im Dschungel zu nähern, so anziehend sie auch sein mag.
Vileplume’s toxic pollen triggers atrocious allergy attacks. That’s why it is advisable never to approach any attractive flowers in a jungle, however pretty they may be.
sm: Es verstreut hochgiftige Pollen. Man erkennt Giflors Spur am leicht gelblichen Nebel, den es hinterlässt.
lgpe: Wenn es seine großen Blütenblätter schüttelt, um giftige Pollen zu verteilen, entsteht dabei ein unglaublich großer Lärm.
Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.
swsh: Es besitzt die größten Blütenblätter der Welt. Bei jedem Schritt streut es große Mengen an Giftpollen zu Boden.
It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

rb: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw ing nutrients from the bug host.
y: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.
gs: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
c: The tochukaso growing on this Pokémon's back orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.
rs: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from the BUG Pokémon host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
e: A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.
frlg: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
dp: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
pt: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
hgss: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
bw: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
b2w2: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
xy: Auf seinem Rücken wachsen Pilze, die man Tochukaso nennt. Die Pilze wachsen mit ihrem Wirt.
Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
oras: Auf Paras’ Rücken wachsen parasitäre Pilze, die Tochukaso genannt werden. Sie wachsen, indem sie dem Käfer-Pokémon Nährstoffe entziehen. Sie sind sehr wertvoll als lebensverlängernde Medizin.
Paras has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this Bug Pokémon host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
sm: Egal, wie viel Nahrung es auch zu sich nimmt, die Pilze, die auf seinem Rücken wachsen, entziehen ihm so gut wie alle Nährstoffe.
No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.
lgpe: Es gräbt sich in den Boden, um Baumwurzeln Nährstoffe zu entziehen. Den Großteil davon absorbieren jedoch die Pilze auf seinem Rücken.
Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.
pla: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

rb: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
y: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushrooms on its back. They appear to do all the thinking.
gs: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mush rooms on its back.
c: When nothing's left to extract from the bug, the mushrooms on its back leave spores on the bug's egg.
rs: PARASECT is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
e: PARASECT are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
frlg: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.
dp: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
pt: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
hgss: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.
bw: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
b2w2: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
xy: Parasek wird von einem Pilz, der größer als das Pokémon ist, kontrolliert. Er gibt Giftsporen ab.
A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
oras: Parasek sucht große Bäume heim und entzieht Nährstoffe aus Stamm und Wurzeln. Wenn ein befallener Baum stirbt, sucht es sich zusammen mit seinen Artgenossen einen neuen Wirt.
Parasect is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
sm: Parasek wird von dem Pilz auf seinen Rücken kontrolliert. Es ist oft mit Lamellux in Revierstreitigkeiten verstrickt.
The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.
lgpe: Der Pilz auf Paraseks Rücken nutzt das Pokémon als Wirt und entzieht ihm Energie. Es scheint, als habe er die Kontrolle über das Pokémon.
The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.
pla: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

rb: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
y: Its large eyes act as radars. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
gs: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
c: The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.
rs: VENONAT is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
e: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
frlg: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.
dp: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
pt: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
hgss: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
bw: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
b2w2: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
xy: Seine großen Augen bestehen aus vielen kleinen Augen. Nachts wird es von Licht angezogen.
Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
oras: Bluzuk hat einen Pelz aus dünnen Borsten entwickelt, der dem Schutz seines Körpers dient. Es hat große Augen, denen auch winzig kleine Beute nicht entgeht.
Venonat is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even minuscule prey.
lgpe: Seine großen Augen fungieren als Radar. Im Licht kann man erkennen, dass sie aus unzähligen, sehr kleinen Augen bestehen.
Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

rb: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
y: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
gs: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poi sonous powder all around.
c: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
rs: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a Pokémon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
e: VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
frlg: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
dp: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
pt: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
hgss: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around.
bw: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
b2w2: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
xy: Wer die von ihm verstreuten Schuppen berührt, wird gelähmt und muss sich setzen.
The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
oras: Omot ist ein nachtaktives Pokémon. Kleine Insekten, die vom Licht in der Dunkelheit angezogen Straßenlaternen umschwärmen, sind seine bevorzugte Beute.
Venomoth is nocturnal—it is a Pokémon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
lgpe: Berührt man die staubartigen Schuppen auf seinen Flügeln, heften diese sich hartnäckig am Körper an und sondern darüber hinaus Gift ab.
The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

rb: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
y: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
gs: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
c: It digs under ground and chews on tree roots, sticking its head out only when the sun isn't bright.
rs: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple - wherever this Pokémon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
e: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.
frlg: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
dp: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
pt: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
hgss: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
bw: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
b2w2: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
xy: Dieses Pokémon lebt 1 m unter der Erde. Es frisst Wurzeln und kommt selten an die Oberfläche.
Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
oras: Digda wird zumeist auf Farmen gezüchtet. Denn wo auch immer dieses Pokémon zu graben beginnt, hinterlässt es Erde, die für das Anpflanzen von Feldfrüchten perfekt geeignet und für den Anbau köstlichen Gemüses ideal ist.
