Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple— wherever this Pokémon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
sm: Es knabbert im Erdreich die Wurzeln von Bäumen und Pflanzen an. Bei manchen Gemüsesorten kann dies zu Ernteschäden führen.
It chews on plant roots underground. Farmers whose vegetables are vulnerable find it can be quite a pest.
lgpe: Digda bevorzugt dunkle Orte. Es hält sich meist unter der Erdoberfläche auf, kommt aber auch oft in Höhlen zum Vorschein.
It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
swsh: Bewegt sich ein Digda unterirdisch fort, pflügt es dabei den Erdboden gleich mit und bereitet so den Anbau von Feldfrüchten vor.
If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

rb: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
y: A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it's an earthquake.
gs: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
c: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
rs: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
e: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.
frlg: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
dp: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
pt: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
hgss: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
bw: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
b2w2: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
xy: Im Kampf gräbt es sich ein und attackiert den Gegner aus einer unvorhersehbaren Richtung.
In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
oras: Digdri sind Drillinge, die aus einem Körper entstanden sind. Daher denken alle Köpfe gleich. Sie arbeiten so gut zusammen, dass sie endlos graben können.
Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
sm: Die drei arbeiten und handeln stets zusammen. Durch Teamwork gelingt es dem Pokémon, sich bis zu 100 km tief ins Erdreich zu graben.
This set of triplets moves cooperatively. It’s the power of teamwork that enables this Pokémon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.
lgpe: Mit der vereinten Kraft von drei Digda gräbt es sich bis zu 100 km tief in die Erde. Berichten zufolge löst dies mitunter Erdbeben aus.
A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.
swsh: Diese Digda-Drillinge graben sich manchmal bis zu 100 km tief in den Erdboden und lösen dadurch Erdbeben aus.
A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

rb: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
y: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop from picking them up.
gs: It is fascinated by round objects. It can't stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
c: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.
rs: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
e: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
frlg: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
dp: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
pt: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
hgss: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
bw: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
b2w2: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
xy: Ein nachtaktives Pokémon. Sieht es etwas Schimmerndes, fangen seine Augen an zu glänzen.
It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
oras: Mauzi zieht seine scharfen Krallen ein, um umherschleichen zu können, ohne verräterische Spuren zu hinterlassen. Dieses Pokémon hat eine Vorliebe für Münzen, die im Licht glitzern.
Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
sm: Tagsüber ist es faul und schläft ständig. Erst nach Sonnenuntergang wird es aktiv und durchstöbert die Stadt nach Münzen.
It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
lgpe: Dieses Pokémon ist offenbar nachtaktiv. Es liebt glitzernde, runde Gegenstände und stiehlt diese bei jeder Gelegenheit.
Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.
swsh: Es sammelt mit Vorliebe glänzende Gegenstände. Ist es gut gelaunt, lässt es seinen Trainer einen Blick auf seine Sammlung werfen.
It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

rb: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
y: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
gs: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
c: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.
rs: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokémon’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
e: A PERSIAN’s six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
frlg: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
dp: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
pt: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
hgss: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
bw: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
b2w2: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
xy: Dieses Pokémon hat sehr schönes Fell. Es ist jedoch ein schwer erziehbares Haustier.
Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
oras: Snobilikat hat sechs dicke Schnurrhaare, wodurch es Furcht einflößend wirkt. Durch diese nimmt es wahr, wenn sich etwas in seiner Nähe bewegt. Es wird sehr zutraulich, wenn man es an den Schnurrhaaren berührt.

Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokémon’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
sm: Sieht man diesem ungestümen Pokémon nur in die Augen, fällt es einen bereits an. Seine scharfen Klauen hinterlassen tiefe Wunden.
It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.
lgpe: Es trägt ein leuchtendes Juwel an der Stirn. Zusammen mit seinem anmutigen Gang wirkt es dadurch elegant wie eine Königin.
The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
swsh: Es ist sehr stolz, was es nicht leicht macht, mit ihm Freundschaft zu schließen. Wenn ihm etwas missfällt, fährt es unverzüglich die Krallen aus.
Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

rb: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.
y: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but it is not known if it intends to do so.
gs: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
c: The only time it can use its psy chic power is when its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.
rs: PSYDUCK uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this Pokémon generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
e: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.
frlg: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
dp: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
pt: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
hgss: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
bw: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
b2w2: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.
xy: Es wird permanent von Kopfschmerzen geplagt. Wird der Schmerz stärker, setzt es geheimnisvolle Kräfte ein.
It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
oras: Enton verwendet eine geheimnisvolle Kraft. Dabei erzeugt es Gehirnströme, die man sonst nur von Schlafenden kennt. Diese Entdeckung führte zu einer kontroversen Diskussion unter Wissenschaftlern.
Psyduck uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this Pokémon generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
sm: Es weint oft, da es immer unter Kopfschmerzen leidet und seine Psycho-Kräfte von Zeit zu Zeit gegen seinen Willen ausgelöst werden.
As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.
lgpe: Es wird von chronischen Kopfschmerzen geplagt. Ob es seine Psycho-Kräfte aus eigenem Willen einsetzt, ist unklar.
Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.
swsh: Enton leidet permanent unter Kopfschmerzen. Wenn es seine geheimnisvollen Kräfte freisetzt, sollen die Schmerzen für eine Weile nachlassen.
Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If the Pokémon lets its strange power erupt, apparently the pain subsides for a while.
pla: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

rb: Often seen swim ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
y: Its slim and long limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swim ming gracefully in lakes.
gs: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its fore head somehow be gins to glow.
c: It swims grace fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.
rs: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of GOLDUCK give it frightening speed. This Pokémon is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
e: A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.
frlg: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.
dp: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
pt: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
hgss: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
bw: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
b2w2: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.
xy: Es taucht bei Sonnenuntergang am Wasser auf. Leuchtet seine Stirn, setzt es telekinetische Kräfte ein.
It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
oras: Die mit Schwimmhäuten überzogenen Flossen an seinen Vorder- und Hinterbeinen und der stromlinienförmige Körper machen Entoron unheimlich schnell. Dieses Pokémon ist auf jeden Fall schneller als die meisten Hochleistungsschwimmer.
The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of Golduck give it frightening speed. This Pokémon is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
sm: Besitzt man den roten Fortsatz seiner Stirn, erhält man angeblich telekinetische Kräfte. Einst war es sehr selten, da es maßlos gejagt wurde.
It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who possess one, so it was over-hunted in the past.
lgpe: An seinen langen, dünnen Gliedmaßen befinden sich Schwimmflossen. Mit diesen kann es anmutig durch Seen schwimmen.
Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon lebt in sanft fließenden Flüssen. Mit seinen langen Gliedmaßen schwimmt es voller Eleganz durch das Wasser.
This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.
pla: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

rb: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
y: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
gs: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
c: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
rs: When MANKEY starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
e: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
frlg: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
dp: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
pt: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
hgss: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
bw: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
b2w2: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
xy: Da es grundlos angreift und nicht zwischen Freund oder Feind unterscheidet, ist es sehr gefährlich.
It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
oras: Wenn Menki sich schüttelt und schwer durch die Nase atmet, dann ist es wütend. Da es blitzartig in Raserei gerät, ist es unmöglich, seinem Zorn zu entkommen.

When Mankey starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
sm: Es rastet häufig völlig unvermittelt aus. Danach findet es sich oft mutterseelenallein wieder. Das macht es schließlich noch wütender.
It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.
lgpe: Es ist sehr agil und lebt auf Bäumen. Aufgrund seiner hitzköpfigen Natur wird es schnell wütend, was dazu führt, dass es alles und jeden angreift.
An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

rb: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
y: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
gs: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
c: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.
rs: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
e: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.
frlg: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.
dp: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
pt: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
hgss: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
bw: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
b2w2: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
xy: In ganz seltenen Fällen beruhigt sich dieses sehr jähzornige Pokémon und ist für einen Moment friedlich.
It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
oras: Wenn Rasaff wütend ist, wird seine Blutzirkulation gesteigert und seine Muskeln werden noch stärker. Allerdings mindert das auch die Fähigkeit zum logischen Denken.
When Primeape becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
sm: Manchmal rastet es so aus, dass es auf der Stelle tot umfällt. Sein Gesichtsausdruck ist danach jedoch äußerst friedlich.
It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.
lgpe: Es hört lediglich dann auf zu toben, wenn niemand in der Nähe ist. Diesen Anblick zu Gesicht zu bekommen, ist daher nicht einfach.
It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

rb: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
y: A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
gs: It has a brave and trustworthy na ture. It fear lessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
c: It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.
rs: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokémon won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
e: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this Pokémon won’t forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.
frlg: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
dp: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
pt: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
hgss: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
bw: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
b2w2: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.
xy: Es ist sehr freundlich und bleibt den Menschen treu. Durch Bellen und Beißen versucht es, Gegner zu verscheuchen.
Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
oras: Fukano hat einen ausgezeichneten Geruchssinn. Wenn dieses Pokémon einmal einen Geruch wahrgenommen hat, vergisst es ihn nicht mehr. Es benutzt diese Fähigkeit dazu, die Gefühlslage von Lebewesen auszuloten.

Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokémon won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
sm: Es ist klug und loyal. Sein Revier verteidigt es jedoch mit lautem Bellen gegen Fremde und Eindringlinge.
It’s both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.
lgpe: Es ist von Natur aus sehr zutraulich. Doch wenn jemand in sein Revier eindringt, wird dieser wild angebellt.
A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
swsh: Es ist von Natur aus tapfer und vertrauenswürdig und scheut auch vor Gegnern nicht zurück, die größer und stärker sind als es selbst.
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
pla: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

rb: A Pokémon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
y: A legendary Poké MON in China. Many people are charmed by its grace and beauty while running.
gs: This legendary Chinese POKEMON is considered magnif icent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
c: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.
rs: ARCANINE is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this Pokémon’s body is its source of power.
e: This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.
frlg: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.
dp: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
pt: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
hgss: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
bw: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
b2w2: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
xy: Dieses Pokémon trägt ein wunderschönes Fell. Es ist obendrein schnell und sehr wendig.
A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
oras: Arkani ist sehr schnell. Es kann an einem Tag fast 10 000 km zurücklegen. Das Feuer, das im Innern dieses Pokémon lodert, dient ihm als Energiequelle.
Arcanine is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this Pokémon’s body is its source of power.
sm: Ein anmutiges Pokémon, das Kraft und Stolz ausstrahlt. Bereits in alten Legenden aus dem weit entfernten Osten wurde von ihm berichtet.
Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.
lgpe: Weit entfernt im Osten gilt Arkani als legendär. Wenn es rennt, zieht es mit seinen leichtfüßigen Bewegungen so manche in seinen Bann.
A legendary Pokémon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.
swsh: Viele Trainer sind davon fasziniert, dass dieses Pokémon innerhalb eines Tages 10 000 km zurücklegen kann.
The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
pla: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

rb: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
y: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
gs: Because it is in ept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
c: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.
rs: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokémon’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
e: It is possible to see this Pokémon’s spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
frlg: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
dp: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
pt: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
hgss: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
bw: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
b2w2: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
xy: Seine glatte, schwarze Haut ist dünn und feucht. Teilweise sind seine Innereien als spiralförmige Muster sichtbar.
Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
oras: Quapsel hat eine sehr dünne Haut. Durch sie hindurch kann man sogar sein spiralförmiges Inneres sehen. Obwohl seine Haut so dünn ist, ist sie sehr elastisch. Selbst scharfe Reißzähne können sie nicht durchdringen.

Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokémon’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
sm: Durch seine Haut hindurch kann man sein spiralförmiges Inneres sehen. Färbt sich dieses weiß, deutet das darauf hin, dass es krank ist.
The swirl on its belly is its internal organs showing through. If the swirl is tinged white, that means it’s affected by some disease.
lgpe: Offenbar unterscheidet sich die Ausrichtung seiner Spirale je nach Geburtsregion. Es kann besser schwimmen als laufen.
The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
swsh: Quapsel kann besser schwimmen als laufen. Das Spiralmuster auf seinem Bauch ist ein Teil seiner Innereien, der durch die Haut sichtbar ist.
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

rb: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
y: Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.
gs: The swirl on its belly subtly un dulates. Staring at it may gradual ly cause drowsi ness.
c: Though it is skilled at walk ing, it prefers to live underwater where there is less danger.
rs: The surface of POLIWHIRL’s body is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
e: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
frlg: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.
dp: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
pt: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
hgss: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.
bw: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
b2w2: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
xy: Dieses Pokémon kann im Wasser und auch an Land leben. An Land schwitzt es sich den Körper nass.
It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
oras: Quaputzis Körper ist immer feucht und glitschig. Dadurch kann es während eines Kampfes leicht der Umklammerung eines Gegners entkommen.
The surface of Poliwhirl’s body is always wet and slick with a slimy fluid. Because of this slippery covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
sm: Es kann zwar auch an Land überleben, aber bevorzugt das Wasser, da es dort kaum natürliche Feinde hat.
Although it can live on land, it prefers to stay in the water, where it has fewer natural enemies.
lgpe: Wird es angegriffen, versetzt es seine Gegner mit dem Spiralmuster auf seinem Bauch in den Schlaf und flieht.
Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.
swsh: Wer länger auf seine Bauchspirale blickt, wird schläfrig. Manche Leute nutzen dies anstelle eines Schlaflieds, damit ihre Kinder einschlafen.
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

rb: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
y: Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake champion swimmers.
gs: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
c: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
rs: POLIWRATH’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this Pokémon can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
e: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This Pokémon can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
frlg: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.
dp: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
pt: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
hgss: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
bw: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
b2w2: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
xy: Es hat extrem starke Muskeln und kann durch den Ozean schwimmen, ohne sich ausruhen zu müssen.
With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
oras: Quappo besitzt hochentwickelte, starke Muskeln, die niemals ermüden, egal, wie sehr es sie auch beansprucht. Es ist so kräftig, dass es mühelos große Ozeane durchschwimmen kann.
Poliwrath’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this Pokémon can swim back and forth across the ocean without effort.
sm: Quappo, die aus Alola stammen, sind besonders gut im Brustschwimmen. Viele Kinder lernen Schwimmen, indem sie Quappo nachahmen.
Poliwrath in the Alola region are strong swimmers that use the breaststroke. Many children learn to swim by imitating Poliwrath.
lgpe: Seine beherzte Schwimmtechnik erfordert vollen Körpereinsatz und ermöglicht es ihm, selbst Weltmeister zu schlagen.
Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.
swsh: Sein ganzer Körper besteht fast nur aus Muskeln. In kalten Meeren zerschlägt es mit seinen starken Armen Treibeis, um voranzukommen.
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

rb: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
y: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
gs: It senses impend ing attacks and TELEPORTS away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
c: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.
rs: ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokémon immediately teleports to safety.
e: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.
frlg: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
dp: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
pt: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
hgss: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
bw: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
b2w2: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
xy: Es schläft 18 Stunden am Tag. Währenddessen setzt es eine Vielzahl zusätzlicher sensorischer Kräfte ein.
It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
oras: Abra schläft 18 Stunden am Tag. Es nimmt die Gegenwart von Feinden aber auch im Schlaf wahr. In einer solchen Situation bringt es sich umgehend mit Teleport in Sicherheit.
Abra sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokémon immediately teleports to safety.
sm: Abra schläft 18 Stunden am Tag. Es kann sich im Schlaf auf Bäume teleportieren, um dort Beeren zu pflücken und zu essen.
It sleeps 18 hours a day. Even while sleeping, it will teleport itself to treetops and pick and eat berries there.
lgpe: Dieses Pokémon schläft 18 Stunden am Tag. Bei Gefahr teleportiert es sich in Sicherheit, ohne dabei aufzuwachen.
Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
swsh: Es setzt seine Psycho-Kräfte selbst im Schlaf ein. Der Inhalt seiner Träume hat Einfluss auf die Kräfte, die es verwendet.
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.
pla: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

rb: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
y: Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backwards.
gs: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
c: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti cles come out of the surface of its body.
rs: KADABRA emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a TRAINER of this Pokémon.
e: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
frlg: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.
dp: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
pt: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
hgss: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
bw: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
b2w2: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
xy: Setzt es seine Psycho-Kräfte ein, sondert es Alphawellen ab, die Präzisionsgeräten schaden können.
When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.
oras: Kadabra sendet Alphawellen aus, wenn es Kopfschmerzen hat. Nur wer eine besonders starke Psyche hat, kann dieses Pokémon unter seine Fittiche nehmen.
Kadabra emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a Trainer of this Pokémon.
sm: Es heißt, dass es früher ein Junge mit Psikräften war, der sich zu Kadabra verwandelte, weil er seine Fähigkeiten nicht kontrollieren konnte.
A theory exists that this Pokémon was a young boy who couldn’t control his psychic powers and ended up transformed into this Pokémon.
lgpe: Viele seltsame Dinge passieren, wenn ein Kadabra in der Nähe ist. Uhren laufen zum Beispiel rückwärts.
Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.
swsh: Kadabras Psycho-Kräfte ermöglichen es ihm, schwebend zu schlafen. Seinen äußerst elastischen Schweif nutzt es dabei als Kissen.
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
pla: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

rb: Its brain can out perform a super computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
y: A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns-- that's why this Pokémon is smart.
gs: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
c: It has an IQ of 5000. It calcu lates many things in order to gain the edge in every battle.
rs: ALAKAZAM’s brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This Pokémon holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
e: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM’s muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.
frlg: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra sensory powers to defeat foes.
dp: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.
pt: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
hgss: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
bw: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
b2w2: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
xy: Seine Gehirnzellen vervielfachen sich sein ganzes Leben lang. Daher kann es sich immer an alles erinnern.
Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
oras: Simsalas Gehirn hört nicht auf zu wachsen, sodass sein Kopf zu schwer für seine Nackenmuskulatur wird. Dieses Pokémon hält seinen Kopf mit psychokinetischer Energie aufrecht.
Alakazam’s brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This Pokémon holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
sm: Es hat einen IQ von 5 000. Seine Psycho-Kräfte sind so stark ausgeprägt, dass man Kopfweh bekommt, wenn man nur neben ihm steht.
It is said to have an IQ of approximately 5,000. Its overflowing psychokinetic powers cause headaches to anyone nearby.
lgpe: Es hat ein perfektes Gedächtnis und vergisst nichts. Das macht es zu einem sehr schlauen Pokémon.
A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that’s why this Pokémon is smart.
swsh: Es verfügt über extrem hohe Intelligenz und soll sich an alles erinnern können, was zwischen seiner Geburt und seinem Tod passiert.
It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
pla: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

rb: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
y: Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.
gs: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
c: It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.
rs: MACHOP’s muscles are special - they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This Pokémon has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.
e: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.
frlg: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
dp: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
pt: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of GEODUDE at once.
hgss: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
bw: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
b2w2: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
xy: Es hebt Georok hoch, um seinen Körper zu trainieren. Außerdem übt es sich in jeder Art von Kampfsport.
It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
oras: Machollos Muskeln sind etwas Besonderes. Sie schmerzen nie, egal, wie sehr sie beansprucht werden. Dieses Pokémon hat genug Kraft, um 100 Erwachsene umherzuwerfen.
Machop’s muscles are special—they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This Pokémon has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.
sm: Es liebt Muskelaufbautraining und verfolgt jeden Tag das Wachstum seiner Muskeln. Dies spornt es zu noch intensiverem Training an.
It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.
lgpe: Dieses Pokémon ist recht klein, doch seine Kampfsportkenntnisse machen es zu einem sehr starken Gegner.
Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.
swsh: Sein ganzer Körper besteht aus Muskeln. Auch wenn es nur so groß wie ein Menschenkind ist, kann es 100 Erwachsene jonglieren.
Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
pla: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

rb: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
y: The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.
gs: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.
c: This tough Pokémon always stays in the zone. Its muscles become thicker after every battle.
rs: MACHOKE’s thoroughly toned muscles possess the hardness of steel. This Pokémon has so much strength, it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler on just one finger.
e: A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.
frlg: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
dp: MACHOKE’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
pt: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
hgss: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.
bw: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
b2w2: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
xy: Dieses Pokémon ist superstark. Es kann sich nur mit einem Kraft regulierenden Gürtel bewegen.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
oras: Maschocks starke Muskeln sind so hart wie Stahl. Dieses Pokémon hat so viel Kraft, dass es mit nur einem Finger einen Sumo-Ringer in der Luft halten kann.
Machoke’s thoroughly toned muscles possess the hardness of steel. This Pokémon has so much strength, it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler on just one finger.
sm: Es hat sich durch unerbittliches Training unglaubliche Kräfte angeeignet, mit denen es die Menschen bei der Arbeit unterstützt.
As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.
lgpe: Der Gürtel an seiner Hüfte dient dazu, seine Kraft zu begrenzen. Ohne ihn wäre Maschock nicht zu bändigen.
The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon ist superstark. Es kann sich nur mit einem kraftregulierenden Gürtel bewegen.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
pla: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

rb: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
y: One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this Pokémon fires off awesome punches.
gs: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
c: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.
rs: MACHAMP has the power to hurl anything aside. However, trying to do any work requiring care and dexterity causes its arms to get tangled. This Pokémon tends to leap into action before it thinks.
e: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.
frlg: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
dp: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
pt: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
hgss: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
bw: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
b2w2: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
xy: Seine markigen Arme können innerhalb von nur zwei Sekunden 1 000 Schläge verteilen.
Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
oras: Machomei hat genug Kraft, um alles Mögliche zu stemmen. Bei Tätigkeiten, die Geschick und Sorgfalt erfordern, machen es ihm seine Arme jedoch nicht leicht. Dieses Pokémon neigt dazu, zuerst zu handeln und dann zu denken.
Machamp has the power to hurl anything aside. However, trying to do any work requiring care and dexterity causes its arms to get tangled. This Pokémon tends to leap into action before it thinks.
sm: Gegner, die sich ihm in den Weg stellen, werden mit einem Faustschlag, dessen Wucht 1 Million Tonnen übersteigt, gen Horizont geschleudert.
It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.
lgpe: Es kann mit nur einem Arm Berge versetzen. Die geballte Kraft seiner vier Arme lässt es unvorstellbare Schläge austeilen.
One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this Pokémon fires off awesome punches.
swsh: Es verwendet seine vier Arme, um seine Gegner unermüdlich mit schnellen Schlägen aus allen Winkeln einzudecken.
It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
pla: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

rb: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
y: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny insects with its vines and devours them.
gs: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
c: If it notices anything that moves, it immediately flings its vine at the object.
rs: BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
e: A BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.
frlg: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.
dp: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
pt: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
hgss: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
bw: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
b2w2: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
xy: Obwohl sein Körper sehr schmal ist, schnappt es blitzschnell nach Beute.
Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
oras: Knofensas schlanker und elastischer Körper ermöglicht es ihm, jedem Angriff auszuweichen, so heftig dieser auch sein mag. Dieses Pokémon spuckt eine ätzende Flüssigkeit aus, die sogar Eisen zersetzen kann.
Bellsprout’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
lgpe: Knofensa bevorzugt einen warmen und feuchten Lebensraum. Es ernährt sich von kleinen Käfer- Pokémon, die es mit seinen Ranken fängt.
Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

rb: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
y: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is melted inside by strong acids.
gs: Even though it is filled with ACID, it does not melt because it also oozes a neutral izing fluid.
c: When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.
rs: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokémon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
e: At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
frlg: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
dp: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
pt: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
hgss: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.
bw: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
b2w2: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
xy: Die Blätter werden eingesetzt, um Gegner aufzuschlitzen. Dieses Pokémon spuckt eine Flüssigkeit, die alles auflöst.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
oras: Ultrigaria hat einen großen Haken an seinem Hinterteil. Nachts hängt sich dieses Pokémon zum Schlafen an einen Ast. Wenn es sich im Schlaf bewegt, kann es passieren, dass es auf dem Boden wieder aufwacht.
Weepinbell has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokémon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
lgpe: Wenn es hungrig ist, schnappt es willkürlich nach allem, was sich bewegt. Nachdem es seine Beute verschluckt hat, schaltet es sie mit Säure aus.
When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

rb: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
y: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is melted in a day, bones and all.
gs: ACID that has dis solved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
c: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.
rs: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokémon swallows it whole.
e: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.
frlg: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.
dp: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
pt: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
hgss: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
bw: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
b2w2: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honey-like scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
xy: Dieses Pokémon soll in großen Kolonien tief im Dschungel leben, doch niemand kann dies bestätigen.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
oras: Aus Sarzenias Kopf ragt eine lange Ranke hervor, die es bewegt, als wäre sie ein kleines Lebewesen. Nähert sich ahnungslose Beute dieser Falle, verschlingt Sarzenia sie im Ganzen.

Victreebel has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokémon swallows it whole.
lgpe: Es lockt Beute mit einem Duft an, der an Honig erinnert. Was in sein Maul gelangt, wird samt Knochen binnen eines Tages zersetzt.
Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

rb: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
y: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
gs: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
c: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.
rs: TENTACOOL’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this Pokémon happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
e: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
frlg: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.
dp: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
pt: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
hgss: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
bw: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
b2w2: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
xy: Sein Körper besteht aus Wasser. Aus seinen kristallartigen Augen verschießt es eigenartige Strahlen.
Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
oras: Tentachas Körper setzt sich zum größten Teil aus Wasser zusammen. Wenn es das Meer verlässt, vertrocknet es. Wenn dieses Pokémon auszutrocknen beginnt, sollte man es schnell wieder ins Wasser zurückbringen.
Tentacool’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this Pokémon happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
sm: Am Strand kann man oft stark ausgetrocknete Exemplare finden, die aber noch leben. Taucht man sie in Wasser, werden sie wieder topfit.
They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.
lgpe: Findet man ein schwaches, ausgetrocknetes Tentacha am Strand und bringt es ins Wasser zurück, so wird es wieder topfit.
It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
swsh: Da Tentacha kein besonders guter Schwimmer ist, treibt es in seichten Gewässern an der Wasseroberfläche und sucht nach Beute.
Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.
pla: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

rb: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
y: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
gs: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to CON STRICT its prey and enemies.
c: When its 80 feel ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.
rs: TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokémon’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
e: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
frlg: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
dp: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
pt: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
hgss: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.
bw: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
b2w2: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
xy: Dieses Pokémon kann die Tentakel bei der Jagd ausfahren, um die Beute leichter zu fangen.
The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
oras: Tentoxa hat große, rote Kugeln auf seinem Kopf. Sie glühen auf, bevor sie seine Gegner mit Ultraschall erschüttern. Ein Ausbruch dieses Pokémon erzeugt starke Wellen in seiner Umgebung.
Tentacruel has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokémon’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
sm: Es hat für gewöhnlich 80 giftige Tentakel. Mit dem Alter verliert es diese jedoch nach und nach.
Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.
lgpe: Beute umwickelt es mit seinen 80 Tentakeln, die es nach Belieben ausfahren oder einziehen kann. Danach schwächt es sie mit Gift.
Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
swsh: Leuchten die roten Kugeln auf seinem Kopf stark auf, ist Vorsicht geboten, da es kurz danach Ultraschallwellen ausstoßen wird.
When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.
pla: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

rb: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
y: Commonly found near mountain trails, etc. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
gs: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
c: Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.
rs: The longer a GEODUDE lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokémon’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
e: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
frlg: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.
dp: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
pt: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
hgss: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
bw: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
b2w2: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
xy: Wanderer stolpern in den Bergen häufig über dieses Pokémon, da es wie ein Stein aussieht.
Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
oras: Je länger ein Kleinstein lebt, desto mehr wird seine raue Oberfläche abgeschliffen, sodass es runder wird. Das Herz dieses Pokémon bleibt aber für immer versteinert, hart und rau.
The longer a Geodude lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokémon’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
sm: Trotz seiner griffigen, runden Form ist Kleinstein hart und schwer. Bewirft man sich damit wie mit Schneebällen, besteht Verletzungsgefahr!
Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It’s dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.
lgpe: Es hält sich gern in der Nähe von Gebirgspfaden auf. Tritt man versehentlich auf eins, wird es sehr wütend. Deshalb ist höchste Vorsicht geboten.
Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
pla: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

rb: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
y: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
gs: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
c: It travels by rol ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.
rs: GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokémon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
e: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
frlg: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.
dp: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
pt: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
hgss: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
bw: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
b2w2: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
xy: Es ist ihm völlig gleichgültig, wenn Stücke aus ihm herausbrechen, während es Berge hinabrollt.
With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
oras: Georok wächst, indem es sich von Steinen ernährt. Am liebsten mag es Steine, die mit Moos überzogen sind. Dieses Pokémon frisst sich täglich durch eine riesige Menge von Steinen.
Graveler grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokémon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
sm: Mit Moos überzogene Steine sind seine absolute Leibspeise. Es vertilgt täglich laut knirschend eine ganze Tonne davon.
Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.
lgpe: Es rollt sich gerne Gebirgspfade hinunter. Dabei ist es ihm egal, wer oder was sich in seinem Weg befindet.
Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
pla: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

rb: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
y: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
gs: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hard ens and crumbles away.
c: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.
rs: GOLEM live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokémon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
e: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
frlg: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
dp: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
pt: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
hgss: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.
bw: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
b2w2: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
xy: Sie rollen Berge hinunter und hinterlassen Spurrillen. Halte dich von diesen Rillen fern.
It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
oras: Geowaz lebt hoch in den Bergen. Gibt es ein starkes Erdbeben, rollt dieses Pokémon so lange den Berg hinunter, bis es schließlich unten angekommen ist.
Golem live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokémon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
sm: Selbst Sprengstoff kann seinem harten Körper nichts anhaben. Es verabscheut Feuchtigkeit und Regen.
Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.
lgpe: Nachdem es sich gehäutet hat, wird sein Körper weich und hell. Durch den Kontakt mit der Luft erhärtet er aber sofort wieder.
Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.
pla: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

rb: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
y: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
gs: It is a weak run ner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
c: Training by jumping over grass that grows longer every day has made it a world-class jumper.
rs: PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
e: A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.
frlg: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.
dp: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.
pt: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
hgss: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
bw: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
b2w2: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
xy: Neugeboren kann es kaum stehen. Durch das Galoppieren werden seine Beine aber schneller und kräftiger.
As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
oras: Nach seiner Geburt ist Ponita so schwach, dass es kaum von alleine aufstehen kann. Dieses Pokémon wird dadurch schnell stärker, dass es sich beim Versuch, mit seinen Eltern Schritt zu halten, immer wieder aufrappeln muss.
Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
lgpe: Es kann unglaublich hoch springen. Die Wucht der Landung absorbiert es mit seinen robusten Hufen und Beinen.
Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
swsh: Nach der Geburt fällt ihm das Laufen schwer. Die Wettrennen, die es sich mit seinen Freunden liefert, stärken jedoch seine Beinmuskulatur.
It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
pla: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

rb: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
y: Just loves to run. If it sees some thing faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
gs: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredi bly fast.
c: It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the long er the swaying flames of its mane will become.
rs: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this Pokémon turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
e: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
frlg: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.
dp: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
pt: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
hgss: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.
bw: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
b2w2: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
xy: Dieses Pokémon verfolgt schnelle Objekte in der Hoffnung, ein Wettrennen gegen sie zu gewinnen.
Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
oras: Man kann Gallopa dabei beobachten, wie es lässig über Felder und Wiesen galoppiert. Wenn dieses Pokémon jedoch Ernst macht, erreicht es bis zu 240 km/h. Dann beginnt seine Mähne zu lodern.
Rapidash usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this Pokémon turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
lgpe: Es galoppiert für sein Leben gern. Entdeckt es etwas, das schneller ist als es selbst, nimmt es blitzschnell die Verfolgung auf.
Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
swsh: Die lodernde Mähne dieses Pokémon flattert im Wind, wenn es mit einer Geschwindigkeit von 240 km/h über Felder und Wiesen galoppiert.
This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
pla: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

rb: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
y: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
gs: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
c: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
rs: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
e: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
frlg: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
dp: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
pt: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
hgss: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.
bw: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
b2w2: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
xy: Es ist stets in Gedanken versunken und niemand weiß, worüber es nachdenkt. Es kann mit seiner Rute gut angeln.
It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
oras: Flegmon benutzt seinen Schweif, um Beute zu fangen, indem es ihn an einem Flussufer ins Wasser taucht. Dieses Pokémon vergisst häufig, was es gerade tun wollte, und verbringt ganze Tage damit, am Ufer herumzutrödeln.
Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
sm: Seine Rute bricht sehr leicht ab. Dies kümmert es jedoch wenig, da es dabei keine Schmerzen spürt und sie sofort wieder nachwächst.
Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn’t really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn’t particularly bothered.
lgpe: Dieses Pokémon ist unglaublich faul und träge. Es faulenzt den ganzen Tag lang und schert sich nicht um die verstrichene Zeit.
Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
swsh: Es ist so träge und unempfindlich, dass es keinen Schmerz verspürt, wenn seine Rute gegessen wird. Es bemerkt nicht einmal, dass sie nachwächst.
Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

rb: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
y: Lives lazily by the sea. If the SHELLDER on its tail comes off, it becomes a SLOWPOKE again.
gs: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordi nary SLOWPOKE.
c: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
rs: SLOWBRO’s tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
e: Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
frlg: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.
dp: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
pt: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
hgss: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary SLOWPOKE.
bw: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
b2w2: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
xy: Das Muschas an seiner Rute lässt nicht locker, da ein leckerer Geschmack aus seiner Rute strömt.
An attached Shellder won’t let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
oras: An Lahmus’ Rute hat sich ein Muschas festgebissen. Daher kann es ihn nicht mehr zum Angeln benutzen und es ist dazu gezwungen, umherzuschwimmen und nach Beute Ausschau zu halten.
Slowbro’s tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
sm: Es betrachtet oft mit leerem Blick das Meer. Das Gift, das Muschas in seinen Körper injiziert, erhöht seine Begriffsstutzigkeit noch weiter.
It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder’s poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.
lgpe: Es führt ein ruhiges Leben in der Nähe des Meeres. Verliert es das Muschas an seinem Schwanz, wird es wieder zu einem Flegmon.
Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.
swsh: Es entwickelte sich, als ein Muschas in seine Rute biss. Das süße Aroma, das aus der Rute strömt, hat Muschas in eine Art Trance versetzt.
Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.
