rb: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
y: It is born with the ability to defy gravity. It floats in air on powerful electro magnetic waves.
gs: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach trainers if they are using their PokéGEAR.
c: The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.
rs: MAGNEMITE attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this Pokémon clinging to the breaker box.
e: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.
frlg: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.
dp: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.
pt: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
hgss: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach Trainers if they are using their Pokégear.
bw: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
b2w2: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
xy: Die Magneten an seinem Körper erzeugen ein Antigravitationsfeld, um es ständig in der Schwebe zu halten.
The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
oras: Magnetilo ernährt sich von Elektrizität aus Stromleitungen. Dieses Pokémon hängt sich gern an Sicherungskästen. Wenn es in deinem Haus zu einem Stromausfall kommt, solltest du die Sicherungen überprüfen.

Magnemite attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this Pokémon clinging to the breaker box.
sm: Sie scharen sich um Orte, durch die Elektrizität fließt. Deshalb klammern sie sich zum Beispiel sehr oft in Massen an Strommasten fest.
They gather in places where electricity is available. They can be found clinging to the steel towers used to support power lines.
lgpe: Es trotzt von Geburt an der Schwerkraft und schwebt auf elektromagnetischen Wellen durch die Luft.
It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity. It floats while emitting powerful electromagnetic waves.
swsh: Manchmal geht die Elektrizität in seinem Körper zur Neige, woraufhin es zu Boden fällt. Eine Batterie bringt es wieder in Bewegung.
At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it’ll start moving again.
pla: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

rb: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
y: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the tem perature by 3.6F degrees within 3,300 feet.
gs: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
c: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.
rs: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this Pokémon.
e: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
frlg: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
dp: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.
pt: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
hgss: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
bw: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
b2w2: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.
xy: Schließen sich mehrere Magnetilo zusammen, entsteht dieses Pokémon. Es entlädt kräftige Hochspannungsmagnetwellen.
A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
oras: Magneton erzeugt ein sehr starkes Magnetfeld, das Maschinen zerstören kann. Deshalb hört man in großen Städten oft Sirenen, die die Bürger vor Scharen dieser Pokémon warnen sollen.
Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this Pokémon.
sm: Drei Magnetilo schließen sich zusammen und vereinigen ihre Gehirne. Das heißt aber nicht, dass dieses Pokémon dreimal so schlau wird.
When three Magnemite link together, their brains also become one. They do not become three times more intelligent.
lgpe: Es erzeugt seltsame Radiowellen, durch welche die Lufttemperatur in einem Radius von 1 km um 2 ºC steigt.
Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.
swsh: Es entsteht durch den Zusammenschluss dreier Magnetilo und sendet starke Radiowellen aus, um seine Umgebung zu untersuchen.
This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.
pla: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

rb: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
y: Lives where reedy plants grow. They are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.
gs: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.
c: In order to pre vent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these Pokémon.
rs: FARFETCH’D is always seen with a stick from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over sticks.
e: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.
frlg: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
dp: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
pt: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
hgss: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.
bw: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
b2w2: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
xy: Dieses Pokémon nutzt eine Lauchstange als Waffe. Es setzt sie wie ein Schwert ein.
The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.
oras: Porenta trifft man immer mit einer Lauchstange an. Es gibt gute und schlechte Stangen. Dieses Pokémon kämpft mit Hilfe seiner Stange gegen seine Gegner.
Farfetch’d is always seen with a stalk from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good stalks and bad stalks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over stalks.
lgpe: Sie leben in Gebieten, in denen stangenförmige Gewächse gedeihen. Da diese seltener werden, scheint es auch weniger Porenta zu geben.
They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought their numbers are decreasing.
swsh: Unter seinem Flügel trägt es eine Lauchstange, die es wie ein Schwert gegen Feinde einsetzt und welche ihm im Bedarfsfall auch als Nahrung dient.
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

rb: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
y: Its short wings make flying dif ficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.
gs: By alternately raising and lower ing its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
c: It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.
rs: DODUO’s two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.
e: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.
frlg: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
dp: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
pt: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
hgss: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
bw: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
b2w2: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
xy: Dieses zweiköpfige Pokémon gilt als plötzliche Mutation. Es rennt bis zu 100 km/h schnell.
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
oras: Dodu hat zwei Köpfe, die nie zur selben Zeit, sondern abwechselnd schlafen. Während ein Kopf schläft, hält der andere Ausschau nach Feinden.
Doduo’s two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.
lgpe: Es kann nicht gut fliegen, weil seine Flügel zu klein sind. Dafür kann es mit seinen starken Beinen sehr schnell laufen.
Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

rb: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
y: One of DODUO's 2 heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 MPH in prairies.
gs: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and be come immobilized.
c: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
rs: Watch out if DODRIO’s three heads are looking in three separate directions. It’s a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don’t go near this Pokémon if it’s being wary - it may decide to peck you.
e: A peculiar Pokémon species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.
frlg: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.
dp: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
pt: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
hgss: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.
bw: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
b2w2: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
xy: Lässt ein Feind auch nur einen der drei Köpfe für nur eine Sekunde aus den Augen, wird er sofort gepickt.
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
oras: Dodris drei Köpfe blicken in drei verschiedene Richtungen. Es ist immer auf der Hut. Du solltest dich diesem Pokémon nicht nähern, wenn es bereits misstrauisch ist. Es könnte nach dir hacken.
Watch out if Dodrio’s three heads are looking in three separate directions. It’s a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don’t go near this Pokémon if it’s being wary—it may decide to peck you.
lgpe: Bei der Entwicklung zu Dodri hat sich einer von Dodus Köpfen in zwei geteilt. Es flitzt mit einer Geschwindigkeit von 60 km/h über Wiesen.
One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

rb: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
y: Loves freezing cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid cli mate of around 14F degrees.
gs: Although it can't walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It espe cially loves being in frigid seas.
c: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves iceberg- filled oceans.
rs: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
e: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
frlg: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.
dp: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
pt: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
hgss: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.
bw: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
b2w2: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.
xy: Dieses Pokémon lebt auf Eisbergen. Es schwimmt im Eiswasser und bricht das Eis mithilfe seines Horns.
A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
oras: Jurob jagt unter der eisigen Oberfläche des Eismeeres nach Beute. Zum Luftholen schlägt es mit dem vorstehenden Teil seines Kopfes ein Loch ins Eis.
Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
sm: Bisher wurde vermutet, dass es ausschließlich in kalten Gewässern lebe. Warum es auch in Alola auftaucht, ist noch ein Rätsel.
It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.
lgpe: Es bevorzugt eiskalte Lebensräume und schwimmt mit Vorliebe in -10 ºC kaltem Wasser.
Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

rb: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
y: Its entire body is a snowy-white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
gs: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
c: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.
rs: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
e: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
frlg: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
dp: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
pt: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
hgss: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
bw: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
b2w2: Its streamlined body has low resistance, and it swims around cold oceans at a speed of eight knots.
xy: Sein Körper ist mit reinem, weißem Fell überzogen. Je kälter es wird, desto aktiver wird dieses Pokémon.
Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
oras: Jugong liebt es, auf bitterkalten Eisschollen ein Nickerchen zu machen. Ein Seemann, der einmal ein solches Pokémon schlafend auf einem Eisberg sah, hielt es irrtümlicherweise für eine Meerjungfrau.
Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
sm: Es schwimmt mit bis zu acht Knoten im Meer und sucht nach Beute. Für Lusardin hat es eine besondere Vorliebe.
It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It’s especially fond of Wishiwashi.
lgpe: Sein ganzer Körper ist schneeweiß. Da ihm Kälte nichts ausmacht, kann es selbst in Eiswasser kraftvoll schwimmen.
Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

rb: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
y: Made of hardened sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
gs: As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
c: When two of these Pokémon's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
rs: GRIMER’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokémon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
e: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER’s favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.
frlg: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.
dp: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
pt: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
hgss: As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
bw: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
b2w2: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.
xy: Schlamm, der Röntgenstrahlung vom Mond ausgesetzt war, wurde zu Sleima. Es isst am liebsten dreckige Dinge.
Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.
oras: Sleimas glitschiger, gummiartiger Körper passt durch jede noch so kleine Öffnung. Dieses Pokémon steigt in die Kanalisation hinab, um fauliges Abwasser zu trinken.
Grimer’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokémon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
sm: Es ernährt sich primär von Industrieabfällen. In letzter Zeit sieht man es viel seltener als früher.
Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon’s numbers have been decreasing in recent years.
lgpe: Sleima ist aus erhärtetem Schlamm entstanden. Es riecht sehr penetrant und man sollte es nicht berühren. Wo es hintritt, wächst kein Gras mehr.
Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

rb: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
y: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration, it lost its sense of smell.
gs: They love to gath er in smelly areas where sludge ac cumulates, making the stench around them worse.
c: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.
rs: From MUK’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this Pokémon’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
e: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.
frlg: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.
dp: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
pt: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
hgss: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
bw: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
b2w2: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.
xy: Sie treffen sich an stinkenden Orten, an denen der Schleim sich türmt. Dies merkt man am Gestank.
They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
oras: Sleimok scheidet eine widerlich stinkende Substanz aus. Ein einziger Tropfen dieser Substanz reicht aus, um ein Gewässer zu verseuchen.
From Muk’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this Pokémon’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
sm: Es sondert einen widerlichen Gestank ab. In Fankreisen wird jedoch ausgerechnet diese Eigenschaft besonders geschätzt.
The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that’s a good thing.
lgpe: Sein fürchterlicher Gestank kann zur Ohnmacht führen. Da seine Nase so verkümmert ist, kann es selbst nichts mehr riechen.
Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

rb: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
y: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.
gs: It swims facing backward by open ing and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
c: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.
rs: At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
e: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
frlg: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
dp: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
pt: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
hgss: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
bw: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
b2w2: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
xy: Eine harte Schale schützt dieses Pokémon. Nur wenn es diese öffnet, wird es verwundbar.
Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
oras: Nachts benutzt dieses Pokémon seine breite Zunge, um ein Loch in den Meeresboden zu graben. Darin schläft es. Dabei schließt es seine Schale, aber die Zunge hängt heraus.
At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, Shellder closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
sm: Ihre Schalen sind härter als Diamanten. Vor langer Zeit sammelte man die Schalen von Muschas und machte Schilde daraus.
The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.
lgpe: Seine Schale ist hart genug, um allen Attacken standzuhalten. Wenn sie offen ist, kommt sein weiches Inneres zum Vorschein.
The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.
swsh: Es schwimmt rückwärts, indem es seine Schale öffnet und schließt, und ist damit überraschend schnell.
It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

rb: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
y: For protection, it uses its harder- than-diamonds shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.
gs: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superi or strength.
c: Even a missile can't break the spikes it uses to stab opponents. They're even hard er than its shell.
rs: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This Pokémon shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
e: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
frlg: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
dp: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
pt: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
hgss: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
bw: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
b2w2: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
xy: Austos, die im Meer mit starker Strömung leben, werden groß und entwickeln scharfe Stacheln.
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
oras: Austos kann im Meerwasser schwimmen, indem es Wasser schluckt und wieder herausspritzt. Dieses Pokémon kann sich auch verteidigen, indem es spitze Stacheln mithilfe des Wasserdrucks verschießt.
Cloyster is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This Pokémon shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
sm: Seine Schale ist so hart, dass nicht einmal eine Bombe sie zerschmettern kann. Bis heute weiß niemand, wie das Innere seiner Schale aussieht.
Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.
lgpe: Es wird von einer Schale geschützt, die härter als Diamant ist. Dieses gefährliche Pokémon feuert die Stacheln an seiner Schale auf Gegner ab.
For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamond shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.
swsh: Seine Schale ist extrem hart und kann nicht einmal durch eine Bombe zerschmettert werden. Sie öffnet sich nur, wenn es angreift.
Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

rb: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
y: Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape as it appears to be made of a gas.
gs: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
c: It wraps its op ponent in its gas- like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
rs: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
e: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY’s gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
frlg: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.
dp: This Pokémon’s body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.
pt: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
hgss: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
bw: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
b2w2: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
xy: Es hat einen gasförmigen Körper. Es kann jeden Gegner mit Giftgas einnebeln und dadurch ersticken.
Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
oras: Nebulak hat einen gasförmigen Körper. Wenn es starkem Wind ausgesetzt wird, kann es davongeweht werden. Scharen dieser Pokémon sammeln sich unter Dachrinnen, um sich vor dem gefährlichen Wind zu schützen.

Gastly is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
sm: Flackert in einem verlassenen alten Gebäude plötzlich ein rätselhaftes Licht auf, hält sich dort ein Nebulak versteckt.
Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.
lgpe: Es heißt, es erscheine in alten, verlassenen Gebäuden. Sein Körper hat keine feste Form und erinnert an Gas.
Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape, as it appears to be made of a gas.
swsh: Es ist aus Gasen entstanden. Wird jemand in seinen gasförmigen, giftigen Körper gehüllt, so fällt er in Ohnmacht.
Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
pla: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

rb: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an other dimension.
y: By licking, it saps the victim's life. It causes shaking that won't stop until the victim's demise.
gs: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
c: It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of the next living thing that wanders close by.
rs: HAUNTER is a dangerous Pokémon. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
e: If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don’t approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
frlg: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.
dp: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
pt: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
hgss: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
bw: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
b2w2: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
xy: Falls du im Dunkeln das Gefühl hast, beobachtet zu werden und niemand ist zu sehen, ist es bestimmt Alpollo.
If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
oras: Alpollo ist ein gefährliches Pokémon. Wenn es dich zu sich lockt, während es durch die Dunkelheit schwebt, darfst du ihm keinesfalls zu nahe kommen. Dieses Pokémon wird versuchen, an dir zu lecken und dein Leben zu stehlen.
Haunter is a dangerous Pokémon. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
sm: Es lauert Menschen im Dunkeln auf und leckt sie mit seiner kalten Zunge. Danach werden sie von Tag zu Tag schwächer, bis sie dahinscheiden.
It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.
lgpe: Es saugt seinen Opfern das Leben aus, indem es sie abschleckt. Man sagt, sie würden daraufhin unentwegt zittern, bis sie schließlich entschlafen.
By licking, it saps the victim’s life. It causes shaking that won’t stop until the victim’s demise.
swsh: Seine Zunge besteht aus Gas. Schleckt es seine Opfer damit ab, zittern diese unentwegt, bis sie schließlich entschlafen.
Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
pla: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

rb: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
y: A GENGAR is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
gs: It steals heat from its surround ings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
c: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
rs: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
e: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
frlg: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.
dp: It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.
pt: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.
hgss: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
bw: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
b2w2: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
xy: Es versteckt sich im Schatten. Man sagt, wenn sich ein Gengar versteckt, kühlt es sich um 5 °C ab.
It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
oras: Nachts kann es passieren, dass dich dein Schatten im Licht einer Straßenlaterne plötzlich überholt. Dann ist es ein Gengar, das an dir vorbeiläuft und sich als dein Schatten ausgibt.
Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
sm: Läuft es einem plötzlich eiskalt den Rücken hinunter, wurde man von Gengar als nächstes Opfer auserkoren. Widerstand ist zwecklos.
Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.
lgpe: Läuft es einem plötzlich eiskalt den Rücken hinunter, ist ein Gengar in der Nähe. Womöglich belegt es einen dann mit einem Fluch.
A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
swsh: Wenn Schatten bei Vollmond plötzlich anfangen, sich zu bewegen und zu lachen, steckt zweifellos Gengar dahinter.
On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.
pla: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

rb: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
y: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by DIGLETTs.
gs: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
c: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
rs: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
e: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
frlg: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.
dp: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
pt: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
hgss: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
bw: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
b2w2: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.
xy: Dieses Pokémon gräbt auf seiner Suche nach Futter lange Tunnel, in denen sich später Digda einnisten.
Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
oras: Onix hat einen Magneten in seinem Gehirn. Er dient ihm als Kompass, sodass es beim Graben von Tunneln nicht die Orientierung verliert. Wenn es älter wird, wird sein Körper immer runder und glatter.
Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
lgpe: Es gräbt auf seiner Suche nach Futter mit irrsinniger Geschwindigkeit lange Tunnel, in denen sich später Digda einnisten.
Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
swsh: Wenn es sich durch die Erde gräbt, nimmt es viele harte Gegenstände auf, die seinen Körper erhärten.
As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
pla: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

rb: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
y: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it has eaten in the past.
gs: If you think that you had a good dream, but you can't remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
c: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
rs: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
e: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
frlg: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.
dp: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
pt: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
hgss: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
bw: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
b2w2: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
xy: Traumato versetzt Gegner in den Schlaf und frisst deren Träume. Von Alpträumen wird ihm aber übel.
Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.
oras: Wenn dir im Schlaf die Nase juckt, ist das ein sicheres Zeichen dafür, dass eines dieser Pokémon auf deinem Kissen sitzt, um deinen Traum durch deine Nasenlöcher hindurch zu verspeisen.
If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
sm: Es ernährt sich von Träumen. Man geht davon aus, dass es von demselben Vorfahren wie Somniam und Somnivora abstammt.
A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.
lgpe: Wenn man immer in der Nähe eines Traumato schläft, zeigt es einem nachts manchmal Träume, die es vor langer Zeit verspeist hat.
If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

rb: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
y: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
gs: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
c: The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.
rs: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this Pokémon searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
e: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO’s hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
frlg: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
dp: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
pt: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
hgss: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
bw: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
b2w2: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
xy: Es trägt ein Pendel. Man berichtet von einem Vorfall, bei dem es ein Kind mitnahm, das es zuvor hypnotisiert hatte.
It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
oras: Hypno hält ein Pendel in der Hand. Das Schwingen und Glitzern des Pendels versetzt seine Feinde in eine tiefe Hypnose. Während dieses Pokémon auf der Suche nach Beute ist, poliert es sein Pendel.
Hypno holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this Pokémon searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
sm: Dieses Pokémon ist äußerst gefährlich. Für Menschen, die an Schlaflosigkeit leiden, ist es aber ein wahrer Retter in der Not.
While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.
lgpe: Läuft man einem Hypno über den Weg, sollte man wegsehen, da es andere mit dem Pendel in seiner Hand hypnotisieren kann.
Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

rb: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
y: Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.
gs: If it senses dan ger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
c: If it is unable to find food, it will absorb nutrients by swallowing a mouthful of sand.
rs: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these Pokémon can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
e: KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
frlg: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
dp: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
pt: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
hgss: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
bw: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
b2w2: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
xy: Wittert es Gefahr, hüllt es sich in Blasen aus seinem Maul, um größer zu erscheinen.
If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
oras: Krabby lebt an Stränden, in Löchern im Sand. An Sandstränden, an denen es wenig Nahrung findet, sieht man dieses Pokémon mit Artgenossen um sein Revier streiten.
Krabby live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these Pokémon can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
lgpe: Die Scheren dieses Pokémon bilden perfekte Waffen. Im Kampf brechen sie zwar manchmal ab, wachsen aber schnell wieder nach.
Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.
swsh: Es kommt vor allem nahe dem Meer vor. Die großen Scheren wachsen nach, wenn sie vom Körper abgetrennt wurden.
It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

rb: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
y: One claw grew massively and as hard as steel. It has 10,000-HP strength. However, it is too heavy.
gs: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer's size makes it difficult to aim properly.
c: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
rs: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the Pokémon quickly tires.
e: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this Pokémon quickly tires.
frlg: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
dp: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
pt: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
hgss: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer’s size makes it difficult to aim properly.
bw: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
b2w2: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
xy: Die Kraft seiner großen und harten Schere entspricht 10 000 PS. Durch die Größe ist sie aber auch äußerst unhandlich und sperrig.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
oras: Kingler hat eine riesige Schere. Es winkt damit, um mit anderen zu kommunizieren. Da seine Schere aber so schwer ist, wird dieses Pokémon schnell müde.
Kingler has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the Pokémon quickly tires.
lgpe: Seine größere Schere ist zwar hart wie Stahl und verfügt über eine außerordentliche Stärke, aber gleichzeitig ist sie auch extrem schwer.
One claw grew massively and is as hard as steel. It has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is too heavy.
swsh: Die Kraft seiner großen und harten Schere entspricht 10 000 PS. Durch die Größe ist sie aber auch äußerst unhandlich und sperrig.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

rb: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, they have zapped many people.
y: It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
gs: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
c: During the study of this Pokémon, it was discovered that its compo nents are not found in nature.
rs: VOLTORB was first sighted at a company that manufactures Poké BallS. The link between that sighting and the fact that this Pokémon looks very similar to a Poké Ball remains a mystery.
e: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.
frlg: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.
dp: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
pt: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
hgss: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
bw: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
b2w2: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.
xy: Es wurde entdeckt, als man Pokébälle einführte. Es scheint, als gäbe es da einen Zusammenhang.
It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
oras: Voltobal wurde zuerst bei einer Firma beobachtet, die Pokébälle herstellt. Der Zusammenhang zwischen dieser Beobachtung und der Tatsache, dass dieses Pokémon wie ein Pokéball aussieht, ist noch ungeklärt.
Voltorb was first sighted at a company that manufactures Poké Balls. The link between that sighting and the fact that this Pokémon looks very similar to a Poké Ball remains a mystery.
lgpe: Man sagt, es tarne sich als Pokéball, um sich zu schützen. Allerdings zerstört es sich schon bei der kleinsten äußeren Einwirkung selbst.
It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
pla: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

rb: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
y: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
gs: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
c: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.
rs: ELECTRODE eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
e: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
frlg: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
dp: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
pt: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
hgss: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
bw: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
b2w2: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
xy: Es explodiert schon bei kleinsten Reizen. Sein Spitzname „Die Bombenkugel“ spiegelt die Furcht der Menschen wider.
It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
oras: Lektrobal ernährt sich von Elektrizität aus der Atmosphäre. An Tagen, an denen es blitzt, explodiert dieses Pokémon dauernd, da es zu viel Elektrizität zu sich nimmt.
Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
lgpe: Es speichert elektrische Energie in seinem Körper. Schon die geringste Erschütterung lässt es explodieren.
Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
pla: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

rb: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
y: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.
gs: The shell is very durable. Even if it cracks, it can survive without spilling the contents.
c: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.
rs: This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.
e: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.
frlg: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.
dp: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
pt: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
hgss: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.
bw: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
b2w2: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
xy: Die sechs Eier kommunizieren telepathisch. Werden sie getrennt, finden sie sich schnell wieder.
Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
oras: Dieses Pokémon besteht aus sechs Eiern, die ein engmaschiges Netz bilden. Die sechs Eier ziehen sich gegenseitig an und drehen sich. Wenn die Eier Risse bekommen, steht Owei kurz vor seiner Entwicklung.
This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, Exeggcute is close to evolution.
sm: Die sechs Eier kommunizieren telepathisch miteinander. Sie tragen das Erbgut von Pflanzen sowie Pokémon eines bestimmten Typs in sich.
Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.
lgpe: Oweis kleine Köpfe ziehen sich gegenseitig an und drehen sich. Es braucht sechs von ihnen, um die Balance zu halten.
The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.
swsh: Owei mag zwar Eiern ähneln, ist aber ein echtes Pokémon, das aus sechs Individuen besteht, die wohl telepathisch miteinander kommunizieren.
Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

rb: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
y: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the 3 heads thinks about whatever it likes.
gs: Its three heads think independent ly. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
c: Living in a good environment makes it grow lots of heads. A head that drops off becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
rs: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form EXEGGCUTE.
e: Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR’s heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.
frlg: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.
dp: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
pt: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
hgss: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
bw: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
b2w2: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
xy: Seine drei Köpfe denken unabhängig voneinander. Dennoch sind sie nett zueinander und streiten nie.
Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
oras: Kokowei stammt ursprünglich aus den Tropen. Seine Köpfe wachsen stetig, wenn es starkem Sonnenlicht ausgesetzt ist. Wenn seine Köpfe abfallen, bilden sie zusammen ein Owei.
Exeggutor originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form Exeggcute.
sm: Jeder seiner Köpfe hat einen eigenen Willen. Sie kommunizieren telepathisch miteinander, um gemeinsam Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Each of its heads has its own will. They use telepathy to discuss their plans before coming to a joint decision.
lgpe: Der Schrei dieses Pokémon ist ohrenbetäubend, weil jeder seiner drei Köpfe sagt, was er denkt.
Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.
swsh: Jeder der drei Köpfe hat einen eigenen Willen und scheint sich nur für sich selbst zu interessieren.
Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

rb: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.
y: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.
gs: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and emits a plain tive and mournful sound.
c: It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its mother's skull, never revealing its true face.
rs: CUBONE pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the Pokémon wears are made by the tears it sheds.
e: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.
frlg: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
dp: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
pt: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
hgss: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.
bw: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
b2w2: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
xy: Es trägt den Schädel seiner verstorbenen Mutter auf seinem Kopf. Fühlt es sich einsam, soll es laut weinen.
It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
oras: Tragosso sehnt sich nach seiner Mutter, die nicht mehr da ist. Wenn es im Vollmond das Ebenbild seiner Mutter erblickt, muss es weinen. Die Flecken auf dem Totenkopf, den es trägt, stammen von vergossenen Tränen.
Cubone pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the Pokémon wears are made by the tears it sheds.
sm: Denkt es an seine verstorbene Mutter, weint es laut. Hört dies ein Grypheldis, nutzt dieses die Gelegenheit, um es aus der Luft anzugreifen.
When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.
lgpe: Es trägt den Schädel seiner Mutter als Maske. Sein Weinen hallt darin wider und wird zu einer traurigen Melodie.
Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.
swsh: Denkt Tragosso an seine verstorbene Mutter, so weint es. Sein Schluchzen hallt dabei in dem Schädel auf seinem Kopf klagend wider.
When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

rb: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
y: Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
gs: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out mes sages to others.
c: Somewhere in the world is a ceme tery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.
rs: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
e: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
frlg: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
dp: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pt: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
hgss: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.
bw: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
b2w2: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
xy: Es ist klein und war ursprünglich sehr schwach. Erst als es anfing Knochen einzusetzen, wurde es wild.
It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
oras: Knogga ist eine entwickelte Form von Tragosso, die den Verlust der Mutter überwunden hat und stärker geworden ist. Die gestählte, abgehärtete Seele dieses Pokémon ist nur schwer zu brechen.
Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
sm: Vor der Entwicklung war es schwach und ängstlich. Jetzt ist es hitzköpfig und schlägt wild mit einem Knochen um sich.
Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
lgpe: Einst war es klein und schwach, doch jetzt ist es geschickt im Umgang mit seinem Knochen und verhält sich äußerst brutal.
Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
swsh: Als es seine Trauer überwand, entwickelte es sich und wurde stärker. Mit seinem Knochen als Waffe stellt sich Knogga mutig seinen Feinden.
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

rb: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
y: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on im pact and destroys its enemy.
gs: This amazing Poké MON has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
c: It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.
rs: HITMONLEE’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
e: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.
frlg: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
dp: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
pt: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
hgss: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
bw: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
b2w2: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
xy: Die Beine ziehen und strecken sich unabhängig voneinander. Mit seinen dehnbaren Beinen kann es einen entfernten Gegner treffen.
The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
oras: Kicklee kann seine Beine ausfahren und einziehen. Es verblüfft seine Gegner mit brutalen Tritten. Nach einem Kampf massiert es seine Beine und lockert die Muskeln, um der Erschöpfung vorzubeugen.
Hitmonlee’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
lgpe: Tritt ein Kicklee zu, wird die Unterseite seines Fußes im Moment des Aufpralls hart wie ein Diamant. So zerschmettert es seinen Gegner.
When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon besitzt einen formidablen Gleichgewichtssinn. Es kann in jeder Position pausenlos zutreten.
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

rb: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
y: Punches in cork screw fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall in the same way as a drill.
gs: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
c: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.
rs: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working towards a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
e: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.
frlg: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.
dp: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
pt: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
hgss: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
bw: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
b2w2: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
xy: Die Schläge, die es austeilt, können Beton pulverisieren. Es muss sich im Kampf alle drei Minuten ausruhen.
The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
oras: Nockchan besitzt das Herz eines Boxers, der sich auf eine Weltmeisterschaft vorbereitet. Dieses Pokémon hat einen unbeugsamen Willen und gibt niemals auf.
Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working toward a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
lgpe: Mit seinen rotierenden Hieben vermag es, sich wie eine Bohrmaschine Stück für Stück durch Betonwände zu bohren.
Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall like a drill.
swsh: Seine Fäuste zerschneiden regelrecht die Luft. Sie sind so schnell, dass selbst die geringste Berührung Verbrennungen verursacht.
Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

rb: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
y: Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
gs: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deft ly manipulated.
c: It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.
rs: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
e: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
frlg: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
dp: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.
pt: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
hgss: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.
bw: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
b2w2: Being licked by its long, saliva-covered tongue leaves a tingling sensation. Extending its tongue retracts its tail.
xy: Seine Zunge ist mit klebrigem Speichel bedeckt, der überall haftet. Dies ist sehr nützlich.
Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
oras: Wenn Schlurp etwas Neues entdeckt, leckt es daran. Es merkt sich Gegenstände anhand der Struktur und des Geschmacks. Saure Sachen schrecken es eher ab.
Whenever Lickitung comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
sm: Mit seiner langen Zunge leckt es an allem, um es zu prüfen. Lässt man eine abgeleckte Stelle unbehandelt, entwickelt sich ein Ausschlag.
It checks out whatever’s around it by licking everything. If you don’t clean off a spot where it’s licked you, you’ll break out in a rash!
lgpe: Schlurps Zunge ist bis zu zwei Meter lang. Es kann sie geschickter bewegen als seine Vorderbeine und andere damit paralysieren.
Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
swsh: Wäscht man sich nach der Berührung mit seinem klebrigen Speichel nicht, setzt bald ein starker Juckreiz ein, der nicht mehr zu stoppen ist.
If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.
pla: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

rb: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
y: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
gs: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
c: If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.
rs: If KOFFING becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This Pokémon may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
e: Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.
frlg: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
dp: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
pt: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
hgss: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
bw: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
b2w2: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.
xy: Sein dünner, ballonartiger Körper ist mit schrecklichem Giftgas gefüllt. Es verbreitet einen heftigen Gestank, wenn es in der Nähe ist.
Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
oras: Wenn Smogon sich aufregt, lässt es das giftige Gas in seinem Inneren entweichen. Wenn es sich zu sehr aufbläht, explodiert dieses Pokémon.
If Koffing becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This Pokémon may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
lgpe: Bei diesem Pokémon ist Vorsicht geboten, da sich die Gase in seinem Innern an warmen Orten ausbreiten und es explodieren lassen.
In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
swsh: Sein Körper ist zum Bersten voll mit Giftgas. Angelockt vom fauligen Geruch verrottender Abfälle, lungert es auf Müllhalden herum.
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

rb: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
y: It lives and grows by absorbing dust, germs and poison gases that are contained in toxic waste and garbage.
gs: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It con stantly mixes its poisonous gases.
c: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.
rs: WEEZING loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This Pokémon will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
e: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
frlg: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.
dp: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
pt: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
hgss: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
bw: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
b2w2: Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.
xy: Pumpt sich eines der zwei Smogon auf, lässt das andere Luft ab. So findet ein Giftgasaustausch statt.
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
oras: Smogmog liebt die Gase verrottender, fauler Küchenabfälle. Dieses Pokémon sucht sich ein vernachlässigtes, schmutziges Gebäude und richtet sich dort häuslich ein. Nachts, wenn die Menschen schlafen, wühlt es im Müll.

Weezing loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This Pokémon will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
lgpe: Smogmog ernährt sich von allerlei Müll, aus dem es Köstlichkeiten wie giftige Gase, Bakterien und Staub absorbiert.
This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
swsh: In seinen beiden Körpern vermischt es Gase. Man sagt, dass es früher überall in der Galar-Region anzutreffen gewesen sei.
It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.

rb: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
y: A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won't stop running until it falls asleep.
gs: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
c: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
rs: RHYHORN runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This Pokémon may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
e: Once it starts running, it doesn’t stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can’t remember why it started running in the first place.
frlg: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.
dp: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
pt: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
hgss: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
bw: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
b2w2: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
xy: Stark, aber nicht allzu klug, kann dieses Pokémon sogar Hochhäuser mit seinem Tackle-Angriff zum Einsturz bringen.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
oras: Rihorn läuft immer geradeaus und zerstampft alles, was ihm in die Quere kommt. Es macht ihm auch nichts aus, wenn es mit dem Kopf voran gegen einen Stahlklotz rennt. Am nächsten Tag allerdings könnte es Schmerzen haben.

Rhyhorn runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This Pokémon may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
lgpe: Rihorn ist sehr einfach gestrickt und kann nur eingleisig denken. Stürmt es einmal los, hört es erst auf zu laufen, wenn es ermattet einschläft.
A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon ist zwar nicht besonders klug, aber dafür so stark, dass es durch Rammen sogar Hochhäuser zum Einsturz bringen kann.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
pla: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

rb: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
y: Walks on its hind legs. Shows signs of intelligence. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
gs: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
c: By lightly spin ning its drill- like horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.
rs: RHYDON’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This Pokémon’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
e: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.
frlg: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
dp: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
pt: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
hgss: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
bw: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
b2w2: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
