xy: Durch seine panzerähnliche Körperhülle kann es in bis zu 2 000 °C heißer Lava leben.
Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
oras: Mit seinem Horn kann Rizeros selbst Diamanten zerbrechen. Ein einziger Hieb mit seinem Schweif kann ein Haus zum Einsturz bringen. Die Haut dieses Pokémon ist so hart, dass nicht einmal Kanonenkugeln Kratzer hinterlassen.
Rhydon’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This Pokémon’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
lgpe: Es hat gelernt, auf seinen Hinterbeinen zu laufen und komplex zu denken. Seine Haut gleicht einer Rüstung und widersteht sogar heißer Lava.
Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
swsh: Nach seiner Entwicklung geht es aufrecht auf seinen Hinterbeinen. Mit seinem Horn kann es Löcher in Felsen bohren.
It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
pla: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

rb: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
y: A gentle and kind hearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.
gs: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
c: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.
rs: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
e: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
frlg: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.
dp: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
pt: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
hgss: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
bw: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
b2w2: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
xy: Man sagt, es bringe Glück. Es ist sehr mitfühlend und teilt seine Eier mit Verletzten.
It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
oras: Chaneira legt täglich ausgesprochen nahrhafte Eier. Sie sind so köstlich, dass sie sogar von Menschen verspeist werden, die gar keinen Appetit haben.
Chansey lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
sm: Die Eier, die es legt, sind ausgesprochen nahrhaft. Sie sind die Leibspeise vieler Pokémon.
The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.
lgpe: Chaneira ist sehr warmherzig und freundlich. Es kümmert sich liebevoll um verletzte Lebewesen, indem es seine nahrhaften Eier mit ihnen teilt.
A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.
swsh: Seine Eier sind äußerst nahrhaft und schmecken köstlich, weshalb sie als erlesene Kochzutat gelten.
The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It’s used as a high-class cooking ingredient.
pla: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

rb: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
y: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick, blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
gs: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively un nerve its foes.
c: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.
rs: TANGELA’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
e: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.
frlg: Blue plant vines cloak the Pokémon’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.
dp: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
pt: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
hgss: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.
bw: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
b2w2: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
xy: Aufgrund der Ranken, die seinen Körper bedecken, kennt keiner seine wahre Form. Die blauen Ranken wachsen immer weiter.
Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
oras: Wenn man Tangelas Ranken berührt, fallen diese sofort ab. Das tut ihm aber nicht weh und es kann sich schnell in Sicherheit bringen. Verliert es Ranken, werden diese am nächsten Tag durch neue ersetzt.
Tangela’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
lgpe: Sein Körper liegt unter dichten, blauen Ranken verborgen, die niemals aufhören zu wachsen.
Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
swsh: Seine wahre Gestalt ist weiterhin ein Mysterium, da sie von Ranken verdeckt wird, die unaufhörlich nachwachsen, selbst wenn sie abreißen.
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.
pla: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

rb: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
y: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.
gs: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
c: To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.
rs: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokémon’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
e: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.
frlg: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.
dp: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
pt: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
hgss: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
bw: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
b2w2: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
xy: Sein Nachwuchs wächst in seinem Beutel heran. Nur wenn es sicher ist, darf das Junge aus dem Beutel.
It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
oras: Wenn du auf ein junges, spielendes Kangama stößt, solltest du es nicht stören oder versuchen, es einzufangen. Die Mutter dieses Baby-Pokémon ist bestimmt in Reichweite und könnte sehr wütend auf dich werden.

If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokémon’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
sm: Die Mutterliebe des ausgewachsenen Kangama ist tief. Es wäre sogar bereit, sein eigenes Leben zu opfern, um sein Junges zu beschützen.
Kangaskhan’s maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
lgpe: Es zieht sein Junges in seiner Bauchtasche auf. Um es zu schützen, nimmt es mit jedem Gegner den Kampf auf.
Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.
swsh: Obwohl es sein Junges im Beutel trägt, bewegt sich dieses Pokémon äußerst leichtfüßig. Gegner schreckt Kangama mit blitzschnellen Schlägen ab.
Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

rb: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
y: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.
gs: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.
c: When they're in a safe location, they can be seen playfully tangling their tails together.
rs: HORSEA eats small insects and moss off of rocks. If the ocean current turns fast, this Pokémon anchors itself by wrapping its tail around rocks or coral to prevent being washed away.
e: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.
frlg: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
dp: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
pt: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
hgss: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its well-developed dorsal fin.
bw: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
b2w2: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
xy: Dieses Pokémon schießt mit Tinte auf über der Wasseroberfläche fliegende Insekten.
Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
oras: Seeper ernährt sich von kleinen Insekten und dem Moos auf Steinen. Bei unruhiger See verankert sich dieses Pokémon mit seinem Schweif an Steinen oder Korallen, damit es nicht weggespült wird.
Horsea eats small insects and moss off of rocks. If the ocean current turns fast, this Pokémon anchors itself by wrapping its tail around rocks or coral to prevent being washed away.
lgpe: Wenn Seeper sich in Gefahr wähnt, sprüht es zur Verteidigung entweder Wasser oder eine spezielle Tinte kraftvoll aus seinem Mund.
If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.
swsh: Es lebt in Meeren mit ruhigem Gezeitenstrom. Wird es angegriffen, versprüht es tiefschwarze Tinte und ergreift daraufhin die Flucht.
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

rb: Capable of swim ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
y: Touching the back fin causes numb ness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.
gs: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
c: The male raises the young. If it is approached, it uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.
rs: SEADRA sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this Pokémon’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.
e: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.
frlg: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
dp: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
pt: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
hgss: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
bw: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
b2w2: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.
xy: Sein Körper ist mit scharfen Stacheln gespickt. Wenn man sorglos ist und es berührt, kann man durch die Stacheln bewusstlos werden.
Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
oras: Sobald sich Seemon um eine Koralle gewickelt hat, schläft es. Von Zeit zu Zeit werden Menschen durch die Widerhaken dieses Pokémon verletzt, wenn sie versuchen, Korallen zu ernten und es dabei nicht bemerken.
Seadra sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this Pokémon’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.
lgpe: Eine Berührung seiner Rückenflossen betäubt. Es klammert sich mit dem Schwanz an Korallen fest, um sich im Schlaf vor der Strömung zu schützen.
Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.
swsh: Männlichen Seemon obliegt es, den Nachwuchs großzuziehen. In diesem Zeitraum ist das Gift in ihren Rückenstacheln stärker und dickflüssiger.
It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

rb: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
y: When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.
gs: Its dorsal, pecto ral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
c: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.
rs: GOLDEEN is a very beautiful Pokémon with fins that billow elegantly in water. However, don’t let your guard down around this Pokémon - it could ram you powerfully with its horn.
e: In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.
frlg: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
dp: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.
pt: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
hgss: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
bw: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
b2w2: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
xy: Es schwimmt mit fünf Knoten. Wird es angegriffen, wehrt es sich mit seinem scharfen Horn.
It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.
oras: Goldini ist ein wunderschönes Pokémon, dessen Flossen sich elegant im Wasser wiegen. Aber man muss auf dieses Pokémon achtgeben. Es könnte einen sonst heftig mit seinem Horn rammen.
Goldeen is a very beautiful Pokémon with fins that billow elegantly in water. However, don’t let your guard down around this Pokémon—it could ram you powerfully with its horn.
sm: Wenn es warm wird, bilden sie Schwärme und schwimmen stromaufwärts. Dies ist ein Zeichen dafür, dass der Frühling herannaht.
When the weather grows warm, they form groups and swim upriver. This sight serves as a poetic reminder that spring has arrived.
lgpe: Während der Laichzeit kann man Schwärme von Goldini dabei beobachten, wie sie gegen den Strom von Flüssen und Wasserfällen schwimmen.
When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.
swsh: Seine Brust-, Rücken- und Schwanzflossen bewegen sich anmutig. Daher nennt man es den „Wassertänzer“.
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

rb: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power fully up rivers and creeks.
y: It is the male's job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.
gs: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, coloring the rivers a brilliant red.
c: When autumn comes, the males patrol the area around their nests in order to protect their offspring.
rs: In the autumn, SEAKING males can be seen performing courtship dances in riverbeds to woo females. During this season, this Pokémon’s body coloration is at its most beautiful.
e: It punches holes in boulders on stream beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.
frlg: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.
dp: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.
pt: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
hgss: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, causing rivers to appear a brilliant red.
bw: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
b2w2: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
xy: Im Herbst, zur Paarungszeit, sieht man diese Pokémon kraftvoll Bäche und Flüsse hinaufschwimmen.
In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.
oras: Im Herbst kann man männliche Golking dabei beobachten, wie sie Balztänze in Flussbetten aufführen, um die weiblichen Exemplare zu beeindrucken. Während dieser Zeit ist die Farbe dieser Pokémon am schönsten.
In the autumn, Seaking males can be seen performing courtship dances in riverbeds to woo females. During this season, this Pokémon’s body coloration is at its most beautiful.
sm: Wenn es kälter wird, färbt sich sein ganzer Körper tiefrot. Dieser Anblick versetzt die Leute in Herbststimmung.
When the weather grows cold, its whole body flushes a deep red. This sight serves as a poetic reminder that autumn has arrived.
lgpe: Männliche Exemplare dieses Pokémon höhlen mit dem Horn an ihrem Kopf Steine im Flussbett aus, um sich so ein Nest zu bauen.
It is the male’s job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.
swsh: Im Herbst legt es an Gewicht zu und erscheint in prächtigen Farben, um so einen Partner anzulocken.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

rb: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
y: As long as the center section is unharmed, it can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.
gs: At night, the cen ter of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
c: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.
rs: STARYU’s center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these Pokémon look like the stars in the sky.
e: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.
frlg: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.
dp: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
pt: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
hgss: At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
bw: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
b2w2: As long as its red core remains, it can regenerate its body instantly, even if it’s torn apart.
xy: Auch wenn sein Körper nicht mehr intakt ist, kann es sich regenerieren, wenn der Kern leuchtet.
Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
oras: In Sterndus Körpermitte befindet sich ein hellrot leuchtendes Organ – sein Kern. Wenn du im Spätsommer an einen Strand gehst, sehen die leuchtenden Kerne dieser Pokémon aus wie Sterne.
Staryu’s center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these Pokémon look like the stars in the sky.
sm: Es taucht in großer Zahl an Ufern auf. Nachts erstrahlt der Kern in seiner Mitte in einem unheimlichen Rot.
Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.
lgpe: Selbst wenn es zerstückelt wird, kann es seinen Körper immer wieder regenerieren, solange sein Kernstück unversehrt bleibt.
As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.
swsh: Bei spätsommerlichen Strandbesuchen kann man Gruppen von Sterndu begegnen, deren Kerne in gleichmäßigem Rhythmus aufblinken.
If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

rb: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
y: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in 7 colors.
gs: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a dif ferent color each time it is seen.
c: It is said that it uses the seven- colored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.
rs: STARMIE’s center section - the core - glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
e: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.
frlg: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
dp: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
pt: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
hgss: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.
bw: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
b2w2: Its core shines in many colors and sends radio signals into space to communicate with something.
xy: Der Kern dieses Pokémon leuchtet in den Farben des Regenbogens. Sein Kern gilt als Edelstein.
Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
oras: Starmies Mittelteil, sein Kern, leuchtet in sieben Farben. Aufgrund dieser Eigenschaft wird es auch „Juwel des Meeres“ genannt.
Starmie’s center section—the core—glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
sm: Offenbar sendet und empfängt sein leuchtender Kern mysteriöse Radiowellen. Kommt man ihm zu nahe, löst es eventuell Kopfschmerzen aus.
Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.
lgpe: Den Mittelteil seines Körpers nennt man „Kern“. Man sagt, es würde damit kommunizieren, wenn dieser in den Regenbogenfarben leuchtet.
The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.
swsh: Das als Kern bezeichnete Organ dieses Pokémon erstrahlt in den sieben Farben des Regenbogens, wenn Starmie mächtige Psycho-Kräfte entfesselt.
This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

rb: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
y: Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.
gs: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisi ble objects as it matures.
c: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.
rs: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once it is believed, it will exist as if it were a real thing.
e: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.
frlg: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.
dp: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
pt: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
hgss: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.
bw: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
b2w2: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
xy: Seine Fingerspitzen sondern etwas ab, das die Luft zu einer schützenden Wand werden lässt.
Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.
oras: Pantimos ist ein Meister der Pantomime. Seine Gesten und Bewegungen machen den Zuschauer glauben, dass etwas Unsichtbares tatsächlich existiert. Wenn ein Objekt für real gehalten wird, beginnt es, wirklich zu existieren.
Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.
sm: Sein Können als Pantomime ist verblüffend. Vor lauter Bewunderung merkt man gar nicht, wie plötzlich eine echte Wand vor einem erscheint.
Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
lgpe: Pantimos ist begabt im Mienenspiel und trainiert dieses jederzeit. Es kann andere dazu verleiten, Dinge zu sehen, die gar nicht existieren.
Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.
swsh: Viele Forscher glauben, seine Hände hätten nur deshalb so eine beachtliche Größe angenommen, damit es Pantomime praktizieren kann.
The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
pla: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

rb: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
y: Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The move ment looks like that of a ninja.
gs: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
c: It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.
rs: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This Pokémon’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
e: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
frlg: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
dp: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
pt: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
hgss: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
bw: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
b2w2: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
xy: Es zerreißt und zerkleinert seine Beute mit seinen unglaublich scharfen Sicheln. Selten breitet es seine Flügel aus, um zu fliegen.
It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
oras: Sichlor ist unheimlich schnell. Dadurch werden die beiden Sensen an seinen Unterarmen noch effektiver. Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinen Sensen in Sekundenschnelle Baumstämme zerteilen.

Scyther is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This Pokémon’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
sm: Seine schnellen, Ninja-artigen Reflexe irritieren seine Beute. Findet es eine Lücke in ihrer Defensive, schlitzt es sie mit seinen Sicheln auf.
It confuses its prey with its quick, ninja-like movements. Then, in an instant, it cleaves them with its scythes.
lgpe: Sichlor gleicht einem Ninja, wenn es plötzlich aus dem hohen Gras springt und mit seinen scharfen, sichelförmigen Armen angreift.
Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.
swsh: Mit jedem Kampf werden seine Sicheln schärfer. Es kann selbst einen massiven Baumstamm mit nur einem Schnitt zerteilen.
As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.
pla: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

rb: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
y: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.
gs: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depend ing on how it is feeling.
c: It has several different cry pat terns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.
rs: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
e: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.
frlg: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.
dp: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
pt: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
hgss: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.
bw: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
b2w2: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
xy: Der beschwingte Gang dieses Pokémon bezaubert Zuschauer und lässt sie im Takt dazu tanzen.
It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
oras: Rossana bewegt sich rhythmisch fort. Es wiegt und schwingt seine Hüften, als würde es tanzen. Seine Bewegungen wirken so anziehend auf Menschen, dass diese beginnen, mit den Hüften zu schwingen, ohne darüber nachzudenken.

Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
sm: Es bewegt seine Hüften in einem eigentümlichen Rhythmus. Rossana in Alola beherrschen einen besonders anmutigen Hüftschwung.
It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.
lgpe: Es scheint sich mit einem besonderen Rhythmus zu bewegen. Beim Laufen schwingt es die Hüften und sieht so aus, als würde es tanzen.
Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.
swsh: In einer bestimmten Gegend von Galar wurde Rossana einst als „Königin des Eises“ gleichermaßen gefürchtet wie verehrt.
In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

rb: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
y: If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this Pokémon has eaten electricity at a power plant.
gs: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its en tire body glows a whitish-blue.
c: When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the electric currents to communicate their feelings.
rs: When a storm arrives, gangs of this Pokémon compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
e: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
frlg: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
dp: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
pt: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
hgss: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.
bw: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
b2w2: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.
xy: Elektrizität bedeckt seinen Körper. Im Dunkeln erstrahlt es in einem bläulichen Ton.
Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish blue.
oras: Bei Gewitter entbrennt unter Elektek ein Wettstreit um höher gelegene Orte, an denen ein Blitzeinschlag wahrscheinlich ist. Einige Ortschaften benutzen diese Pokémon anstelle von Blitzableitern.
When a storm arrives, gangs of this Pokémon compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.
sm: Für die Hälfte aller plötzlichen Stromausfälle sind Elektek verantwortlich. Sie belagern gerne Kraftwerke und zapfen ihnen Strom ab.
Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.
lgpe: Größere Stromausfälle sind fast immer darauf zurückzuführen, dass ein Elektek den Strom eines Kraftwerks einfach gefressen hat.
If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this Pokémon has eaten electricity at a power plant.
swsh: In vielen Elektrizitätswerken werden Pokémon vom Typ Boden eingesetzt, um Elektek davon abzuhalten, den dortigen Strom anzuzapfen.
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
pla: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

rb: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
y: Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.
gs: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suit able for itself.
c: It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal itself by dipping its wound into lava.
rs: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
e: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.
frlg: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
dp: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.
pt: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
hgss: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.
bw: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
b2w2: The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar forms heat waves around its body, making it hard to see the Pokémon clearly.
xy: Es wurde in der Nähe eines Vulkans gefunden. Die Körpertemperatur dieses Feuerspuckers liegt bei fast 1 200 °C.
Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
oras: Im Kampf stößt Magmar glühend heiße Flammen aus, um seinen Gegner einzuschüchtern. Diese Feuersalven erzeugen Hitzewellen, die das Gras und die Bäume der Umgebung in Brand setzen.
In battle, Magmar blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
sm: Wenn es erschöpft ist, springt es in einen Vulkankrater und entspannt sich in der Lava. Sein brennender Körper ist 1 200 °C heiß.
When it’s tired, it leaps into the mouth of a volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.
lgpe: Magmar werden in Vulkankratern geboren. Sie sehen aus wie Feuerbälle, da ihr ganzer Körper in Flammen gehüllt ist.
Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.
swsh: Magmar erlegt seine Beute mit Feuer. Manchmal röstet es diese zu seinem Bedauern so stark, dass sie versehentlich verkohlt.
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
pla: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

rb: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
y: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold, so it lives in warm places.
gs: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
c: When the tempera ture drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.
rs: PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokémon’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
e: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
frlg: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.
dp: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
pt: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
hgss: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
bw: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
b2w2: It grips prey with its powerful pincers and will not let go until the prey is torn in half.
xy: Es hält seine Beute mit seiner Zange fest und teilt sie dann. Was es nicht teilen kann, wirft es fort.
It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
oras: Pinsir ist erstaunlich stark. Es kann einen Feind, der doppelt so viel wiegt wie es selbst, mit seinen Hörnern packen und hochheben. Bei niedrigen Temperaturen werden die Bewegungen dieses Pokémon schwerfällig.
Pinsir is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokémon’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
sm: Es nimmt Gegner mit seinen langen Hörnern in die Zange und reißt sie damit entzwei. Es ist sehr stark, aber es verabscheut Kälte.
It grips its prey in its pincers and splits them apart. Although it is a powerful Pokémon, it can’t deal with the cold.
lgpe: Pinsir nimmt Gegner mit seinen Hörnern in die Zange und drückt kräftig zu. Es lebt an warmen Orten, da es bei niedrigen Temperaturen erstarrt.
Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in warm places.
swsh: Der Status eines Pinsirs hängt von seinen Hörnern ab. Je dicker und stattlicher diese sind, desto beliebter ist es beim anderen Geschlecht.
These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

rb: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
y: A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won't stop until it hits something.
gs: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its bat tle-scarred horns.
c: These violent Pokémon fight with other mem bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.
rs: This Pokémon is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
e: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
frlg: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.
dp: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
pt: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
hgss: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.
bw: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
b2w2: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
xy: Es kämpft mit vollem Einsatz, nachdem es sich mit seinen drei Schweifen auspeitschte, um sich anzustacheln.
After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.
oras: Dieses Pokémon ist nur zufrieden, wenn es kämpfen kann. Wenn Tauros keinen Gegner findet, sucht es sich robuste Bäume und haut sie um, um sich abzureagieren.
This Pokémon is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
sm: Schon seit vielen Jahren reiten Menschen überall auf der Welt auf Tauros. Diese Tradition hat angeblich in Alola ihren Ursprung genommen.
Historically, people in areas all over the world have ridden Tauros, but the practice is said to have started in Alola.
lgpe: Es ist ungestüm und strotzt nur so vor Kraft. Wenn es erst einmal losprescht, rennt es so lange weiter, bis es mit etwas zusammenstößt.
A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.
swsh: Peitscht es seinen Körper mit seinen Schweifen aus, ist Vorsicht geboten, denn es steht kurz davor, mit Karacho auf sein Ziel loszustürmen.
When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

rb: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
y: Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers and shallow puddles.
gs: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.
c: This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
rs: MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a Pokémon that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
e: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.
frlg: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
dp: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.
pt: A MAGIKARP living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
hgss: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.
bw: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
b2w2: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
xy: Es ist nutzlos, was Kraft und Geschwindigkeit angeht. Dieses ist das schwächste und erbärmlichste Pokémon der Welt.
It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
oras: Karpador ist ein armseliges Pokémon, das nur platschen kann. Sein merkwürdiges Verhalten hat so manchen Wissenschaftler zum Forschen angeregt.
Magikarp is a pathetic excuse for a Pokémon that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
sm: Es ist schwach und unzuverlässig, aber es vermehrt sich unglaublich schnell. Deshalb trifft man es auch öfter an, als einem lieb ist.
Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you’ll soon grow tired of seeing them.
lgpe: Karpador ist für seine Nutzlosigkeit bekannt. Ob Meer, Fluss, See oder Pfütze, es schwimmt durch die verschiedensten Gewässer.
Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers, and shallow puddles.
swsh: Es ist nutzlos, was Kraft und Geschwindigkeit angeht. Dieses Pokémon ist das schwächste und erbärmlichste der Welt.
It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
pla: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

rb: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
y: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
gs: They say that during past wars, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
c: It appears when ever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through.
rs: When MAGIKARP evolves into GYARADOS, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this Pokémon’s wildly violent nature.
e: It is an extremely vicious and violent Pokémon. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.
frlg: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
dp: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.
pt: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
hgss: They say that during past strife, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
bw: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
b2w2: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
xy: In alten Schriften wird von einem Garados berichtet, das in einem Wutanfall ein Dorf zerstörte.
In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.
oras: Wenn sich Karpador zu Garados entwickelt, durchlaufen seine Gehirnzellen eine strukturelle Veränderung, was wohl der Grund für die zügellose, gewalttätige Natur dieses Pokémon ist.
When Magikarp evolves into Gyarados, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this Pokémon’s wildly violent nature.
sm: Es heißt, es habe eine ganze Stadt, deren Bewohner es verärgert hatten, über Nacht vollständig in Schutt und Asche gelegt.
A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.
lgpe: Garados ist brutal und zerstörungswütig. Es hat Aufzeichnungen zufolge in alten Zeiten ganze Städte in Schutt und Asche gelegt.
Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
swsh: Es ist von Natur aus sehr aggressiv. Der Hyperstrahl, den es aus seinem Maul verschießt, äschert seine Gegner ein.
It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
pla: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

rb: A Pokémon that has been over hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
y: A gentle soul that can read the minds of people. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
gs: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their num ber has dwindled.
c: This gentle Pokémon loves to give people rides and provides a ve ry comfortable way to get around.
rs: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
e: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
frlg: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.
dp: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
pt: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
hgss: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.
bw: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
b2w2: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.
xy: Sie sind gutmütig. Da sie selten kämpfen, wurden sie oft gefangen. Ihre Anzahl ist stark reduziert.
They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.
oras: Die Menschen sind dafür verantwortlich, dass Lapras fast ausgestorben wäre. Abends singt es traurige Klagelieder, da nur noch wenige seiner Artgenossen übrig sind.
People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
sm: Aufgrund seiner hohen Intelligenz kann es die menschliche Sprache verstehen. Ist es gut gelaunt, singt es mit wunderschöner Stimme.
Its high intelligence enables it to comprehend human speech. When it’s in a good mood, it sings in its beautiful voice.
lgpe: Dieses freundliche Pokémon besitzt ein sanftes Gemüt und versteht die Sprache der Menschen. Auf seinem Rücken trägt es sie über das Meer.
A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
swsh: Ein intelligentes und herzensgutes Pokémon. Während es auf dem Meer schwimmt, lässt es seinen herrlichen Gesang erklingen.
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

rb: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
y: When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost perfect copy of its oppo nent.
gs: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.
c: When it encount ers another DITTO, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
rs: DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this Pokémon manages to get details wrong.
e: A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.
frlg: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.
dp: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
pt: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
hgss: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.
bw: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
b2w2: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
xy: Es kann seine Zellstruktur so verändern, dass es sich in alles verwandeln kann, was es sieht.
It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
oras: Ditto verändert seine Zellstruktur, um sich in eine andere Form zu verwandeln. Wenn es sich dabei jedoch auf sein Gedächtnis verlässt, unterlaufen diesem Pokémon schon mal Fehler.
Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this Pokémon manages to get details wrong.
sm: Es verändert seine Zellstruktur, um die Gestalt anderer Lebewesen, die es sieht, anzunehmen. Wie gut das Ebenbild ist, variiert nach Exemplar.
It can reorganize its cells to make itself into a duplicate of anything it sees. The quality of the duplicate depends on the individual.
lgpe: Wenn es einen Gegner ausmacht, verwandelt es seinen Körper in eine nahezu perfekte Kopie seines Gegenübers.
When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.
swsh: Es modifiziert seine Zellstruktur, um sich in alles zu verwandeln, was es sieht. Im entspannten Zustand nimmt es wieder seine Ausgangsform an.
It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

rb: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
y: Its genetic code is unstable, so it could evolve in a variety of ways. There are only a few alive.
gs: It has the ability to alter the com position of its body to suit its surrounding envi ronment.
c: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
rs: EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various STONES causes this Pokémon to evolve.
e: An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this Pokémon to evolve.
frlg: An extremely rare Pokémon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
dp: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
pt: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
hgss: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
bw: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
b2w2: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
xy: Ein seltenes Pokémon, das sich seiner Umgebung anpasst, indem es sich in unterschiedliche Formen entwickelt.
A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
oras: Evolis genetisches Erbmaterial ist so instabil, dass die Umgebung plötzliche Mutationen auslösen kann. Unter anderem führt die Wirkung verschiedener Steine zur Entwicklung dieses Pokémon.
Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.
sm: Sein instabiles Erbmaterial ermöglicht es ihm, sich zu verschiedenen Pokémon zu entwickeln.
Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.
lgpe: Es kann sich auf verschiedene Weise entwickeln. Evolis genetischer Code ist der Schlüssel für das Geheimnis der Entwicklung von Pokémon.
It can evolve into a variety of forms. Eevee’s genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.
swsh: Es ist imstande, seinen Körper perfekt an die jeweilige Umgebung anzupassen.
It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
pla: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

rb: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
y: Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It will melt away and become invis ible in water.
gs: When VAPOREON's fins begin to vi brate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
c: As it uses the fins on the tip of its tail to swim, it blends with the water perfectly.
rs: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow it to live underwater. This Pokémon has the ability to freely control water.
e: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.
frlg: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.
dp: It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.
pt: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.
hgss: When VAPOREON’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
bw: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.
b2w2: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.
xy: Es liebt schöne Ufer. Da seine Zellstruktur Wassermolekülen ähnlich ist, kann es mit Wasser verschmelzen.
It prefers beautiful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.
oras: Aquana hat eine spontane Mutation durchgemacht und ihm sind Flossen und Kiemen gewachsen. Dadurch kann es unter Wasser leben. Dieses Pokémon kann Wasser nach Belieben manipulieren.
Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow it to live underwater. This Pokémon has the ability to freely control water.
sm: Seine Zellstruktur ist der von Wassermolekülen ähnlich. Es lebt in der Nähe von Ufern, daher wird es oft mit einer Meerjungfrau verwechselt.
Its cells are composed of units much like water molecules. It lives close to water and is often mistaken for a mermaid.
lgpe: Seine Zellstruktur ähnelt der molekularen Zusammensetzung von Wasser. Daher wird es im Wasser unsichtbar.
Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It melts into the water and becomes invisible.
swsh: Wenn seine Flossen beginnen zu vibrieren, ist das ein sicheres Zeichen dafür, dass in den nächsten Stunden Regen aufziehen wird.
When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
pla: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

rb: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
y: A sensitive Poké MON that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.
gs: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
c: The negatively charged ions generated in its fur create a constant sparking noise.
rs: JOLTEON’s cells generate a low level of electricity. This power is amplified by the static electricity of its fur, enabling the Pokémon to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
e: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur’s static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
frlg: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
dp: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the fur on its body as if it were sharp needles.
pt: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.
hgss: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
bw: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.
b2w2: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.
xy: Lädt es sich mit Elektrizität auf, steht jedes einzelne seiner Körperhaare steil nach oben.
Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.
oras: Blitzas Zellen erzeugen schwache Elektrizität. Diese wird aber durch die statische Aufladung seines Fells verstärkt, sodass es Blitzschläge erzeugen kann. Sein Fell besteht aus elektrisch geladenen Nadeln.

Jolteon’s cells generate a low level of electricity. This power is amplified by the static electricity of its fur, enabling the Pokémon to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
sm: Es feuert Blitze von 10 000 V Stärke aus seinem Mund ab. Es ist sehr nervös, daher haben es Trainer schwer, seine Zuneigung zu gewinnen.
They send out electrical charges of about 10,000 volts. Because they are high-strung, it can be difficult to grow close to them.
lgpe: Schon geringste Reize lösen bei Blitza Wut oder Trauer aus. Wenn seine Gefühlslage umschlägt, baut sich stets Elektrizität auf.
A sensitive Pokémon that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.
swsh: Wenn es erschrickt oder wütend wird, stellt sich sein Fell auf wie scharfe Nadeln und sticht den Gegner.
If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
pla: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

rb: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
y: It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then blows out fire that is over 3,000F degrees.
gs: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees.
c: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1700 degrees.
rs: FLAREON’s fluffy fur has a functional purpose - it releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. This Pokémon’s body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
e: FLAREON’s fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
frlg: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
dp: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.
pt: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
hgss: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
bw: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
b2w2: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.
xy: In seinem Körper befindet sich eine Flamme. Seine Körpertemperatur liegt vor dem Kampf bei 900 °C.
It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.
oras: Flamaras flauschiges Fell dient einem besonderen Zweck. Es gibt Hitze an die Luft ab, damit sein Körper nicht zu heiß wird. Die Körpertemperatur dieses Pokémon kann bis auf 900 °C ansteigen.

Flareon’s fluffy fur has a functional purpose—it releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. This Pokémon’s body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.
sm: Hat es Beeren oder Pokémon erbeutet, speit es so lange Feuer, bis beides gut durchgebraten ist. Danach beißt es beherzt zu.
When it catches prey or finds berries, it breathes fire on them until they’re well done, and then it gobbles them up.
lgpe: In seinem Körper befindet sich ein Flammensack. Dort wandelt es Luft in 1 700 ºC heiße Flammen um, die es über den Mund ausspeit.
It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then breathes out fire that is over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
swsh: Wenn die Flamme in seinem Körper heiß genug brennt, kann seine Körpertemperatur bis zu 900 ºC erreichen.
Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon’s body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
pla: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

rb: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
y: The only Pokémon people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.
gs: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.
c: An artificial Pokémon created due to extensive research, it can perform only what is in its program.
rs: PORYGON is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data and entering cyberspace. This Pokémon is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated by copying.
e: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A PORYGON is copy- protected so it cannot be duplicated.
frlg: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.
dp: The world’s first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.
pt: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
hgss: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.
bw: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
b2w2: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
xy: Ein künstlich produziertes Pokémon, welches das Ergebnis von Forschungen ist. Es ist simpel aufgebaut.
A man-made Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.
oras: Porygon ist in der Lage, sich in Daten zurückzuverwandeln und in den Cyberspace zu gelangen. Dieses Pokémon ist kopiergeschützt, sodass es durch Kopieren nicht vervielfältigt werden kann.
Porygon is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data and entering cyberspace. This Pokémon is copy protected so it cannot be duplicated by copying.
sm: Dieses Pokémon wurde vor 20 Jahren künstlich erschaffen. Damals stellte es das Nonplusultra der technischen Möglichkeiten dar.
Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.
lgpe: Porygon ist das einzige Pokémon, von dem man sich erhofft, dass es ins Weltall fliegen kann. Bislang ist dies aber keinem Exemplar gelungen.
The only Pokémon that people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.
swsh: Es ist weltweit das erste künstliche Pokémon, das dank neuester Technologien mittels Computerprogrammen erschaffen wurde.
State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.
pla: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

rb: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
y: An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swims by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.
gs: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.
c: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.
rs: OMANYTE is one of the ancient and long- since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.
e: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.
frlg: A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.
dp: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
pt: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
hgss: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.
bw: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
b2w2: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
xy: Ein prähistorisches Pokémon, das zur Urzeit im Wasser lebte. Es schwimmt, indem es seine zehn Tentakel bewegt.
A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.
oras: Amonitas ist ein Pokémon, das lange Zeit ausgestorben war, aber von den Menschen aus Fossilien reproduziert wurde. Wenn es von einem Feind angegriffen wird, zieht es sich in sein hartes Gehäuse zurück.
Omanyte is one of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.
sm: Es lebte im urzeitlichen Meer. Bissspuren auf seinen Fossilien deuten darauf hin, dass es damals von Aeropteryx gejagt wurde.
Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.
lgpe: Es wurde aus einem Fossil zurückverwandelt. In der Urzeit schwamm es durch geschicktes Bewegen seiner zehn Tentakel durch das Meer.
An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swam by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.
swsh: Diese Pokémon entwickeln sich allmählich zu einem Problem, da einige wiederbelebte Exemplare fliehen oder freigelassen werden.
Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

rb: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
y: Sharp beaks ring its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.
gs: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.
c: Its heavy shell allowed it to reach only nearby food. This could be the reason it is extinct.
rs: OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.
e: An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.
frlg: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.
dp: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
pt: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
hgss: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER’s shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.
bw: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
b2w2: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
xy: Seine Tentakel sind hoch entwickelt und es setzt sie ähnlich Händen und Füßen ein. Sobald es Beute ergriffen hat, beißt es zu.
Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.
oras: Amoroso benutzt seine Tentakel, um Beute einzufangen. Man nimmt an, dass es ausgestorben ist, weil seine Schale zu groß und zu schwer geworden war, sodass seine Bewegungen immer langsamer und schwerfälliger wurden.
Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.
sm: Diesem prähistorischen Pokémon wurde wohl das Gewicht seines Gehäuses zum Verhängnis. Es ist ein ferner Vorfahre von Octillery.
Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It’s apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.
lgpe: Es verfügt über sehr scharfe Zähne. Offenbar starb es aus, weil seine Schale zu groß war und es sich daher nicht frei bewegen konnte.
Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.
swsh: Es starb wohl aus, weil seine Bewegungen durch das große, schwere Gehäuse so langsam wurden, dass es keine Beute mehr fangen konnte.
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

rb: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
y: A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It uses the eyes on its back while hiding on the sea floor.
gs: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
c: Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.
rs: KABUTO is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokémon has not changed at all for 300 million years.
e: It is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.
frlg: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.
dp: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
pt: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
hgss: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
bw: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
b2w2: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
xy: Man geht davon aus, dass dieses Pokémon vor 300 Millionen Jahren die Strände bevölkerte.
It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
oras: Kabuto ist ein Pokémon, das aus einem Fossil reproduziert wurde. Höchst selten wurden lebende Exemplare dieser Art entdeckt. Dieses Pokémon hat sich seit 300 Millionen Jahren überhaupt nicht verändert.
Kabuto is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokémon has not changed at all for 300 million years.
sm: Kabuto erlebte seine Blütezeit vor 300 Millionen Jahren. Doch in einer bestimmten Region gibt es angeblich noch einige lebende Exemplare.
This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It’s said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.
lgpe: Es wurde aus einem Fossil zurückverwandelt. Aus Verstecken am Meeresboden spähte es mit den Augen auf seinem Rücken die Gegend aus.
A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon ist so gut wie ausgestorben. Sein Panzer wird immer härter, indem es sich alle drei Tage häutet.
This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

rb: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
y: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.
gs: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
c: It was able to swim quickly thro ugh the water by compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.
rs: KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokémon was apparently evolving from being a water-dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.
e: KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.
frlg: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.
dp: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
pt: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
hgss: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
bw: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
b2w2: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
xy: Im Wasser zieht es seine Beine an und bewegt seinen Panzer, um so schneller schwimmen zu können.
In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
oras: Vor langer Zeit jagte Kabutops unter Wasser nach Beute. Es hat sich von einem Meeresbewohner zu einem Landbewohner entwickelt, was man an den Veränderungen seiner Kiemen und Beine sehen kann.

Kabutops swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokémon was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.
sm: Dieses Pokémon hatte begonnen, sich an das Leben an Land anzupassen, starb aber aus, bevor es den Wandel vollziehen konnte.
Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn’t adapt in time and went extinct.
