lgpe: Sein dünner Körper ließ es rasant schwimmen. Offenbar schlitzte es seine Beute mit seinen Sicheln auf und saugte ihr die Körpersäfte aus.
A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.
swsh: Kabutops schlitzt seine Beute auf und saugt ihre Körpersäfte aus. Die Überreste dienen als Nahrung für andere Pokémon.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

rb: A ferocious, pre historic Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
y: A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
gs: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
c: In prehistoric times, this Pokémon flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.
rs: AERODACTYL is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
e: AERODACTYL is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.
frlg: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.
dp: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
pt: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
hgss: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
bw: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
b2w2: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
xy: In Bernstein eingeschlossenes genetisches Material eines Dinosauriers war der Ursprung dieses Pokémon. Beim Fliegen schreit es schrill.
It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.
oras: Aerodactyl ist ein Pokémon aus dem Zeitalter der Dinosaurier. Es wurde aus genetischem Material reproduziert, das aus Bernstein gewonnen wurde. Man geht davon aus, dass es in grauer Vorzeit der König der Lüfte war.
Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
sm: Es stammt aus dem Zeitalter der Dinosaurier. Mit seinen Zähnen, die Sägeblättern gleichen, zerreißt es seine Beute, bevor es sie frisst.
A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.
lgpe: Dieses wilde Pokémon aus der Urzeit wurde mithilfe von in Bernstein eingeschlossenem Genmaterial wieder zum Leben erweckt.
A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
swsh: Selbst mit moderner Technologie scheint es unmöglich, ein perfektes Exemplar von diesem wilden urzeitlichen Pokémon zu reproduzieren.
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

rb: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
y: Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.
gs: What sounds like its cry may ac tually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
c: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.
rs: SNORLAX’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
e: SNORLAX’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.
frlg: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
dp: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.
pt: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
hgss: What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
bw: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
b2w2: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
xy: Es ist erst satt, wenn es über 400 kg Nahrung am Tag gefressen hat. Ist es mit dem Essen fertig, schläft es sofort ein.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
oras: Der typische Tagesablauf von Relaxo besteht lediglich aus Essen und Schlafen. Es ist so zutraulich, dass Kinder seinen dicken Bauch als Platz zum Spielen nutzen.
Snorlax’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
sm: Es heißt, sein Magen sei an Widerstandsfähigkeit nicht zu übertreffen. Für Relaxo ist selbst das Gift eines Sleimok nicht mehr als ein Würzstoff.
Its stomach is said to be incomparably strong. Even Muk’s poison is nothing more than a hint of spice on Snorlax’s tongue.
lgpe: Relaxo verschlingt sogar Nahrung, auf der sich etwas Schimmel gebildet hat. Trotzdem verdirbt es sich nie den Magen.
Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.
swsh: Es muss über 400 kg Nahrung am Tag fressen, um satt zu werden. Ist es mit dem Essen fertig, schläft es sofort ein.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
pla: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

rb: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
y: A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
gs: The magnificent, seemingly translu cent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.
c: Legendary bird Pokémon. As it flies through the sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.
rs: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
e: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
frlg: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.
dp: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
pt: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
hgss: The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.
bw: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
b2w2: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
xy: Ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon. Es kann Blizzards verursachen, indem es Feuchtigkeit gefriert.
A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
oras: Arktos ist ein sagenumwobenes Vogel-Pokémon, das Eis manipulieren kann. Das Schlagen seiner Flügel bringt die Luft zum Gefrieren. Es wird behauptet, dass es zu schneien beginnt, wenn dieses Pokémon fliegt.
Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
lgpe: Ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon, das im Winter die Wasserpartikel in der Luft gefrieren lässt, um Schnee zu erzeugen.
A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
swsh: Seine wunderschönen blauen Flügel sollen aus Eis bestehen. Es fliegt über schneebedeckte Berge, während sein langer Schweif hinter ihm flattert.
It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

rb: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
y: This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
gs: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glit tering wings.
c: Legendary bird Pokémon. They say lightning caused by the flapping of its wings causes summer storms.
rs: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The Pokémon gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
e: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
frlg: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.
dp: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
pt: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
hgss: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.
bw: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
b2w2: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
xy: Ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon, das im Sturzflug aus den Wolken bricht und Blitze schleudert.
A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
oras: Zapdos ist ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon, das die Fähigkeit besitzt, Elektrizität zu manipulieren. Es lebt in Gewitterwolken. Dieses Pokémon nimmt Energie auf, wenn es vom Blitz getroffen wird.
Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The Pokémon gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
lgpe: Dieses Legendäre Vogel-Pokémon erscheint, wenn sich der Himmel verdunkelt und Blitze unablässig herunterdonnern.
This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
swsh: Zapdos kann Elektrizität manipulieren. Überlieferungen nach soll sein Nest inmitten pechschwarzer Gewitterwolken liegen.
This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

rb: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
y: A legendary bird Pokémon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
gs: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
c: Legendary bird Pokémon. It is said to migrate from the south along with the spring.
rs: MOLTRES is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
e: MOLTRES is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
frlg: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.
dp: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
pt: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
hgss: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
bw: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
b2w2: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
xy: Dieses Pokémon ist der Legendäre Feuervogel. Sein Flügelschlag entfacht ein helles Feuermeer.
It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.
oras: Lavados ist ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon, das Feuer manipulieren kann. Wenn es verletzt wird, taucht es seinen Körper in das Magma eines Vulkans, um sich zu verbrennen und selbst zu heilen.
Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
lgpe: Wenn dieses Legendäre Vogel-Pokémon mit seinen lodernden Flügeln schlägt, erstrahlt sogar der Nachthimmel in gleißendem Rot.
A legendary bird Pokémon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
swsh: Schlägt dieses Legendäre Vogel-Pokémon mit den Flügeln, so leuchten die Flammen an seinen Schwingen in einem bezaubernden Rot.
It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

rb: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
y: The existence of this mythical Pokémon was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
gs: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
c: It sheds many lay ers of skin as it grows larger. Dur ing this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
rs: DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
e: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
frlg: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.
dp: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
pt: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
hgss: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
bw: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
b2w2: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
xy: Man nennt es „Illusion-Pokémon“, denn nur wenige haben es gesehen. Nur seine Haut wurde oft gefunden.
It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
oras: Dratini häutet sich ständig und entledigt sich so seiner Haut, da die Lebensenergie in seinem Körper stetig und unkontrollierbar ansteigt.
Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
sm: Sein Wachstum wird durch wiederholtes Häuten unterstützt. Gerbt man seine abgestreifte Haut, kann man daraus hochwertige Stiefel schustern.
It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.
lgpe: Die Existenz dieses mythischen Pokémon wurde erst kürzlich bestätigt, als es von einem Angler an Land gezogen wurde.
Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
swsh: Dratini lebt in der Nähe reißender Gewässer, wie etwa in tiefen Becken unter Wasserfällen. Es wächst, indem es sich immer wieder häutet.
Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

rb: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
y: According to a witness, its body was surrounded by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.
gs: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
c: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.
rs: DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter weather conditions in its vicinity by discharging energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
e: A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
frlg: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.
dp: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
pt: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
hgss: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
bw: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
b2w2: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
xy: Die kristallenen Bälle an seinem Schweif ermöglichen es ihm, das Wetter zu beeinflussen.
Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.
oras: Dragonir speichert eine enorme Menge an Energie in seinem Körper. Es kann die Witterung in seiner Umgebung ändern, indem es Energie aus den Kristallen an seinem Hals und an seinem Schweif entlädt.
Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter weather conditions in its vicinity by discharging energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
sm: Es heißt, es könne mit den kristallenen Bällen an seinem Schweif das Wetter beeinflussen.
It has long been thought that its crystalline orbs are imbued with the power to control the weather.
lgpe: Augenzeugenberichten zufolge wird Dragonirs Körper von einer seltsamen Aura umgeben, die ihm eine mysteriöse Ausstrahlung verleiht.

hgss: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
bw: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
b2w2: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
xy: Sein Sehvermögen ist hervorragend. Selbst bei schwachem Licht kann es jedes Detail erkennen.
Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
oras: Dank seines hervorragenden Sehvermögens, mit dem es auch bei geringer Beleuchtung sehen kann, und dank seiner geschmeidigen Flügel, mit denen es geräuschlos fliegt, entgeht Noctuh keine Beute.

Noctowl never fails at catching prey in darkness. This Pokémon owes its success to its superior vision that allows it to see in minimal light, and to its soft, supple wings that make no sound in flight.
sm: Dank seines perfekten Sehvermögens entgeht ihm selbst in der Dunkelheit keine Beute. Man nennt es auch den „Herrscher der Nacht“.
With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it “the emperor of dark nights.”
swsh: Seine Augen sind so gut entwickelt, dass es selbst in fast kompletter Dunkelheit so klar sehen kann, als wäre es Tag.
Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

gs: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
c: It is timid and clusters together with others. The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.
rs: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This Pokémon conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
e: LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
frlg: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
dp: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
pt: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
hgss: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
bw: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
b2w2: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
xy: Wird es kalt, versammeln sich viele Ledyba von nah und fern, um sich gegenseitig Wärme zu schenken.
When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
oras: Ledyba sondert eine duftende Flüssigkeit ab. Über diese kommuniziert es mit anderen. Dieses Pokémon übermittelt seine Gefühle, indem es die Duftnote des Sekrets verändert.
Ledyba secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This Pokémon conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
sm: Es ist scheu und fürchtet sich, wenn es nicht Teil des Schwarms ist. Das Muster auf seinem Rücken ist bei jedem Exemplar minimal anders.
They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

gs: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
c: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.
rs: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live LEDIAN in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this - the Pokémon uses the light of the stars as its energy.
e: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.
frlg: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.
dp: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
pt: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
hgss: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
bw: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
b2w2: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
xy: Leuchten die Sterne am Nachthimmel, schwirrt es umher und verstreut einen strahlenden, leuchtenden Puder.
When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
oras: In Ländern mit frischer Luft und Sternen am Himmel leben unzählig viele Ledian. Dafür gibt es einen guten Grund: Dieses Pokémon nutzt das Licht der Sterne als Energie.
It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live Ledian in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this—the Pokémon uses the light of the stars as its energy.
sm: Es heißt, es ziehe seine Energie aus dem Licht der Sterne, aber es frisst trotzdem mit Wonne Beeren. Tagsüber schläft es im Gras.
While it’s believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

gs: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
c: If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.
rs: The web spun by SPINARAK can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this Pokémon can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
e: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.
frlg: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
dp: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
pt: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
hgss: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
bw: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
b2w2: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
xy: Es spinnt ein Netz aus feinem, aber reißfestem Faden. Dann wartet es auf Beute, die im Netz zappelt.
It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
oras: Das von Webarak gesponnene Netz ist sein zweites Nervensystem. Dieses Pokémon kann anhand der feinen Vibrationen der Netzfäden bestimmen, welche Art Beute sich darauf befindet.

The web spun by Spinarak can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this Pokémon can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
sm: Ein sehr geduldiges Pokémon, das besonders gern Wommel frisst. Es wartet beharrlich darauf, dass sich welche in seinem Netz verfangen.
It waits intently until its preferred prey, Cutiefly, gets caught in its web. In fact, it’s quite a patient Pokémon.

gs: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
c: Rather than mak ing a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls.
rs: ARIADOS’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This Pokémon constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
e: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
frlg: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.
dp: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
pt: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
hgss: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
bw: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
b2w2: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
xy: Da es Fäden sowohl mit dem Hinterleib als auch mit dem Mund spinnt, verwechselt man die beiden leicht.
It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
oras: Ariados hat kleine hakenförmige Krallen an seinen Füßen. Damit kann es an Decken und Wänden entlangflitzen. Dieses Pokémon schnürt seine Gegner mit einem starken, dünnen Seidenfaden ein.
Ariados’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This Pokémon constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
sm: Man schätzt die Fäden von Ariados aufgrund ihrer Stärke. Vielerorts werden sie zum Weben verwendet.
There are some areas where people use the string Ariados spins for their own weaving. The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.

gs: It flies so si lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
c: As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.
rs: If this Pokémon is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that CROBAT has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
e: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
frlg: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.
dp: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
pt: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
hgss: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
bw: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
b2w2: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
xy: Mit seinen vier Flügeln fliegt es so geräuschlos durch die Nacht, dass man es nicht bemerkt.
It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
oras: Wenn Iksbat fliegt, indem es entweder das vordere oder das hintere Paar Flügel bewegt, ist dies ein Anzeichen dafür, dass dieses Pokémon bereits eine lange Strecke hinter sich hat. Dann wechselt es die Flügel häufig.
If this Pokémon is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that Crobat has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
sm: Es kann sich nur schwer am Boden fortbewegen, da aus seinen zwei Beinen Flügel geworden sind. Daher ist es nur zu Kriechbewegungen fähig.
Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can’t move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.
swsh: Seine zwei Beine wurden zu Flügeln. Es fliegt schnell und lautlos zu seiner Beute, um ihr dann die Zähne in den Nacken zu bohren.
Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.
pla: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

gs: It shoots positive and negative elec tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
c: Its antennae, whi ch evolved from a fin, have both po sitive and neg ative charges flo wing through them.
rs: CHINCHOU lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This Pokémon flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
e: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight’s reach.
frlg: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
dp: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
pt: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
hgss: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
bw: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
b2w2: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
xy: Am Meeresgrund kann es sich nur durch ständiges Flackern seiner Lichter der Umgebung kundtun.
On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
oras: Lampi gibt positive und negative elektrische Ladungen durch seine Antennen ab, um seine Beute zu lähmen. Dieses Pokémon lässt seine Lichter aufflackern und tauscht Signale mit seinen Artgenossen aus.
Chinchou lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This Pokémon flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
sm: Seine zwei Antennen waren ursprünglich Flossen. Es greift seine Beute an, indem es sie mit Strom lähmt.
Its two antennae were originally fins. It discharges electricity to stun its prey before attacking.
swsh: Seine Antennen haben sich aus Flossen entwickelt und sind sowohl positiv als auch negativ geladen.
Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

gs: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
c: This Pokémon uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.
rs: LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This Pokémon produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
e: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.
frlg: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
dp: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
pt: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
hgss: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
bw: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
b2w2: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
xy: Lanturns Licht kann aus großen Tiefen heraufscheinen. Man nennt es auch „Tiefseestern“.
Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
oras: Lanturn wird auch „Tiefseestern“ genannt, da es eine leuchtende Antenne besitzt. Dieses Pokémon erzeugt Licht, indem es in der Antenne eine chemische Reaktion zwischen Bakterien und seinen Körperflüssigkeiten erzeugt.
Lanturn is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This Pokémon produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
sm: Blickt man nachts in die Tiefen des Meeres hinab und sieht am Grund ein helles Licht, handelt es sich dabei um ein Lanturn.
Should you peer into the ocean at night and see a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.
swsh: Sein Licht ist so hell, dass es selbst aus 5 000 m Tiefe an die Meeresoberfläche dringt.
The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

gs: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
c: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.
rs: PICHU charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this Pokémon.
e: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
frlg: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
dp: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
pt: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
hgss: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
bw: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
b2w2: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
xy: Sie spielen miteinander, indem sie ihre Schweifspitzen aneinanderhalten und Funken fliegen lassen.
It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.
oras: An Gewittertagen oder Tagen, an denen die Luft sehr trocken ist, kann sich Pichu leichter mit Elektrizität aufladen. Dann kann man das Knistern statischer Aufladung hören.
Pichu charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this Pokémon.
sm: Es ist noch nicht sehr geübt im Umgang mit Elektrizität. Lässt man es kurz aus den Augen, lähmt es sich schon mal versehentlich selbst.
It is not yet skilled at controlling electricity. If you take your eyes off it, it may shock itself.
swsh: Obwohl es so klein ist, kann es genug Elektrizität freisetzen, um sogar einen Erwachsenen zu überwältigen. Tritt dies ein, ist es selbst erstaunt.
Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
pla: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

gs: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
c: If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this Pokémon is certain to be within the immediate area.
rs: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these Pokémon quench their thirst with the morning dew.
e: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.
frlg: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.
dp: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
pt: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
hgss: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
bw: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
b2w2: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.
xy: Aufgrund seiner ungewöhnlichen Sternform sagt man, es sei auf einem Meteor hierhergereist.
Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
oras: In Nächten mit vielen Sternschnuppen kann man Pii im Kreis tanzen sehen. Es tanzt die ganze Nacht hindurch und hört erst bei Sonnenaufgang auf, um seinen Durst mit Morgentau zu stillen.
On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these Pokémon quench their thirst with the morning dew.
sm: Sieht man es tief in der Nacht gebannt das Funkeln von Sternschnuppen beobachten, schwelgt es wohl in Gedanken an seine Heimat.
On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.
swsh: Man erzählt sich, dass überall dort besonders häufig Pii anzutreffen seien, wo einst eine Sternschnuppe eingeschlagen ist.
According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.
pla: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

gs: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
c: Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.
rs: IGGLYBUFF’s vocal chords are not sufficiently developed. It would hurt its throat if it were to sing too much. This Pokémon gargles with freshwater from a clean stream.
e: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.
frlg: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.
dp: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
pt: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
hgss: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
bw: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
b2w2: Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.
xy: Anstatt mit seinen kurzen Beinen zu laufen, hüpft es mit seinem weichen und kuscheligen Körper.
Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.
oras: Fluffeluffs Stimmbänder sind noch nicht voll entwickelt. Wenn es zu viel singt, schmerzt ihm die Kehle. Dieses Pokémon gurgelt mit Süßwasser aus einem sauberen Fluss.
Igglybuff’s vocal cords are not sufficiently developed. It would hurt its throat if it were to sing too much. This Pokémon gargles with freshwater from a clean stream.
sm: Es liebt das Singen, ist aber noch nicht sehr gut darin. Lobt man es regelmäßig, verbessern sich seine Gesangskünste jedoch nach und nach.
It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With praise and encouragement, it will get better little by little.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon singt liebend gern. Von seinem Körper, der an ein Marshmallow erinnert, geht ein leicht süßlicher Duft aus.
Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body gives off a faint sweet smell.

gs: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
c: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.
rs: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
e: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
frlg: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.
dp: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.
pt: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
hgss: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
bw: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
b2w2: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
xy: Seine Schale ist voll von Freude. Es teilt sein Glück, wenn man es freundlich und gut behandelt.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
oras: Togepi nutzt die positiven Emotionen, wie Freude und Mitgefühl, von Menschen und Pokémon als Energie. Dieses Pokémon speichert Glücksgefühle in seiner Schale und teilt sie mit anderen.
As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
swsh: Seine Schale ist voll von Freude. Es heißt, wenn man es freundlich und gut behandelt, teile es sein Glück.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
pla: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

gs: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car ing people and shower them with happiness.
c: Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.
rs: TOGETIC is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
e: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.
frlg: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
dp: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called “joy dust.”
pt: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind hearted people.
hgss: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
bw: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
b2w2: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
xy: Es wird entmutigt, wenn es unter unfreundlichen Menschen ist. Es kann ohne Flügel niedrig schweben.
It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
oras: Togetic ist ein Pokémon, das Glück bringt. Wenn es jemanden trifft, der reinen Herzens ist, zeigt es sich und teilt sein Glück mit dieser Person.
Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
swsh: Man sagt, es zeige sich nur gutherzigen und einfühlsamen Menschen und überschütte sie dann mit Freude.
They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
pla: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

gs: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star ing at something.
c: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
rs: NATU cannot fly because its wings are not yet fully grown. If your eyes meet with this Pokémon’s eyes, it will stare back intently at you. But if you move even slightly, it will hop away to safety.
e: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU’s eyes look as if they are always observing something.
frlg: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.
dp: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
pt: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
hgss: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
bw: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
b2w2: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
xy: Da seine Flügel nicht voll ausgebildet sind, bewegt es sich hüpfend. Es starrt immer etwas an.
Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
oras: Natu kann nicht fliegen, da seine Flügel noch nicht ausgewachsen sind. Wenn du diesem Pokémon in die Augen schaust, starrt es dich konzentriert an. Wenn du dich aber bewegst, hüpft es weg, um sich in Sicherheit zu bringen.
Natu cannot fly because its wings are not yet fully grown. If your eyes meet with this Pokémon’s eyes, it will stare back intently at you. But if you move even slightly, it will hop away to safety.
sm: Natu kann noch nicht fliegen, aber hervorragend springen. So erreicht es selbst hoch liegende Äste, an deren Knospen es dann pickt.
Although it still can’t fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.
swsh: Es ist ein hervorragender Kletterer. Besonders gern steigt es auf Bäume und frisst die jungen Triebe ab.
It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

gs: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
c: Once it begins to meditate at sun rise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.
rs: XATU stands rooted and still in one spot all day long. People believe that this Pokémon does so out of fear of the terrible things it has foreseen in the future.
e: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.
frlg: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.
dp: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
pt: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
hgss: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
bw: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
b2w2: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
xy: Wenn es bei Sonnenaufgang anfängt zu meditieren, vergeht der ganze Tag, ehe es sich wieder bewegt.
Once it begins to meditate at sunrise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.
oras: Xatu bleibt den ganzen Tag an ein und demselben Ort wie angewurzelt stehen. Die Menschen glauben, dass es dies aus Angst vor den Dingen tut, die es für die Zukunft vorausgesehen hat.
Xatu stands rooted and still in one spot all day long. People believe that this Pokémon does so out of fear of the terrible things it has foreseen in the future.
sm: Dieses Pokémon kann zwar angeblich die Zukunft voraussehen, aber seine Kräfte reichen nicht aus, um diese auch zu ändern.
It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.
swsh: Man sagt, es sei so still und in sich gekehrt, weil es die Zukunft und die Vergangenheit parallel sieht.
They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

gs: If static elec tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
c: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
rs: MAREEP’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail grows.
e: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
frlg: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
dp: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
pt: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
hgss: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
bw: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
b2w2: When cold weather increases static electricity, its wool doubles in size and the tip of its tail glows slightly.
xy: Sein weiches Fell wird doppelt so dick, wenn sich Elektrizität aufbaut.
Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
oras: Voltilamms flauschiges, wollenes Fell erzeugt Reibung und statische Aufladung. Je höher die elektrische Ladung wird, desto heller leuchtet die Glühbirne an seinem Schweif.
Mareep’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
sm: Kleidung aus Voltilamms Wolle erfordert eine spezielle Verarbeitung, da sie ansonsten zu elektrostatischer Aufladung neigt.
Clothing made from Mareep’s fleece is easily charged with static electricity, so a special process is used on it.

gs: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
c: Because of its rubbery, electric ity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electric ity in its fur.
rs: FLAAFFY’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
e: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
frlg: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
dp: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
pt: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
hgss: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.
bw: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
b2w2: Not even downy wool will grow on its rubbery, nonconductive patches of skin that prevent electrical shock.
xy: Sein flauschiges Fell speichert Elektrizität. Seine Gummihaut schützt es vor Stromstößen.
Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
oras: Die Qualität von Waatys Wolle verändert sich, sodass es mit nur wenig Wolle eine große statische Aufladung erzeugen kann. Die kahlen Stellen in seinem Fell sind gegen Elektrizität abgeschirmt.
Flaaffy’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
sm: Die unbehaarten Stellen seiner gummiartigen Haut leiten keinen Strom weiter. Dort kann man es daher ohne Gefahr anfassen.
In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.

gs: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
c: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.
rs: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.
e: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
frlg: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.
dp: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
pt: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
hgss: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
bw: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
b2w2: The tip of its tail shines so brightly it can be used to send sea-navigation beacons to distant foreign shores.
xy: Seine Schweifspitze ist so hell, dass viele Verschollene es als Orientierungspunkt nutzen.
The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
oras: Ampharos strahlt so viel Licht aus, dass es sogar aus dem Weltraum noch gesehen werden kann. In der Antike benutzten die Menschen das Licht dieses Pokémon dazu, Signale über weite Entfernungen auszutauschen.
Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.
sm: Das Licht seiner Schweifspitze kann man selbst aus dem Weltall noch sehen. Um seinen Standort zu verbergen, macht es sein Licht zumeist aus.
The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.

gs: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
c: When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.
rs: When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This Pokémon’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.
e: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
frlg: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
dp: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
pt: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
hgss: BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
bw: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
b2w2: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
xy: Blubella kommen zusammen, um zu tanzen. Man sagt, dieser Tanz sei ein Ritual, um der Sonne zu huldigen.
Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
oras: Wenn Blubella starkem Sonnenlicht ausgesetzt ist, beginnen sich die Blätter an seinem Körper zu drehen. Der Tanz dieses Pokémon ist in südlichen Ländern sehr bekannt.
When Bellossom gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This Pokémon’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.
sm: In Alola erstrahlt Blubella in einer besonders herrlichen Blütenpracht. Sein Tanz ist hier besonders graziös.
swsh: Es lebt in den Tropen. Beim Tanzen reiben seine Blüten aneinander und erzeugen ein wohliges Geräusch.
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

gs: The tip of its tail, which con tains oil that is lighter than wa ter, lets it swim without drowning.
c: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
rs: MARILL’s oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water’s surface, it’s a sure indication that this Pokémon is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
e: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water’s resistance.
frlg: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.
dp: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.
pt: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.
hgss: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.
bw: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.
b2w2: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.
xy: Sein Fell ist von Natur aus wasserabweisend. Es bleibt trocken, auch wenn es im Wasser spielt.
The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
oras: Marills Schweif ist mit Öl gefüllt und dient ihm als eine Art Rettungsring. Wenn nur sein Schweif an der Wasseroberfläche zu sehen ist, taucht dieses Pokémon gerade, um sich von Wasserpflanzen zu ernähren.

Marill’s oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water’s surface, it’s a sure indication that this Pokémon is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
swsh: Marills runde Schweifspitze dient ihm als eine Art Schwimmring. Sie ist mit Nährstoffen gefüllt, die in Fett umgewandelt wurden.
This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.

gs: By keeping still and listening in tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
c: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.
rs: AZUMARILL’s long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
e: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.
frlg: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.
dp: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
pt: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
hgss: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.
bw: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
b2w2: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.
xy: Seine langen Ohren sind hervorragende Sensoren. Mit ihnen kann es Bewegungen im Fluss wahrnehmen.
Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.
oras: Azumarills lange Ohren dienen ihm als unentbehrliche Sensoren. Wenn es sein Gehör fokussiert, kann dieses Pokémon auch in reißenden Flüssen identifizieren, welche Art von Beute sich in seiner Nähe befindet.
Azumarill’s long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
swsh: Es verbringt fast den ganzen Tag im Wasser. Bei schönem Wetter lässt sich Azumarill an der Oberfläche treiben und badet im Sonnenschein.
It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water and sunbathes.

gs: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
c: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
rs: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because the forelegs remain green throughout the year, the Pokémon is easily identified as a fake during the winter.
e: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
frlg: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
dp: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
pt: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
hgss: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
bw: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
b2w2: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
xy: Obwohl es vorgibt, ein Baum zu sein, kommt seine Zusammensetzung einem Stein näher als einer Pflanze.
Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
oras: Mogelbaum tarnt sich als Baum, um Angriffen von Feinden aus dem Weg zu gehen. Da seine Arme aber das ganze Jahr über grün bleiben, fällt seine Tarnung im Winter leicht auf.
Sudowoodo camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because its hands remain green throughout the year, the Pokémon is easily identified as a fake during the winter.
sm: Es tarnt sich als Baum, um Angriffen aus dem Weg zu gehen. Es hasst jedoch Wasser und ergreift die Flucht, wenn man es nass macht.
To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.
swsh: Bewegt ein Baum bei Windstille einen Ast, ist das kein Baum, sondern ein Mogelbaum. An Regentagen hält es sich versteckt.
If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
pla: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

gs: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather ing from far and wide.
c: When it expands its throat to croak out a tune, nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.
rs: The curled hair on POLITOED’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.
e: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
frlg: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
dp: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
pt: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
hgss: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
bw: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
b2w2: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
xy: Sind drei oder mehr von ihnen zusammen, lassen sie einen schallenden Ruf erklingen.
Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
oras: Quaxo hat gelocktes Haar, das ihm den Status eines Königs bescheinigt. Je länger und lockiger sein Haar ist, desto mehr Respekt erntet dieses Pokémon von seinen Artgenossen.
The curled hair on Politoed’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.
sm: In klaren Mondnächten versammeln sie sich und singen im Chor. Ihr Gesang ist zwar nicht schön und klingt eher wie Geschrei, aber er hat Stil.
They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.
swsh: Nachts erscheint Quaxo an Ufern von Teichen. Mit seinem schallenden Ruf beansprucht es sein Revier.
At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

gs: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
c: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.
rs: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, HOPPIP links its leaves with other HOPPIP to prepare against being blown away.
e: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.
frlg: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
dp: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
pt: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
hgss: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.
bw: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
b2w2: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
xy: Sein Körper ist so leicht, dass es seine Füße im Boden verankert, damit es nicht davongeweht wird.
Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
oras: Hoppspross lässt sich vom Wind treiben. Wenn es bemerkt, dass ein Sturm aufkommt, verbindet es seine Blätter mit anderen Hoppspross, damit es nicht davongeweht wird.
This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
sm: Seinen leichten Körper weht selbst eine Brise davon. Es liebt es, sich vom warmen Frühlingswind treiben zu lassen.

gs: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc tuates up and down.
c: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.
rs: SKIPLOOM’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
e: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower’s blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
frlg: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.
dp: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
pt: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
hgss: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
bw: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
b2w2: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
xy: Temperaturschwankungen veranlassen es, die Blüte auf seinem Kopf immer zu öffnen oder zu schließen.
The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
oras: Hubelupfs Blume beginnt zu blühen, wenn die Temperatur über 18 °C steigt. Wie weit sich die Blüte öffnet, hängt von der Höhe der Temperatur ab. Daher wird dieses Pokémon manchmal als Thermometer eingesetzt.

Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
sm: Die Blüte auf seinem Kopf verströmt einen leicht bitteren Geruch, der eine entspannende Wirkung haben soll.

gs: Once it catches the wind, it deft ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
c: Even in the fierc est wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
rs: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
e: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
frlg: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
dp: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
pt: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
hgss: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores-- it can even float around the world.
bw: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
b2w2: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
xy: Es lässt sich von den Winden um den Globus tragen und verteilt auf seinem Flug Baumwollsamen.
Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
oras: Papungha nutzt den Südwind, um das Meer zu überqueren und in ferne Länder zu fliegen. Dieses Pokémon sinkt zu Boden, wenn es während seines Fluges auf kalte Luftschichten stößt.
Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
sm: Die Baumwollsamen, die Papungha verstreut, machen Allergikern das Leben schwer.

gs: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
c: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.
rs: AIPOM’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokémon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.
e: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM’s real hands have become rather clumsy.
frlg: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.
dp: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
pt: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
hgss: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
bw: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
b2w2: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
xy: Es lebt in den Kronen großer Bäume. Es hüpft von Ast zu Ast und balanciert mit seinem Schweif.
It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.
oras: An Griffels Schweif befindet sich ein handähnliches Anhängsel, mit dem es geschickt zu Werke gehen kann. Da dieses Pokémon sehr häufig seinen Schweif einsetzt, wirken seine Hände eher plump.
Aipom’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokémon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.
sm: Der übermäßige Einsatz seines Schweifes hatte die Zurückbildung seiner Hände zur Folge. Es lebt in den Kronen hoher Bäume.
As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.
pla: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

gs: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
c: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.
rs: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
e: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
frlg: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
dp: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
pt: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
hgss: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
bw: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
b2w2: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.
xy: Manchmal fällt es plötzlich vom Himmel. Wird es von Habitak angegriffen, schüttelt es seine Blätter.
It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.
oras: Sonnkern versucht, sich so wenig wie möglich zu bewegen, um alle gespeicherten Nährstoffe für seine Entwicklung aufzusparen. Außer Morgentau nimmt es nichts weiter zu sich.

Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

gs: It converts sun light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
c: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.
rs: SUNFLORA converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
e: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.
frlg: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.
dp: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
pt: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
hgss: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
bw: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
b2w2: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.
xy: Steht der Sommer bevor, werden die Blätter um das Gesicht dieses Pokémon aktiv und lebhaft.
As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon’s face become more vivid and lively.
oras: Sonnflora verwandelt Solarenergie in Nährstoffe. Tagsüber, wenn es warm ist, ist es sehr aktiv. Wenn aber die Sonne untergegangen ist, hört es auf, sich zu bewegen.
Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

gs: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win dows in the area.
c: It can see in all directions without moving its big eyes, helping it spot attackers and food right away.
rs: YANMA is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
e: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.
frlg: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.
dp: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
pt: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.
hgss: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
bw: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.
b2w2: By flapping its wings at high speed, it can fly freely through the air. Even sudden stops are no problem.
xy: Mit seinen Augen hat es einen Blickwinkel von 360 Grad. Es sieht sogar Beute, die sich hinter ihm befindet.
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
oras: Yanma hat einen Blickwinkel von 360 Grad, ohne die Augen bewegen zu müssen. Es ist ein großartiger Flieger und geübt darin, plötzlich anzuhalten oder Wendemanöver vorzunehmen. So kann es sich blitzschnell auf Beute stürzen.

Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
pla: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

gs: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
c: A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.
