rs: WOOPER usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
e: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.
frlg: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.
dp: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.
pt: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
hgss: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
bw: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
b2w2: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
xy: Dieses Pokémon lebt in Eiswasser. Wird es an Land kalt, verlässt es das Wasser und sucht nach Futter.
This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
oras: Felino lebt eigentlich im Wasser. Manchmal kommt es jedoch an Land, um nach Nahrung zu suchen. An Land bedeckt es seinen Körper mit einem schleimigen Giftfilm.
Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon lebt in kaltem Wasser. Wenn die Temperaturen an Land tief genug fallen, verlässt es das Wasser und sucht dort nach Futter.
This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

gs: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
c: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.
rs: QUAGSIRE hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.
e: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn’t move, it does not get very hungry.
frlg: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.
dp: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
pt: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
hgss: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
bw: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
b2w2: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
xy: Ein träges Pokémon, das auf dem Grund des Flusses liegt und wartet, dass ihm Beute ins Maul schwimmt.
It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
oras: Morlord jagt seine Nahrung, indem es im Wasser sein Maul weit aufmacht und auf unvorsichtige Beute wartet. Da sich dieses Pokémon nicht bewegt, wird es auch nicht besonders hungrig.
Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.
swsh: Es ist sehr unbekümmert und stört sich nicht daran, wenn es während des Schwimmens an Boote oder Felsen stößt.
It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

gs: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene my's actions.
c: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.
rs: ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
e: An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
frlg: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.
dp: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.
pt: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
hgss: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.
bw: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
b2w2: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather...and its foes’ thoughts.
xy: Die Spitze seines geteilten Schweifs bebt, wenn es die nächste Attacke seines Feindes voraussagt.
The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.
oras: Psiana ist jedem Trainer treu, dem es zugetan ist. Dieses Pokémon hat die Fähigkeit der Prophezeiung entwickelt, um seine Trainer vor Unheil zu bewahren.
Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.
sm: Mit seinem feinen, kurzen Fell kann es anhand von Luftbewegungen augenblicklich erkennen, was sein Gegner plant.
It can instantaneously sense its opponent’s movements by feeling air currents with its fine fur.
swsh: Es analysiert Luftströmungen und kann dadurch das Wetter oder die nächste Attacke des Gegners vorhersehen.
By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.
pla: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

gs: When agitated, this Pokémon pro tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
c: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.
rs: UMBREON evolved as a result of exposure to the moon’s waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
e: UMBREON evolved from exposure to the moon’s energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
frlg: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.
dp: The light of the moon changed EEVEE’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
pt: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
hgss: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
bw: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
b2w2: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it’s filled with a mysterious power.
xy: Mondlicht hat die genetische Struktur von Evoli verändert. Im Dunkeln wartet es auf Beute.
The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
oras: Nachtara hat sich dadurch entwickelt, dass es den Mondwellen ausgesetzt war. Es versteckt sich im Schutze der Dunkelheit und wartet darauf, dass sich ein Feind bewegt. Die Ringe an seinem Körper leuchten auf, wenn es angreift.
Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon’s waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
sm: Ist es wütend, feuert es tödlichen Giftschweiß aus all seinen Poren auf die Augen seines Gegners ab.
When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.
swsh: Ist es wütend, feuert es giftigen Schweiß aus all seinen Poren auf die Augen seines Gegners ab.
When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.
pla: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

gs: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
c: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.
rs: MURKROW was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
e: MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.
frlg: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.
dp: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.
pt: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
hgss: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
bw: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
b2w2: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
xy: Es versteckt jeden schimmernden Gegenstand. Kramurx und Mauzi rauben sich gegenseitig die Beute.
It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another’s stashes.
oras: Kramurx wurde als vermeintlicher Überbringer des Unheils verabscheut und gefürchtet. Dieses Pokémon hat ein großes Interesse an allem, was funkelt und glitzert. Es stiehlt auch Ringe von Frauen.
Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
sm: Es wacht bei Dämmerung auf und fliegt durch die Nacht. Daher das Sprichwort: „Flugs nach Haus, mein Kind, wenn Kramurx am Himmel sind!“
They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, “Get home before the Murkrow fly.”
pla: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

gs: It has incredible intellect and in tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
c: Every time it ya wns, SHELLDER injects more poi son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.
rs: SLOWKING undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
e: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
frlg: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.
dp: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
pt: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
hgss: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
bw: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
b2w2: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
xy: Sein feines Gespür und Intellekt zeichnen es aus. Es bleibt in jeder Situation gelassen und besonnen.
It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
oras: Laschoking betreibt jeden Tag Forschung, um die Geheimnisse der Welt zu lüften. Dieses Pokémon vergisst aber alles, was es bereits herausgefunden hat, wenn das Muschas auf seinem Kopf abfällt.
Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.
sm: Durch einen giftigen Biss wurde es zu einer wahren Intelligenzbestie. Es verfügt über Psycho-Kräfte.
A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
swsh: Das Gift von Muschas drang in Flegmons Gehirn ein und erweckte dabei wie durch ein Wunder bisher verborgene Intelligenz in ihm.
Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.

gs: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
c: It loves to watch people it's scar ed. It frightens them by screaming loudly or appear ing suddenly.
rs: MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.
e: A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.
frlg: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
dp: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.
pt: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
hgss: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
bw: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
b2w2: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
xy: Es nährt sich von der Angst anderer Wesen und nimmt diese in roten Kugeln auf. Schläft am Tage.
It gets nourishment from fear that it absorbs into its red orbs. In daytime, it sleeps in darkness.
oras: Traunfugil erschreckt Menschen mit einem markerschütternden Schrei. Dieses Pokémon verwendet seine roten Kraftfelder dazu, die Ängste seiner Feinde aufzunehmen und sie in Nahrung umzuwandeln.
Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.
sm: Es lässt nichts unversucht, um Menschen zu erschrecken und ihnen Lebensenergie abzusaugen. Dafür übt es regelmäßig.
It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.
pla: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

gs: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
c: Because different types of UNOWN exist, it is said that they must have a variety of abilities.
rs: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
e: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.
frlg: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
dp: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
pt: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
hgss: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
bw: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
b2w2: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
xy: Sein flacher, dünner Körper hängt immer an Wänden. Seine Form scheint eine Bedeutung zu haben.
Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
oras: Icognito hat die Form antiker Schriftzeichen. Bis heute ist unklar, was zuerst da war – die antiken Schriftzeichen oder die vielen unterschiedlichen Icognito. Trotz umfangreicher Forschung bleiben Fragen offen.
This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
pla: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

gs: It hates light and shock. If attack ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter strike.
c: In order to con ceal its black tail, it lives in a dark cave and only moves about at night.
rs: If two or more WOBBUFFET meet, they will turn competitive and try to outdo each other’s endurance. However, they may try to see which one can endure the longest without food. TRAINERS need to beware of this habit.
e: Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.
frlg: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
dp: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
pt: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
hgss: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.
bw: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
b2w2: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
xy: Es hasst Licht und Schläge. Wird es angegriffen, pumpt es sich auf, um einen Gegenschlag vorzubereiten.
It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.
oras: Wenn zwei oder mehr Woingenau aufeinandertreffen, versuchen sie, gegenseitig ihre Geduld zu übertreffen. Sie möchten herausfinden, welches Pokémon es am längsten ohne Nahrung aushält. Darauf müssen Trainer achten.

If two or more Wobbuffet meet, they will turn competitive and try to outdo each other’s endurance. However, they may try to see which one can endure the longest without food. Trainers need to beware of this habit.
swsh: Es hasst Licht und Schocks. Wird es angegriffen, pumpt es sich auf, um einen Gegenschlag vorzubereiten.
It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

gs: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
c: When it is in danger, its tail uses some sort of mysterious powers to drive away the enemy.
rs: GIRAFARIG’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.
e: A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.
frlg: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.
dp: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.
pt: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
hgss: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.
bw: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
b2w2: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
xy: Während es schläft, hält sein Schweif Wache. Dieser benötigt keinen Schlaf.
While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn’t need to sleep.
oras: Der Kopf an Girafarigs Hinterteil hat ein eigenes Gehirn. Er reagiert mit Angriffen auf Gerüche und Geräusche. Wenn man sich diesem Pokémon von hinten nähert, könnte der hintere Kopf plötzlich vorschnellen und zubeißen.

Girafarig’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.

gs: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
c: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.
rs: PINECO hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.
e: A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.
frlg: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.
dp: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
pt: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
hgss: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.
bw: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
b2w2: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
xy: Es fügt seiner Schale schichtenweise Baumrinde hinzu. Die zusätzliche Belastung ist ihm gleich.
It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.
oras: Tannza hängt an Ästen und wartet auf Beute. Wenn man dieses Pokémon bei einer Mahlzeit stört, indem man den Baum, auf dem es sich befindet, schüttelt, fällt es herunter und explodiert ohne Vorwarnung.

Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.
sm: Es hängt an Bäumen und wartet regungslos auf seine Beute, Käfer-Pokémon. In Alola ernährt es sich bevorzugt von Wommel.
Motionless, it hangs from trees, waiting for its bug Pokémon prey to come to it. Its favorite in Alola is Cutiefly.

gs: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
c: Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.
rs: FORRETRESS conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
e: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
frlg: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.
dp: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
pt: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
hgss: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.
bw: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
b2w2: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
xy: Dieses Pokémon ist von einer Stahlhülle umgeben. Seine stechenden Augen sind alles, was man von ihm sieht.
It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
oras: Forstellka versteckt sich in seiner stahlharten Schale. Die Schale öffnet sich, wenn es nach Beute schnappt. Dies geht jedoch so schnell, dass man das Innere der Schale nicht zu Gesicht bekommt.
Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
sm: Kommt ihm irgendetwas zu nahe, feuert es Teile seiner stählernen Schale ab. Das geschieht jedoch aus Reflex, nicht aus eigenem Willen.
When something approaches it, it fires off fragments of its steel shell in attack. This is not a conscious action but a conditioned reflex.

gs: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furi ously boring into the ground with its tail.
c: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.
rs: DUNSPARCE has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backwards. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
e: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
frlg: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.
dp: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
pt: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
hgss: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.
bw: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
b2w2: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.
xy: Wird es entdeckt, flüchtet dieses Pokémon, indem es sich mit seinem Schweif in den Boden gräbt.
When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.
oras: Dummisel hat einen Bohrer als Schweif. Diesen benutzt es, um sich rückwärts in den Boden einzugraben. Dieses Pokémon baut seinen Nestkomplex tief unter der Erdoberfläche auf.
Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
sm: Sie bewegen sich fort, indem sie sich durch den Boden graben. Da Dummisel sich mit Digda gut verstehen, teilen sie ihre Tunnel miteinander.
It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another’s tunnels happily.
swsh: Da es kleine Flügel hat, behaupten manche Wissenschaftler, dass es vor langer Zeit fliegen konnte.
This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.

gs: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star tled victim to inject poison.
c: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.
rs: GLIGAR glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
e: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.
frlg: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
dp: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey’s face.
pt: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
hgss: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
bw: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
b2w2: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it’s stunned with surprise.
xy: Es hängt meist an Klippen. Erspäht es Beute, spreizt es seine Flügel und greift diese sofort an.
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
oras: Skorgla segelt lautlos durch die Lüfte. Es verankert sich mithilfe der Krallen an seinen Hinterbeinen und der riesigen Scheren an seinen Vorderbeinen am Gesicht eines Feindes und vergiftet ihn mit seinem Giftstachel.

Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
pla: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

gs: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
c: The many small metal particles that cover this Pokémon's body reflect bright light well.
rs: STEELIX lives even further underground than ONIX. This Pokémon is known to dig towards the earth’s core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
e: STEELIX live even further underground than ONIX. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth’s core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
frlg: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
dp: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
pt: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
hgss: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
bw: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
b2w2: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.
xy: Hoher Druck und hohe Temperaturen haben seinen Körper härter als Stahl werden lassen.
Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
oras: Stahlos lebt noch tiefer unter der Erde als Onix. Dieses Pokémon gräbt immer in Richtung des Erdkerns. Nachweislich hat dieses Pokémon bereits Tiefen von 1 km erreicht.
Steelix lives even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth’s core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
swsh: Es heißt, dass der Körper von Onix so hart wie ein Diamant werde, wenn es mehr als 100 Jahre lebt.
It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
pla: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

gs: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
c: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.
rs: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, SNUBBULL sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
e: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.
frlg: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
dp: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
pt: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
hgss: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
bw: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
b2w2: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
xy: Es ist von Natur aus verspielt. Es tollt mit vielen Frauen herum, da es ihnen zugeneigt ist.
It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
oras: Indem es seine Zähne fletscht und ein furchterregendes Gesicht macht, schlägt Snubbull kleinere Pokémon in die Flucht. Es scheint darüber jedoch etwas traurig zu sein.
By baring its fangs and making a scary face, Snubbull sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
sm: Es macht ein furchterregendes Gesicht, ist aber an sich recht feige. Sein Bemühen, bedrohlich zu wirken, macht es bei vielen beliebt.
Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.

gs: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
c: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
rs: GRANBULL has a particularly well- developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the Pokémon to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.
e: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.
frlg: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.
dp: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
pt: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
hgss: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
bw: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
b2w2: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
xy: Es ist trotz seines Äußeren schüchtern. Wird es wütend, schnappt es mit seinen Fängen zu.
It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
oras: Granbull besitzt einen besonders ausgeprägten Unterkiefer. Wegen seiner schweren Zähne wackelt es mit dem Kopf. Es beißt nur zu, wenn es erschreckt wird.

Granbull has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the Pokémon to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.
sm: Ein ausgeprägter Unterkiefer und schwere Zähne sind seine Waffen. Es beißt nur zu, wenn es verärgert wird.
Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked, it rarely bites.

gs: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
c: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.
rs: QWILFISH sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
e: A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.
frlg: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
dp: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
pt: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
hgss: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
bw: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
b2w2: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
xy: Um seine Giftstacheln abzufeuern, muss es seinen Körper aufpumpen, indem es 10 l trinkt.
To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
oras: Baldorfish saugt Wasser ein, um sich aufzublasen. Dieses Pokémon nutzt den Druck des Wassers dazu, giftige Stacheln aus seinem Körper zu verschießen. Es betrachtet Schwimmen als eine echte Herausforderung.
Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
swsh: Sieht es sich einem größeren Feind gegenüber, schluckt es massenweise Wasser, um seinen Körper aufzublähen und größer zu wirken.
When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent’s size.
pla: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

gs: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
c: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.
rs: SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokémon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
e: A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
frlg: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.
dp: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.
pt: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
hgss: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
bw: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
b2w2: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
xy: Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinen stählernen Scheren jeden harten Gegenstand mühelos zermalmen.
This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets ahold of into bits.
oras: Scherox’ Körper ist hart wie Stahl. Gewöhnliche Angriffe jagen ihm keine Angst ein. Dieses Pokémon schlägt mit den Flügeln, um seine Körpertemperatur zu regulieren.
Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokémon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
sm: Es schlägt mit den Flügeln, um seine Körper- temperatur zu regulieren. So überhitzt und schmilzt sein stählerner Körper im Kampf nicht.
It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.
swsh: Mit einer seiner großen Scheren, die ein Drittel seines Körpergewichts ausmachen, kann es Felsen mit einem einzigen Schlag zermalmen.
Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor’s body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.
pla: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

gs: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
c: The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.
rs: SHUCKLE quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
e: A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
frlg: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
dp: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
pt: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
hgss: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
bw: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
b2w2: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
xy: In seinem topfförmigen Panzer gelagerte Beeren verwandeln sich im Nu zu einem dickflüssigen Saft.
The berries stored in its jar-like shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
oras: Pottrott versteckt sich leise unter Steinen und verbirgt seinen Körper in seiner harten Schale, wenn es gesammelte Beeren zu sich nimmt. Die Beeren vermischen sich mit seinen Körperflüssigkeiten zu einem Saft.
Shuckle quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
swsh: Es sammelt Beeren in seiner Schale. Um sich vor Attacken zu schützen, versteckt es sich unter Steinen und verharrt dort regungslos.
It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

gs: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
c: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.
rs: HERACROSS charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
e: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.
frlg: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.
dp: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.
pt: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
hgss: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
bw: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
b2w2: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.
xy: Dieses kräftige Pokémon rammt sein stolzes Horn unter den Rumpf des Gegners und wirft ihn um.
This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
oras: Skaraborn geht direkt auf seinen Gegner los, rutscht auf ihn zu, um ihn auszuhebeln und mit seinem mächtigen Horn wegzuschleudern. Dieses Pokémon hat genug Kraft, um einen massigen Baum umzustoßen.

Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
sm: Sein mächtiges Horn ist sein ganzer Stolz. Es streitet sich ständig mit Donarion, seinem größten Rivalen in Alola.
It’s proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it’s always fighting with.
swsh: Skaraborn verspeist am liebsten süßen Baumsaft. Mit seinen zwei Antennen nimmt es die Witterung auf, während es den Wald danach absucht.
Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.
pla: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

gs: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
c: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.
rs: SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
e: A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
frlg: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.
dp: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
pt: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
hgss: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
bw: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
b2w2: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.
xy: Es ernährt sich von Eiern, die es aus Nestern stiehlt. Beute greift es mit seinen scharfen Krallen an.
It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
oras: Sniebel klettert an Bäumen hoch, indem es seine hakenförmigen Krallen in die Rinde schlägt. Dieses Pokémon sucht nach unbewachten Nestern und stiehlt die Eier. Davon ernährt es sich.
Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
sm: Dieses Pokémon hat ein durchtriebenes, grausames Wesen. Es sucht nach unbewachten Nestern und stiehlt die Eier.
It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
swsh: In seinen Pfoten stecken scharfe Krallen. Es fährt sie blitzschnell aus, um Gegner zu überraschen.
Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
pla: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

gs: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
c: It always licks honey. Its palm tastes sweet because of all the honey it has absorbed.
rs: This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. TEDDIURSA concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.
e: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.
frlg: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.
dp: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
pt: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
hgss: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
bw: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
b2w2: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
xy: Findet es Honig, leuchtet die Sichel auf seinem Kopf. Es leckt oft seine mit Honig bedeckten Pfoten.
If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
oras: Teddiursa leckt gern seine mit Honig bedeckten Pranken ab. Dieses Pokémon bereitet seinen eigenen Honig zu, indem es die von Bibor gesammelten Früchte und Pollen miteinander vermengt.
This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.
pla: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

gs: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
c: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.
rs: In the forests inhabited by URSARING, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
e: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an URSARING gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.
frlg: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
dp: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
pt: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
hgss: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.
bw: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
b2w2: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
xy: Da es alle Gerüche perfekt unterscheiden kann, findet es sogar Nahrung, die tief im Erdreich ist.
With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
oras: In den von Ursaring bewohnten Wäldern gibt es viele Flüsse und hohe Bäume, in denen es Nahrung findet. Dieses Pokémon läuft täglich durch den Wald, um nach Essbarem zu suchen.
In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
pla: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

gs: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
c: These group to gether in areas that are hotter than normal. If it cools off, its skin hardens.
rs: Molten magma courses throughout SLUGMA’s circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.
e: It is a species of Pokémon that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.
frlg: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
dp: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
pt: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
hgss: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
bw: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
b2w2: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
xy: Es hält sich ständig bei Vulkanen auf und ist stets kriechend auf der Suche nach warmen Aufenthaltsorten.
A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
oras: Durch Schneckmags Kreislaufsystem fließt Magma. Wenn dieses Pokémon erkältet ist, kühlt das Magma aus und erhärtet. Sein Körper wird spröde und es brechen Stücke heraus, sodass es kleiner wird.
Molten magma courses throughout Slugma’s circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.

gs: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
c: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.
rs: MAGCARGO’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile - just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.
e: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned MAGCARGO’s bodies into magma.
frlg: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
dp: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
pt: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
hgss: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
bw: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
b2w2: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
xy: Aus seinem porösen Schneckengehäuse sprudeln Feuerfontänen, die seinen Körper durchfluten.
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
oras: Magcargos Schale ist eigentlich seine Haut, die erhärtet ist, als es auskühlte. Seine Schale ist sehr spröde und zerbrechlich. Schon bei einer leichten Berührung bricht sie auseinander. Dann muss es ein Bad in Magma nehmen.

Magcargo’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

gs: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
c: It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.
rs: SWINUB roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This Pokémon occasionally roots out hot springs.
e: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.
frlg: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.
dp: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.
pt: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
hgss: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
bw: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
b2w2: Rooting the tip of its snout into the ground, it searches for food. Sometimes it even digs up a hot spring.
xy: Auf Nahrungssuche schnüffelt es am Boden entlang. Es entdeckt dabei manchmal auch heiße Quellen.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
oras: Auf Nahrungssuche schnüffelt Quiekel am Boden entlang. Seine Lieblingsspeise ist ein Pilz, der unter verwesendem Gras wächst. Manchmal spürt dieses Pokémon heiße Quellen auf.
Swinub roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This Pokémon occasionally roots out hot springs.
swsh: Auf Nahrungssuche wühlt es sich mit der Nase durch den Erdboden. Manchmal entdeckt es dabei auch heiße Quellen.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
pla: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

gs: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
c: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
rs: PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This Pokémon uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
e: A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
frlg: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
dp: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.
pt: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.
hgss: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
bw: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.
b2w2: With its excellent sense of smell, it’s even able to find mushrooms that are buried under frozen ground.
xy: Trotz kurzer Beine rutscht es auf eisigen Flächen nicht aus, da seine Hufe ihm genügend Halt bieten.
Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
oras: Keifel hat ein dichtes Fell aus langen Haaren. Dadurch ist es gegen eisige Kälte gewappnet. Dieses Pokémon benutzt seine Hauer, um an Nahrung zu gelangen, die unter dem Eis eingeschlossen ist.
Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This Pokémon uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
swsh: Beim Angriff auf einen Gegner stellen sich seine Rückenhaare auf. Es hört außergewöhnlich gut.
If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
pla: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

gs: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
c: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.
rs: CORSOLA’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.
e: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.
frlg: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.
dp: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
pt: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
hgss: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.
bw: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
b2w2: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.
xy: Es häutet sich ständig und wächst. Seine Kopfspitze wurde als Schatz der Schönheit ausgezeichnet.
It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.
oras: Wenn Corasonns Arme Sonnenlicht abbekommen, glitzern sie wunderschön in sieben Farben. Wenn ein Arm abbricht, wächst über Nacht ein neuer nach.
Corsola’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.
sm: Auf seinem Kopf wachsen Korallenarme, die ziemlich leicht abbrechen, allerdings innerhalb von etwa drei Tagen wieder nachwachsen.
Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.
swsh: Die Äste auf seinem Kopf wachsen nach, wenn sie abbrechen. Besonders schöne abgebrochene Äste gelten als Glücksbringer für Geburten.
It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

gs: It has superb ac curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
c: To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.
rs: REMORAID sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this Pokémon travels downstream from rivers.
e: A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.
frlg: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
dp: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.
pt: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.
hgss: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
bw: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.
b2w2: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
xy: Es ist äußerst präzise. Es kann mit seinem Wasserschuss Beute erlegen, die 100 m entfernt ist.
It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
oras: Remoraid saugt Wasser ein und spritzt es unter Einsatz seiner Bauchmuskeln mit Hochdruck wieder heraus. So schießt es fliegende Beute ab. Wenn seine Entwicklung näher rückt, wandert dieses Pokémon flussabwärts.
Remoraid sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this Pokémon travels downstream from rivers.
sm: Es heftet sich an Mantax und ernährt sich von dessen Essensresten. Wird Mantax angegriffen, kämpft es gemeinsam mit ihm.
This Pokémon clings to Mantine and shares in its prosperity. When its Mantine is attacked, Remoraid will fight alongside it!
swsh: Selbst aus 100 m Entfernung treffen die Wassersalven, die es mit seinem Maul abfeuert, ihr Ziel.
The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
pla: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

gs: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
c: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.
rs: OCTILLERY grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This Pokémon tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, OCTILLERY spews ink to escape.
e: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.
frlg: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.
dp: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.
pt: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
hgss: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
bw: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
b2w2: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
xy: Es verkriecht sich gerne in Löchern, von wo aus es Gegner mit Tinte beschießt. Es bevorzugt Felsspalten und Vasen.
It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
oras: Octillery saugt sich mit seinen Tentakeln an einem Feind fest. Dieses Pokémon betäubt seinen Gegner, bevor es ihm den Rest gibt. Wenn ein Feind zu stark ist, speit es Tinte aus und flüchtet.
Octillery grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This Pokémon tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, Octillery spews ink to escape.
sm: Die Tinte, die es während der Flucht ausspeit, vermindert den Geruchssinn und verwirrt selbst Pokémon mit einer guten Nase.
The ink it spits when escaping is special. It contains a substance that dulls the sense of smell, so Pokémon with keen noses get lost.
swsh: Es fühlt sich instinktiv in Löchern am wohlsten und schläft auch am liebsten in solchen, wobei es mitunter die Schlafplätze von anderen einnimmt.
It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
pla: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

gs: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
c: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
rs: DELIBIRD carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of Mt. Everest thanks to one of these Pokémon sharing its food.
e: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.
frlg: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.
dp: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
pt: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
hgss: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by its stored food.
bw: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
b2w2: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.
xy: Im eingerollten Schweif transportiert es Futter, das es mit denen teilt, die sich verlaufen haben.
It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
oras: Botogel sammelt seine Nahrung in seinem Schweif. Es gab einmal einen berühmten Entdecker, der es dank eines Botogels geschafft hat, einen der höchsten Berge der Welt zu besteigen. Es hatte seine Nahrung mit ihm geteilt.
Delibird carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of the world’s highest mountain, thanks to one of these Pokémon sharing its food.
sm: Sie bevorzugen eigentlich kühle Gegenden, aber die Botogel Alolas können bis zu einem gewissen Grad auch heißes Klima ertragen.
Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.
swsh: Es trägt immer Lebensmittel bei sich. Man sagt, dass viele Menschen in Not nur dank seiner Notration überlebt hätten.
It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

gs: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
c: It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.
rs: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This Pokémon is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
e: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
frlg: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.
dp: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of MANTINE swimming as if they are in flight.
pt: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores REMORAID that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
hgss: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
bw: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
b2w2: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.
xy: Schwimmt es schnell genug, kann es über die Wellen springen und bis zu 100 m durch die Lüfte gleiten.
If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.
oras: An schönen Tagen sieht man Schwärme von Mantax elegant über die Wellen des Ozeans springen. Durch Remoraid, die an ihm haften und es begleiten, fühlt sich dieses Pokémon nicht belästigt.
On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This Pokémon is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.
sm: Postkarten und Poster, auf denen Mantax elegant über die Wellen springt, sind beliebte Mitbringsel aus Alola.
Postcards and posters featuring Mantine leaping elegantly above the waves are popular souvenirs of Alola.
swsh: Schwimmt es schnell genug, kann es über die Wellen springen und bis zu 100 m durch die Lüfte gleiten.
If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
pla: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

gs: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
c: The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said that people once used the feathers as swords.
rs: SKARMORY is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
e: A Pokémon that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and knives.
frlg: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
dp: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
pt: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
hgss: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
bw: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
b2w2: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.
xy: Die dornigen Zweige seines Nests bewirken, dass die Flügel seiner Jungen fest und hart werden.
After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
oras: Panzaeron ist komplett in einen harten, schützenden Panzer eingehüllt. Dieses Pokémon fliegt bis zu 300 km/h schnell. Es greift seine Feinde mit seinen messerscharfen Flügeln an.
Skarmory is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
sm: Die im Zuge seines Wachstums abgefallenen Federn sind sehr scharf. Krieger verwendeten sie früher als Schwerter.
Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.
swsh: Seine spitzen Federn sind schärfer als jedes Schwert. Es liefert sich erbitterte Revierkämpfe mit Krarmor.
The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.

gs: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
c: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.
rs: HOUNDOUR hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon’s remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.
e: HOUNDOUR communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon’s remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.
frlg: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.
dp: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.
pt: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
hgss: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
bw: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
b2w2: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
xy: Im Morgengrauen schallt sein ominöses Geheule über das Gebiet, das es für sich beansprucht.
Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.
oras: Hunduster jagen in Gruppen. Sie kommunizieren miteinander über verschiedene Arten von Geheul und treiben ihre Feinde in die Enge. Die Zusammenarbeit dieser Pokémon ist einzigartig.
Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon’s remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.
sm: Es ist auf Zusammenarbeit spezialisiert und folgt den Befehlen seines Trainers aufs Wort.
It cooperates with others skillfully. When it becomes your partner, it’s very loyal to you as its Trainer and will obey your orders.

gs: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
c: The pungent- smelling flame that shoots from its mouth results from toxins burn ing in its body.
rs: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply towards the back serves a leadership role. These Pokémon choose their leader by fighting amongst themselves.
e: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
frlg: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.
dp: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.
pt: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
hgss: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
bw: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
b2w2: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
xy: In alten Zeiten glaubte man, das Heulen dieses Pokémon sei der Ruf des Todes.
Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.
oras: In einer Gruppe von Hundemon ist dasjenige mit den nach hinten gebogenen Hörnern der Anführer. Diese Pokémon bestimmen ihren Anführer durch das Ausfechten von Kämpfen untereinander.
In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokémon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
sm: Es bekämpft seine Gegner mit giftigen Flammen. Erlegte Beute wird im Rudel gerecht aufgeteilt.
They spew flames mixed with poison to finish off their opponents. They divvy up their prey evenly among the members of their pack.

gs: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
c: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.
rs: KINGDRA lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this Pokémon creates spiraling ocean currents.
e: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.
frlg: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.
dp: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
pt: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
hgss: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
bw: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
b2w2: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
xy: Man sagt, es hause in Unterwasserhöhlen. Es kann mächtige Strudel generieren, wenn es gähnt.
It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
oras: Seedraking lebt in den Tiefen des Ozeans, die ansonsten verwaist sind. Lange hat man geglaubt, dass das Gähnen dieses Pokémon Strudel auslöst.
Kingdra lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this Pokémon creates spiraling ocean currents.
swsh: Wenn ein Sturm aufzieht, schwimmt es an die Meeresoberfläche. Stößt es auf ein Dragoran, bricht ein erbitterter Kampf zwischen ihnen aus.
With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

gs: It swings its long snout around play fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan gerous.
c: During the desert ed morning hours, it comes ashore where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.
rs: For its nest, PHANPY digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.
e: PHANPY’s big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.
frlg: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
dp: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
pt: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
hgss: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.
bw: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
b2w2: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
xy: Als Zeichen seiner Zuneigung stupst es dich mit dem Rüssel, was dich aber buchstäblich umwerfen könnte.
As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
oras: Um sich ein Nest zu bauen, gräbt Phanpy am Flussufer ein Loch ins Erdreich. Es markiert die Umgebung seines Nests mithilfe seines Rüssels, damit seine Artgenossen wissen, dass dieses Gebiet vergeben ist.
For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.

gs: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
c: Because this Pokémon's skin is so tough, a normal attack won't even leave a scratch on it.
rs: DONPHAN’s favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can’t stop very easily.
e: A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won’t even leave a scratch.
frlg: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.
dp: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
pt: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
hgss: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
bw: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
b2w2: It attacks by curling up then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
xy: Aufgrund seiner scharfen Stoßzähne und seiner rauen Haut könnte es mit Tackle ein Haus niederreißen.
