It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its Tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
oras: Donphans Lieblingsattacke ist es, als Ball zusammengerollt mit voller Wucht gegen seine Gegner zu krachen. Wenn es erst einmal rollt, ist dieses Pokémon nur schwer aufzuhalten.
Donphan’s favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can’t stop very easily.

gs: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
c: This manmade Pokémon evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprog rammed reactions.
rs: PORYGON2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made Pokémon has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
e: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
frlg: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.
dp: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.
pt: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.
hgss: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.
bw: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.
b2w2: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.
xy: Seine Fähigkeiten wurden verbessert. Es zeigt manchmal sogar Handlungen, die nicht einprogrammiert sind.
Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.
oras: Porygon2 wurde in einem wissenschaftlichen Experiment von Menschen erzeugt. Es verfügt über künstliche Intelligenz, wodurch es selbstständig neue Gesten und Gefühle erlernen kann.
Porygon2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made Pokémon has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
sm: In der Absicht, andere Planeten zu erforschen, verpasste man Porygon ein Upgrade auf dem höchsten Stand der damaligen Technologie.
For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.
swsh: Durch ein Update mit besonderen Daten wurde Porygon zu Porygon2. Es erweitert sein Wissen, indem es selbstständig verschiedene Dinge lernt.
This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.
pla: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

gs: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real ity is distorted.
c: The round balls found on the fallen antlers can be ground into a powder that aids in sleeping.
rs: STANTLER’s magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.
e: STANTLER’s magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction.
frlg: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.
dp: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
pt: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
hgss: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.
bw: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
b2w2: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
xy: Starrt man auf sein Geweih, bekommt man das seltsame Gefühl, in dessen Mitte gezogen zu werden.
Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
oras: Damhirplex hat ein prächtiges Geweih, für das hohe Preise gezahlt werden, da sie als Kunstwerke gelten. Daher wurde dieses Pokémon gejagt und wäre beinahe ausgestorben.
Stantler’s magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.
pla: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

gs: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
c: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its tail is predeter mined for each SMEARGLE.
rs: SMEARGLE marks the boundaries of its territory using a body fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. Over 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.
e: A SMEARGLE marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.
frlg: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.
dp: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
pt: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
hgss: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
bw: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
b2w2: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
xy: Sein Revier markiert es mit seinem pinselartigen Schweif. Es kennt mehr als 5 000 Markierungen.
It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
oras: Farbeagle markiert sein Revier mit einer Flüssigkeit, die aus seiner Schweifspitze austritt. Es wurden über 5 000 unterschiedliche Markierungen entdeckt, die dieses Pokémon hinterlassen hat.
Smeargle marks the boundaries of its territory using a body fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. Over 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.
sm: Farbeagle markiert sein Revier mit einer Flüssigkeit, die aus seiner Schweifspitze austritt.
The unique creations produced by each Smeargle are painted using the fluid that oozes from its tail. This is how it marks its territory.

gs: It is always bursting with en ergy. To make it self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
c: To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge anyone. It has a very strong com petitive spirit.
rs: TYROGUE becomes stressed out if it does not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the TRAINER must establish and uphold various training methods.
e: TYROGUE become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the TRAINER must establish a regular training schedule.
frlg: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.
dp: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
pt: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
hgss: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
bw: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
b2w2: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
xy: Es strotzt vor Energie. Um noch stärker zu werden, kämpft es weiter, auch wenn es verloren hat.
It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
oras: Rabauz muss jeden Tag trainieren, sonst ist es nicht ausgelastet und reagiert gestresst. Wenn man dieses Pokémon trainiert, muss man zahlreiche Trainingsmethoden einsetzen und sie ständig ausbauen.
Tyrogue becomes stressed out if it does not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish and uphold various training methods.
swsh: Es strotzt vor Energie. Um stärker zu werden, fordert es seine Gegner immer wieder heraus, auch wenn es schon mehrmals verloren hat.
It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

gs: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
c: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.
rs: HITMONTOP spins on its head at high speed, all the while delivering kicks. This technique is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense at the same time. The Pokémon travels faster spinning than it does walking.
e: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. HITMONTOP travel faster spinning than they do walking.
frlg: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
dp: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
pt: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
hgss: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you’d like.
bw: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
b2w2: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.
xy: Es kämpft, während es sich wie ein Kreisel dreht. Die Zentrifugalkraft verzehnfacht seine Kampfkraft.
It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.
oras: Kapoera dreht sich auf dem Kopf stehend um die eigene Achse und teilt Tritte aus. Seine Technik ist eine bemerkenswerte Mischung aus Angriff und Verteidigung. Es bewegt sich drehend schneller voran als laufend.

Hitmontop spins on its head at high speed, all the while delivering kicks. This technique is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense at the same time. The Pokémon travels faster spinning than it does walking.
swsh: Es dreht sich um sich selbst und verteilt Tritte. Gewinnt es ausreichend an Schwung, bohrt es sich dabei in den Boden.
It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

gs: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
c: The sensitivity of its lips develops most quickly. It uses them to try to identify unknown objects.
rs: SMOOCHUM actively runs about, but also falls quite often. Whenever the chance arrives, it will look for its reflection to make sure its face hasn’t become dirty.
e: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake’s surface to make sure its face hasn’t become dirty.
frlg: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.
dp: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
pt: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
hgss: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
bw: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
b2w2: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
xy: Die Lippen sind sein empfindlichster Körperteil. Neue Dinge untersucht es zuerst damit.
Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
oras: Kussilla läuft hektisch umher, fällt aber auch ziemlich oft hin. Es lässt keine Möglichkeit aus, sein Spiegelbild zu betrachten, um sicherzustellen, dass sein Gesicht nicht schmutzig geworden ist.
Smoochum actively runs about, but also falls quite often. Whenever the chance arrives, it will look for its reflection to make sure its face hasn’t become dirty.
sm: Bevor es Dinge in die Hände nimmt, die es interessieren, untersucht es diese mit den Lippen. Dabei leckt es sie sorgfältig sauber.
When it examines things, before touching them with its hands, it makes lip contact and then diligently licks all the dirt off its lips.
swsh: Wird Kussillas Gesicht auch nur ein bisschen schmutzig, wäscht es sich sofort. Schmutz am Rest seines Körpers scheint es nicht zu stören.
If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

gs: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
c: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish- white when it is charging energy.
rs: ELEKID stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this Pokémon begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
e: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
frlg: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.
dp: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
pt: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.
hgss: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.
bw: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.
b2w2: Spinning its arms around to generate electricity makes the area between its horns shine light blue.
xy: Es bewegt seine Arme und generiert damit Elektrizität. Diese kann es aber nicht speichern.
It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
oras: Elekid speichert Elektrizität in seinem Körper. Wenn es Metall berührt und versehentlich die aufgestaute Energie entlädt, rotiert es mit den Armen, um sich wieder aufzuladen.
Elekid stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this Pokémon begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
sm: Daheim hängt es an der Steckdose wie an einem Babyfläschchen und nuckelt genüsslich den Strom.
When it’s in a house, electrical outlets serve as its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.
swsh: Nähert sich ein Sturm, wird Elekid unruhig. Sobald es Donnergrollen hört, ist es nicht mehr zu halten und fängt an zu toben.
When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.
pla: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

gs: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
c: It naturally spits an 1100-degree flame. It is said when many appear, it heralds a volcanic eruption.
rs: MAGBY’s state of health is determined by observing the fire it breathes. If the Pokémon is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
e: If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
frlg: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.
dp: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.
pt: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.
hgss: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble from its mouth and nostrils.
bw: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.
b2w2: It’s small, but its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees F. Embers escape its mouth and nose when it breathes.
xy: Seine Körpertemperatur misst 600 °C. Beim Ein- und Ausatmen springen glühende Kohlenstücke aus seinem Mund.
It’s small, but its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. Embers escape its mouth and nose when it breathes.
oras: Magbys Gesundheitszustand kann man am Feuer erkennen, das es ausatmet. Wenn es gelbe Flammen ausstößt, ist es in guter Verfassung. Ist es erschöpft, vermischen sich die Flammen mit schwarzem Rauch.

Magby’s state of health is determined by observing the fire it breathes. If the Pokémon is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
sm: Häufig in Vulkangebieten anzutreffen. Füttert man es, kann es sein, dass es vor lauter Freude 600 °C heißes Feuer ausstößt.
Many of these Pokémon can be seen in areas with volcanic activity. Feeding can get them so excited, they exhale flames of 1,100 degrees F.
swsh: Es ist noch klein und furchtsam. Wenn es sich aufregt oder erschrickt, entweichen Flammen aus seinem Mund und seiner Nase.
This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.
pla: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

gs: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
c: In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for rhythmically pull ing up and down on its udders.
rs: MILTANK gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
e: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
frlg: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.
dp: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
pt: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
hgss: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
bw: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
b2w2: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
xy: Wenn es gerade ein Junges hat, dann enthält seine Milch mehr Nährstoffe als gewöhnlich.
If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.
oras: Miltank gibt täglich 20 l Milch. Sie ist süßlich und wird von Kindern und Erwachsenen gleichermaßen genossen. Menschen, die keine Milch trinken, essen sie stattdessen als Joghurt.
Miltank gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
sm: Seine Milch ist kalorienreich und enthält viele Nährstoffe. Trinkt man zu viel davon, hat man allerdings selbst bald eine Figur wie Miltank.
Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank’s.
swsh: Dank seiner äußerst nährstoffreichen Milch trägt Miltank seit langer Zeit zum Wohl von Menschen und Pokémon bei.
Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

gs: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be comes unfailingly caring and pleas ant to everyone.
c: Biting into one of the delicious eggs that BLISSEY provides will make everyone around smile with joy.
rs: BLISSEY senses sadness with its fluffy coat of fur. If it does so, this Pokémon will rush over to the sad person, however far they may be, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.
e: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.
frlg: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.
dp: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.
pt: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
hgss: Anyone who takes even one taste of BLISSEY’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.
bw: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
b2w2: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
xy: Eier, die es legt, stecken voller Fröhlichkeit. Schon ein Bissen erzeugt ein breites Lächeln.
The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
oras: Heiteira nimmt mit seinem flauschigen Fell Traurigkeit wahr. Es hastet zu einer traurigen Person, egal, wie weit diese entfernt ist, und teilt ein Glücks-Ei mit ihr, um sie zum Lächeln zu bringen.
Blissey senses sadness with its fluffy coat of fur. If it does so, this Pokémon will rush over to a sad person, no matter how far away, to share a Lucky Egg that brings a smile to any face.
sm: Ein Bissen von seinem Glücks-Ei, das voller Fröhlichkeit steckt, lässt selbst das wildeste Pokémon ganz sanft und ruhig werden.
Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey’s egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.
swsh: Stößt Heiteira auf geschwächte Pokémon, teilt es sein Ei mit ihnen und pflegt sie wieder gesund.
Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.
pla: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

gs: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
c: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.
rs: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
e: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.
frlg: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.
dp: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
pt: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
hgss: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
bw: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
b2w2: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
xy: Die Regenwolken, die es trägt, ermöglichen es ihm, Gewitter zu erzeugen. Es strotzt vor Blitzen.
The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
oras: Raikou ist so schnell wie der Blitz. Das Gebrüll dieses Pokémon sendet Schockwellen aus, die wie Donnerschläge durch die Luft beben und den Boden erschüttern.
Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

gs: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
c: This brawny Pokémon courses around the earth, spouting flames hotter than a volcano's magma.
rs: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
e: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.
frlg: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
dp: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
pt: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
hgss: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.
bw: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
b2w2: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
xy: Dieses Pokémon jagt über das Land. Man sagt, in jedem neuen Vulkan wird ein Entei geboren.
A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
oras: Entei verfügt über die Leidenschaft von Magma. Dieses Pokémon wurde bei einem Vulkanausbruch geboren und bringt Feuersbrünste hervor, die alles auslöschen, was mit ihnen in Kontakt kommt.
Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

gs: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
c: This divine Pokémon blows around the world, always in search of a pure reservoir.
rs: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
e: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.
frlg: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.
dp: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
pt: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
hgss: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
bw: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
b2w2: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
xy: Es wandert beständig in der Welt herum, um verunreinigtes Wasser zu reinigen. Es zieht mit dem Nordwind.
It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
oras: Suicune wohnt die Reinheit einer Quelle inne. Es bewegt sich graziös und hat die Macht, schmutziges Wasser zu reinigen.
Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

gs: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
c: Born deep under ground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.
rs: LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. To come up to the surface, this Pokémon must eat its way through the soil above. Until it does so, LARVITAR cannot see its parent’s face.
e: A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents’ faces.
frlg: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.
dp: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
pt: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
hgss: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.
bw: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
b2w2: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.
xy: Es ernährt sich von Erde. Nachdem es einen Berg verspeist hat, schläft es ein, um zu wachsen.
It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.
oras: Larvitar wurde tief unter der Erde geboren. Um an die Oberfläche zu gelangen, muss es sich durch das Erdreich fressen. Erst dann bekommt es seine Eltern zu Gesicht.
Larvitar is born deep under the ground. To come up to the surface, this Pokémon must eat its way through the soil above. Until it does so, Larvitar cannot see its parents.
sm: Es wird unterirdisch geboren und frisst sich durchs Erdreich an die Oberfläche zu seinen Eltern. Es verabscheut grelles, blendendes Licht.
Born underground, it eats its way through dirt to the surface, where its parents are. It doesn’t deal well with the bright light it finds there.
swsh: Sie schlüpfen tief unter der Erde und fressen sich durch das Erdreich bis zur Oberfläche durch, wo sie sich verpuppen.
Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

gs: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
c: It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
rs: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable - it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.
e: A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.
frlg: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
dp: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
pt: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
hgss: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.
bw: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
b2w2: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.
xy: Sein Körper ist hart wie Fels. Es lässt mit Hochdruck Gas ab, um wie eine Rakete nach oben zu schießen.
Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
oras: Pupitar erzeugt in seinem Körper ein Gas, das es komprimiert und kraftvoll ausstößt, um sich wie ein Düsenflugzeug anzutreiben. Sein Körper ist sehr robust und er hält auch massivem Stahl stand.
Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable—it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.
sm: Es kann seine Entwicklung nicht erwarten und stört andere, wenn es zum Stressabbau mithilfe von komprimiertem Gas durch die Luft zischt.
This troublesome Pokémon can’t wait to evolve, so it relieves its stress by wildly propelling itself around using compressed gas.
swsh: Trotz seiner harten Schale kann es sich frei bewegen. Es ist flink und äußerst zerstörerisch.
Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

gs: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
c: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and moun tains crumble.
rs: TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. This Pokémon wanders about in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
e: A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
frlg: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
dp: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
pt: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
hgss: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
bw: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
b2w2: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.
xy: Es besitzt so viel Kraft, dass es mit nur einer Hand die Erde beben lassen und Berge zerbröckeln kann.
In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and mountains crumble.
oras: Despotar ist erstaunlich stark. Es kann einen ganzen Berg vernichten, um sein Nest zu bauen. Dieses Pokémon wandert in den Bergen umher und sucht nach Gegnern für einen Kampf.
Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. This Pokémon wanders about in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
sm: Es durchstreift die Berge auf der Suche nach Gegnern. Begegnet es einem, der ihm nicht ebenbürtig ist, ignoriert es ihn und zieht weiter.
It wanders through the mountains seeking opponents to fight. If it finds an opponent that’s not worthy, Tyranitar ignores it and wanders on.
swsh: Dank seines starken Körpers fürchtet es sich vor keiner Form von Angriff. Deshalb zettelt es ununterbrochen Kämpfe an.
Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

gs: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
c: It has an incred ible ability to calm raging sto rms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.
rs: LUGIA’s wings pack devastating power - a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
e: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
frlg: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
dp: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
pt: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
hgss: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
bw: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
b2w2: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
xy: Es schläft in einem Tiefseegraben. Schwingt es seine Flügel, entsteht ein Sturm, der 40 Tage dauert.
It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
oras: Lugias Flügel haben eine zerstörerische Kraft. Bereits ein leichtes Flattern kann Häuser hinfortwehen. Daher hat sich dieses Pokémon dafür entschieden, tief unter dem Meer zu leben, wo es niemand sieht.
Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

gs: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies con tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
c: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted trainer by shining its bright rain bow-colored wings.
rs: HO-OH’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
e: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
frlg: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
dp: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
pt: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
hgss: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.
bw: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
b2w2: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
xy: Sein Körper soll in sieben Farben leuchten. Im Flug zieht es einen Regenbogen hinter sich her.
A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
oras: Ho-Ohs Federn leuchten in sieben Farben, je nachdem aus welchem Winkel das Licht auf sie fällt. Die Federn sollen ihrem Besitzer Glück bringen. Dieses Pokémon lebt am Fuße eines Regenbogens.

Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

gs: This Pokémon wan ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
c: Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI appears wherever beautiful forests exist.
rs: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
e: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
frlg: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
dp: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
pt: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
hgss: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
bw: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
b2w2: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
xy: Dieses Pokémon reist durch Zeit und Raum. Bäume und Wiesen wuchern, wenn es in der Nähe ist.
This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
oras: Dieses Pokémon kommt aus der Zukunft und ist durch die Zeit gereist. Solange Celebi auftaucht, ist der Menschheit angeblich eine rosige Zukunft beschieden.
This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
swsh: Es kann durch die Zeit reisen und findet in Aufzeichnungen aus verschiedenen Zeitaltern als „Hüter des Waldes“ Erwähnung.
This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

rs: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
e: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest’s trees.
frlg: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
dp: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
pt: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
hgss: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.
bw: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
b2w2: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
xy: Es klettert blitzschnell Wände empor. Mit seinem Schwanz misst es die Luftfeuchtigkeit, um das Wetter am nächsten Tag vorherzusagen.
It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
oras: Mit den kleinen Haken unter seinen Füßen kann Geckarbor an Wänden hochklettern. Dieses Pokémon greift Feinde an, indem es mit seinem mächtigen Schweif zuschlägt.
Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

rs: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
e: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon’s body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.
frlg: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
dp: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
pt: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
hgss: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.
bw: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
b2w2: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
xy: Seine stark entwickelten Oberschenkelmuskeln verleihen ihm außergewöhnliche Agilität und Sprungkraft.
Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
oras: Reptain kann sich mit den Blättern, die aus seinem Körper herauswachsen, im Wald hervorragend tarnen. Dieses Pokémon ist ein wahrer Meister darin, auf die Bäume des Dschungels zu klettern.
The leaves growing out of Grovyle’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

rs: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
e: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.
frlg: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.
dp: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
pt: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
hgss: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.
bw: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
b2w2: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
xy: Die Blätter an seinen Armen können dicke Bäume fällen. Im Dschungelkampf gibt es kein stärkeres Pokémon.
The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
oras: Die Blätter, die auf Gewaldros Körper wachsen, sind sehr scharfkantig. Dieses Pokémon ist sehr agil. Es hüpft von Ast zu Ast und springt seine Feinde von oben oder hinten an.
The leaves growing on Sceptile’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile—it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

rs: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
e: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can’t see its surroundings.
frlg: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
dp: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
pt: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
hgss: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.
bw: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
b2w2: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
xy: In seinem Bauch ist ein Flammensack, der stets brennt. Umarmt man es, fühlt es sich warm an.
It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
oras: Flemmli hängt an seinem Trainer wie eine Klette. Es schlurft immer hinter ihm her. Dieses Pokémon spuckt 1 000 °C heißes Feuer, das seinen Feinden ordentlich einheizt.
Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

rs: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
e: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.
frlg: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
dp: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
pt: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
hgss: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
bw: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
b2w2: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
xy: Es kann zehn Tritte pro Sekunde austeilen. Es gibt schrille Schreie von sich, um Gegner einzuschüchtern.
Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
oras: Jungglut trainiert seine Beine und Oberschenkel, indem es über Felder und Berge läuft. Die Beine dieses Pokémon sind sowohl schnell als auch kräftig, sodass es 10 Tritte pro Sekunde ausführen kann.
Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.

rs: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.
e: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.
frlg: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
dp: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
pt: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
hgss: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
bw: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
b2w2: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
xy: Mühelos springt es selbst über 30-stöckige Häuser. Sein Feuerschlag fügt dem Gegner Verbrennungen zu.
It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
oras: Lohgock stößt heftige Flammen aus seinen Handgelenken aus und greift seine Feinde mutig an. Je stärker ein Feind ist, desto stärker lodern die Handgelenke dieses Pokémon.
In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.

rs: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
e: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water’s edge.
frlg: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
dp: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
pt: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
hgss: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.
bw: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
b2w2: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
xy: Durch den propellerartigen Einsatz seiner großen Schwanzflosse schwimmt es schnell durchs Wasser. Trotz seiner kleinen Größe ist es stark.
Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
oras: Die Flosse an Hydropis Kopf dient als hochempfindliches Radar. Damit kann es Bewegungen im Wasser und in der Luft wahrnehmen. So weiß es jederzeit, was in seiner Umgebung passiert, ohne dabei seine Augen zu benutzen.
The fin on Mudkip’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

rs: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
e: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.
frlg: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
dp: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
pt: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
hgss: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
bw: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
b2w2: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
xy: Seine kräftigen Beine geben ihm sicheren Halt. Es gräbt sich in Dreck ein, wenn es schlafen will.
Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
oras: Moorabbels Körper ist mit einem klebrigen Film überzogen, durch den es an Land überleben kann. Dieses Pokémon spielt bei Ebbe in den Schlammpfützen am Strand.
The surface of Marshtomp’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

rs: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
e: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.
frlg: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
dp: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
pt: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
hgss: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
bw: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
b2w2: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
xy: Schon ein Hieb seiner steinharten Arme schlägt selbst den stärksten Felsen zu Bruch.
Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
oras: Sumpex ist sehr stark. Es kann mit Leichtigkeit einen Felsblock bewegen, der über eine Tonne wiegt. Weiterhin ist es mit einem exzellenten Sehvermögen ausgestattet, wodurch es auch in trüben Gewässern sehen kann.
Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

rs: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
e: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.
frlg: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
dp: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
pt: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
hgss: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.
bw: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
b2w2: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
xy: Ein beharrliches Pokémon, das seine Beute jagt, bis diese erschöpft ist.
A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
oras: Sobald Fiffyen eine Bewegung wahrnimmt, schnappt es zu. Es jagt seine Beute so lange, bis sie vollkommen erschöpft ist. Wenn sich die Beute allerdings wehrt, kann es passieren, dass Fiffyen klein beigibt und flieht.
At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

rs: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
e: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader’s orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
frlg: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
dp: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
pt: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
hgss: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
bw: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
b2w2: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
xy: Es wird stets die Befehle eines begabten Trainers befolgen. Dieses Verhalten geht darauf zurück, dass es früher im Rudel lebte.
It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
oras: Magnayen sendet deutliche Signale aus, wenn es sich auf einen Angriff vorbereitet. Es knurrt heftig und macht sich flach. Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinen spitzen Zähnen brutal zubeißen.
Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

rs: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
e: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.
frlg: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
dp: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
pt: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
hgss: It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.
bw: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
b2w2: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
xy: Es läuft im Zickzack. Es hat das Talent, Items im Gras, aber auch im Boden, zu finden.
It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
oras: Zigzachs ist ein rastloser Wanderer. Dieses Pokémon ist nämlich sehr neugierig und es inspiziert alles, was ihm zufällig begegnet.
Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
swsh: Sie markieren ihr Revier, indem sie ihr hartes Fell an Bäumen reiben. Sie sind weniger aggressiv als die Zigzachs der Galar-Region.
It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.

rs: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.
e: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.
frlg: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.
dp: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
pt: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
hgss: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
bw: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
b2w2: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
xy: Auf gerader Strecke erreicht es mühelos 100 km/h. Nur die Kurven bereiten ihm große Schwierigkeiten.
When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
oras: Geradaks rennt immer mit vollem Tempo und nie im Zickzack, sondern nur gerade. Wenn ihm ein Hindernis im Weg ist, läuft es rechtwinklig daran vorbei. Für dieses Pokémon stellen leichte Kurven eine große Herausforderung dar.
Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.
swsh: Sein Fell ist kräftig und fest. Rasierpinsel, die aus seinen ausgefallenen Haaren hergestellt werden, sind absolute Luxusartikel.
Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.

rs: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
e: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.
frlg: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.
dp: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
pt: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
hgss: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.
bw: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
b2w2: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
xy: Es isst am liebsten Blätter. Wird es von einem Staralili angegriffen, verteidigt es sich mit Stacheln.
It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
oras: Waumpel kann mit den Stacheln an seinem Hinterteil die Rinde von Bäumen entfernen und ernährt sich von dem austretenden Saft. An den Füßen dieses Pokémon befinden sich Saugnäpfe, mit denen es auch an Glas nicht abrutscht.

Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
pla: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

rs: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
e: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.
frlg: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.
dp: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
pt: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
hgss: Having wrapped silk around the branches of a tree, it quiescently awaits evolution.
bw: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
b2w2: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
xy: Es bindet sich mit Seide an Äste und trinkt Regenwasser, während es starr auf seine Entwicklung wartet.
It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
oras: Schaloko bindet sich mit einem Seidenfaden an einen Ast. Es baumelt dort und wartet auf seine Entwicklung. Durch zwei kleine Löcher in seinem Seidenkokon lugt es heraus.
Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
pla: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

rs: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
e: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.
frlg: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.
dp: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
pt: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
hgss: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
bw: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
b2w2: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
xy: Die bunten Flügel sind sein Markenzeichen. Mit seinem Rüssel saugt es süßen Honig aus Blumen.
Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
oras: Papinellas Lieblingsspeise ist Blütenstaub. Wenn du dieses Pokémon beobachten möchtest, musst du bloß einen Blumentopf vor ein geöffnetes Fenster stellen. Papinella wird sich diese Leckerei nicht entgehen lassen.
Beautifly’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.
pla: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

rs: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
e: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.
frlg: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
dp: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
pt: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
hgss: It endures attacks with patience, because the more pain before evolution, the sturdier it becomes.
bw: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
b2w2: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
xy: Sein aus weicher Seide bestehender Körper erhärtet mit der Zeit. Sobald Risse sichtbar sind, steht die Entwicklung kurz bevor.
Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
oras: Panekon baut seinen schützenden Kokon, indem es seinen Körper mit feiner Seide einwickelt, die aus seinem Mund austritt. Wenn sein Körper mit Seide bedeckt ist, wird diese hart. Im Kokon wartet es auf seine Entwicklung.

Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
pla: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

rs: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
e: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.
frlg: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.
dp: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
pt: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
hgss: It scatters its fine dust all over when it is attacked. It is a nocturnal Pokémon.
bw: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
b2w2: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
xy: Nachtaktives Pokémon, das vom Licht der Stadt angezogen wird und dort die Blätter der Bäume frisst.
A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
oras: Pudox wird instinktiv vom Licht angezogen. In hell erleuchteten Städten kann man Scharen dieser Pokémon dabei beobachten, wie sie großen Schaden anrichten, indem sie die Blätter von Bäumen abfressen.
Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
pla: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

rs: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.
e: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.
frlg: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
dp: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
pt: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
hgss: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.
bw: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
b2w2: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
xy: Es sieht aus wie eine Wasserpflanze. Es dient den Pokémon, die nicht schwimmen können, als Fähre.
It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
oras: Loturzel lebt auf der Wasseroberfläche von Teichen oder Seen. Es wird schwächer, wenn sein breites Blatt abstirbt. Nur selten geht dieses Pokémon an Land, um nach sauberem Wasser Ausschau zu halten.
Lotad live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.
swsh: Es sucht nach reinem Wasser. Wenn es für längere Zeit kein Wasser trinkt, verwelkt das Blatt auf seinem Kopf.
It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

rs: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
e: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.
frlg: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
dp: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
pt: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
hgss: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.
bw: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
b2w2: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
xy: Es lebt am Ufer, wo die Sonne scheint. Tagsüber schläft es in einem Bett aus Schilf und wird nachts aktiv.
It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water-grass by day and becomes active at night.
oras: Lombrero liebt die Nacht und wird bei Einbruch der Dunkelheit aktiv. Es spielt auch gerne Streiche. Wenn es Angler sieht, zieht es unter Wasser an ihren Angelschnüren und erfreut sich an ihrer Entrüstung.

Lombre is nocturnal—it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
swsh: Lombrero wird erst in der Abenddämmerung aktiv. Es ernährt sich von Moos, das am Boden von Flüssen gedeiht.
It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

rs: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
e: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
frlg: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO’s cells, making it more powerful.
dp: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
pt: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
hgss: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.
bw: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
b2w2: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
xy: Hört es fröhliche Musik, füllen sich seine Muskeln mit Energie. Es muss dann einfach tanzen.
If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
oras: Kappalores fängt sofort zu tanzen an, wenn es stimmungsvolle, feierliche Musik vernimmt. Dieses Pokémon erscheint angeblich, wenn es Kinder auf Wanderausflügen singen hört.
Ludicolo begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
swsh: Der Rhythmus von fröhlicher Musik aktiviert die Zellen von Kappalores und macht es so stärker.
The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.

rs: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon’s body becomes.
e: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.
frlg: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.
dp: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
pt: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
hgss: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
bw: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
b2w2: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
xy: Mit dem Stiel auf seinem Kopf hängt es sich an Äste. Bei starkem Wind fällt es durchaus einmal herunter.
It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
oras: Samurzel hängt sich mit dem Kopf an einen Ast. Dabei entzieht es dem Baum Feuchtigkeit. Je mehr Wasser es trinkt, desto glänzender wird der Körper dieses Pokémon.
Seedot attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon’s body becomes.
swsh: Zeigt es sich regungslos, kann man es nicht von echten Nüssen unterscheiden. Es überrascht liebend gern Pokémon, die es aufpicken wollen.
If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

rs: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.
e: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.
frlg: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
dp: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
pt: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
hgss: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
bw: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
b2w2: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
xy: Der Ton seiner Grasflöte beunruhigt die, die ihn hören. Es lebt tief in den Wäldern.
The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
oras: Blanas lebt in dichten Wäldern. Manchmal wagt es sich aus dem Wald heraus, um Menschen zu erschrecken. Dieses Pokémon mag es überhaupt nicht, wenn man seine lange Nase zwickt.
Nuzleaf live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.
swsh: Es lebt tief im Wald. Aus dem Blatt auf seinem Kopf kann es sich eine Flöte bauen, deren Klang Unruhe verbreitet.
It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

rs: SHIFTRY is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
e: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.
frlg: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
dp: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
pt: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
hgss: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
bw: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
b2w2: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
xy: Dieses Pokémon wurde als Wächter des Waldes gefürchtet. Es kann die Gedanken des Gegners lesen und präventiv handeln.
A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
oras: Tengulist ist ein geheimnisvolles Pokémon, das angeblich auf hohen Bäumen lebt, die Tausende von Jahren alt sind. Mit den Blätterfächern an seinen Händen kann es heftige Stürme erzeugen.
Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon wurde als „Wächter des Waldes“ gefürchtet. Es kann die Gedanken des Gegners lesen und präventiv handeln.
A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

rs: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
e: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.
frlg: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.
dp: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
pt: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
hgss: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.
bw: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
b2w2: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
xy: Es ist sehr mutig und stellt sich auch starken Gegnern. Es sucht ständig nach warmen Regionen.
It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
oras: Mutig behauptet Schwalbini sein Territorium gegen Eindringlinge, so stark diese auch sein mögen. Dieses unerschrockene Pokémon bleibt trotz einer Niederlage angriffslustig, heult aber laut, wenn es Hunger hat.
