Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

rs: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
e: A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.
frlg: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
dp: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
pt: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
hgss: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.
bw: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
b2w2: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
xy: Wenn seine beiden Schwanzfedern aufrecht stehen, zeigt das, dass es bei bester Gesundheit ist. Es fliegt elegant in den Himmel empor.
If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
oras: Dieses Pokémon taucht in einem steilen Winkel ab, sobald es Beute wahrgenommen hat. Es packt seine Beute mit seinen Krallen und lässt sie nicht mehr entkommen.

Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow’s clawed feet, preventing escape.

rs: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
e: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.
frlg: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.
dp: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.
pt: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.
hgss: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.
bw: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.
b2w2: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.
xy: Es lässt sich vom Wind der Meere treiben, als wäre es ein Segelflugzeug.
Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.
oras: Man sieht Wingull oft mit seiner Beute oder seinen Besitztümern im Schnabel herumfliegen auf der Suche nach geeigneten Verstecken. Dieses Pokémon fliegt durch die Lüfte, als würde es gleiten.
Wingull has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
sm: Seine Knochen sind hohl und daher sehr leicht. Mit seinen ausgebreiteten großen Flügeln steigt es hoch in den Himmel empor.
Its hollow bones enhance its lightness. It spreads its wings to the wind and soars away into the sky.
swsh: Es baut sein Nest an Steilhängen und nutzt die Seebrise, um beim Gleiten am weiten Himmel an Höhe zu gewinnen.
It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

rs: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
e: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
frlg: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.
dp: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
pt: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
hgss: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.
bw: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
b2w2: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
xy: Es taucht seinen großen Schnabel ins Wasser und fängt so eine Menge Beute.
It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
oras: Pelipper transportiert kleine Pokémon und Eier in seinem riesigen Schnabel durch die Lüfte. Dieses Pokémon baut sein Nest auf steilen Klippen am Meer.
Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
sm: Sein riesiger Schnabel ist so groß, dass sogar ein kleines Kind problemlos hineinpassen würde.
Its spacious beak is large enough for a small child to fit right inside.
swsh: Ein Bote der Lüfte. Es bringt Eier und kleine Pokémon in seinem Schnabel in Sicherheit.
It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

rs: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
e: A RALTS has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
frlg: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
dp: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
pt: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
hgss: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.
bw: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
b2w2: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
xy: Es erfasst warme Gefühle von Menschen und Pokémon mit seinen Hörnern und wärmt sich daran auf.
If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
oras: Trasla nimmt mit den Hörnern an seinem Kopf die Gefühle von Menschen wahr. Menschen bekommen dieses Pokémon nur selten zu Gesicht. Wenn es bemerkt, dass eine Person gut gelaunt ist, traut es sich näher an sie heran.
Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
swsh: Es hat ein feines Gespür für die Gefühle der Menschen und Pokémon. Wenn es Feindseligkeit wahrnimmt, versteckt es sich.
It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
pla: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

rs: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
e: A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
frlg: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
dp: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.
pt: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
hgss: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
bw: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
b2w2: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
xy: Die fröhliche Stimmung seines Trainers verleiht ihm Energie für psychokinetische Kraft. Wenn es glücklich ist, tanzt und dreht es sich.
The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
oras: Man sagt, dass ein Kirlia, das häufig positive Emotionen seines Trainers wahrnimmt, sehr schön wird. Dieses Pokémon kontrolliert psychokinetische Energie mit seinem hochentwickelten Gehirn.
It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
swsh: Wenn sich sein Trainer freut, tanzt es in einem Schwall von Energie fröhlich kreisend umher.
If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
pla: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

rs: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
e: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.
frlg: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.
dp: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.
pt: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
hgss: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.
bw: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
b2w2: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
xy: Erzeugt ein kleines schwarzes Loch mithilfe all seiner Psycho-Kräfte, um seinen Trainer zu schützen.
To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
oras: Guardevoir kann in die Zukunft schauen. Wenn es eine Gefahr für seinen Trainer voraussieht, entlädt es seine psychokinetische Energie mit voller Kraft.
Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
swsh: Es kann die Zukunft vorhersagen. Beschützt es seinen Trainer, erreicht seine Kraft ihren Höhepunkt.
It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
pla: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

rs: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
e: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
frlg: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
dp: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
pt: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
hgss: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.
bw: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
b2w2: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
xy: Normalerweise leben sie in Teichen, aber nach einem Schauer am Abend kann man sie auch in Pfützen in den Städten finden.
They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
oras: Gehweiher scheidet aus seinen Zehen ein Öl aus, das es ihm ermöglicht, über Wasser zu gleiten. Dieses Pokémon ernährt sich von Mikroorganismen aus Teichen und Seen.
From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
sm: Es scheint, als würde es übers Wasser gleiten. Auf der Suche nach Futter gerät es immer wieder mit Araqua aneinander.
It moves as if skating on the surface of the water. It often fights with Dewpider over food.

rs: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
e: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can’t fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
frlg: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.
dp: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
pt: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
hgss: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-- to and fro and sideways.
bw: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
b2w2: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
xy: Seine Antenne besitzt ein Augenmuster. Seine vier Flügel erlauben es, in alle Richtungen zu fliegen.
Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
oras: Maskeregen schüchtert seine Feinde mit den augenähnlichen Mustern auf seinen Antennen ein. Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinen vier Flügeln wie ein Hubschrauber in jede Richtung fliegen, sogar seitwärts und rückwärts.
Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction—even sideways and backwards—as if it were a helicopter.
sm: Schüchtert seine Feinde mit den augenähnlichen Mustern auf seinen Antennen ein. Kann dank seiner vier Flügel frei in alle Richtungen fliegen.
It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.

rs: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
e: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH feasting on composted soil.
frlg: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
dp: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
pt: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
hgss: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.
bw: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
b2w2: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
xy: Es bevorzugt feuchte Orte. Am Tag sitzt es regungslos im Schatten des Waldes. Von seinem Kopf sondert es einen giftigen Puder ab.
It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
oras: Knilz lebt im feuchten Erdboden finsterer Wälder. Es wird oft reglos unter herabgefallenen Blättern gefunden. Dieses Pokémon ernährt sich von Kompost aus verrotteten Blättern.
Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

rs: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
e: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.
frlg: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.
dp: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
pt: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
hgss: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.
bw: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
b2w2: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
xy: Seine kurzen Arme dehnen sich aus, wenn es zuschlägt. Seine Technik ähnelt der von Profi-Boxern.
Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
oras: Mit leichtfüßiger Beinarbeit nähert sich Kapilz seinen Feinden und schlägt dann mit seinen dehnbaren Armen um sich. Die Kampftechnik dieses Pokémon treibt Profiboxern die Schamesröte ins Gesicht.
Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

rs: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
e: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn’t change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
frlg: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.
dp: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
pt: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
hgss: The way SLAKOTH lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
bw: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
b2w2: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.
xy: Allein bei Bummelz’ Anblick werden Gegner von Trägheit gepackt und schlummern alsbald ein.
The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
oras: Bummelz faulenzt zwanzig Stunden pro Tag. Da es sich sehr wenig bewegt, braucht es auch nicht viel Nahrung. Seine Tagesration besteht lediglich aus drei Blättern.
Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

rs: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
e: It can’t keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn’t, it can’t sleep at night.
frlg: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.
dp: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
pt: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
hgss: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.
bw: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
b2w2: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can’t sit still for one second.
xy: Sein Puls ist konstant so hoch, dass sein Blut immer in Wallung ist und es keine Sekunde stillhalten kann.
Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can’t sit still for one second.
oras: Muntier brennt darauf, sich auszutoben. Es kann nicht einmal für eine Minute stillsitzen. Es gerät in Stress, wenn es sich nicht andauernd bewegen kann.
Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.

rs: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.
e: Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
frlg: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.
dp: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
pt: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
hgss: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.
bw: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
b2w2: This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only rolls over and moves when there is no more grass to eat.
xy: Das faulste Pokémon der Welt. Es bewegt sich nur, wenn alles Essbare in Reichweite verputzt ist.
The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.
oras: Letarking verbringt den Tag damit, herumzuliegen und nichts zu tun. Es ernährt sich von Gras, das in seiner Reichweite wächst. Hat es alles aufgefressen, so sucht es sich widerwillig ein anderes Plätzchen.
Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.

rs: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
e: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.
frlg: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
dp: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
pt: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
hgss: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
bw: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
b2w2: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
xy: Da es fast sein gesamtes Leben unter der Erde verbracht hat, ist es nahezu blind. Es setzt daher als Augenersatz seine Fühler ein.
Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
oras: Nincada lebt viele Jahre in absoluter Dunkelheit unter der Erde. Dieses Pokémon nimmt Nährstoffe aus Baumwurzeln auf. Es rührt sich nicht, da es auf seine Entwicklung wartet.
Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
swsh: Da es fast sein gesamtes Leben unter der Erde verbracht hat, ist es nahezu blind. Es setzt daher als Augenersatz seine Fühler ein.
Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

rs: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.
e: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.
frlg: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
dp: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
pt: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
hgss: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
bw: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
b2w2: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
xy: Sein Gesang erzeugt unausweichlich Kopfweh. Es bewegt sich so schnell, dass es beinah unsichtbar zu sein scheint.
Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
oras: Ninjask bewegt sich so schnell, dass man es nicht sehen kann. Seine Schreie sind aber laut und deutlich zu hören. Deshalb hielt man dieses Pokémon lange für unsichtbar.
Ninjask moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.
swsh: Lauscht man längere Zeit seinem Gesang, löst er dauerhafte Kopfschmerzen aus. Es ist so schnell, dass es beinahe unsichtbar zu sein scheint.
Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

rs: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
e: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.
frlg: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a NINCADA evolves.
dp: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
pt: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
hgss: A strange Pokémon--it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.
bw: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
b2w2: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
xy: Ein weggeworfener Käferpanzer, der zum Leben erwachte. Schaut man hinein, stiehlt es einem die Seele.
A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
oras: Ninjatoms harter Körper bewegt sich überhaupt nicht. Er scheint bloß eine hohle Schale zu sein. Dieses Pokémon soll angeblich die Seele eines jeden stehlen, der hinterrücks einen Blick in seinen hohlen Körper riskiert.

Shedinja’s hard body doesn’t move—not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
swsh: Ein äußerst sonderbares Pokémon, das plötzlich auf rätselhafte Weise in einem Pokéball auftaucht, wenn Nincada sich entwickelt.
A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

rs: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
e: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.
frlg: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
dp: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
pt: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
hgss: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.
bw: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
b2w2: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
xy: Normalerweise murmelt es, aber bei Gefahr beginnt es laut zu schreien. Es hört auf zu schreien, wenn seine Ohrmuscheln bedeckt werden.
It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
oras: Normalerweise ist Flurmels Stimme sehr leise, selbst mit größter Anstrengung ist sie kaum hörbar. Wenn dieses Pokémon jedoch eine Gefahr wittert, stößt es ohrenbetäubende Schreie aus.
Normally, Whismur’s voice is very quiet—it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
swsh: Sein Schrei erreicht eine Lautstärke von über 100 Dezibel. Hört man diesen aus der Nähe, leidet man den ganzen Tag unter Kopfschmerzen.
The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.

rs: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
e: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
frlg: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.
dp: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
pt: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
hgss: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
bw: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
b2w2: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
xy: Es atmet tief ein und nutzt seine Bauchmuskeln, um die Luft in einem gewaltigen Schrei auszustoßen.
It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
oras: Krakeelos Brüllen kann ein Holzhaus zum Einsturz bringen. Es setzt seine Stimme ein, um seine Gegner anzugreifen. Die runden Ohren dieses Pokémon dienen als Lautsprecher.
Loudred’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
swsh: Seine Ohren fungieren als Lautsprecher. Mit ihnen kann es starke Schallwellen ausstoßen, die ganze Häuser zum Einsturz bringen.
Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

rs: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
e: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
frlg: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.
dp: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
pt: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
hgss: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.
bw: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
b2w2: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
xy: Sein Heulen hört man in 10 km Entfernung. Es gibt alle Arten von Geräuschen von sich.
Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
oras: Krawumms kann durch sein Brüllen Erdbeben auslösen. Wenn dieses Pokémon durch seine Körperöffnungen kräftig einatmet, ist es kurz davor, ein mächtiges Brüllen von sich zu geben.
Exploud triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
swsh: Einst nutzten die Menschen das Gebrüll von Krawumms zur Kommunikation zwischen weit voneinander entfernten Dörfern.
In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

rs: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.
e: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.
frlg: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.
dp: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
pt: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
hgss: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
bw: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
b2w2: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
xy: Indem es wieder und wieder Bäume rammt, erhält es einen zähen Körper und einen stahlharten Willen.
It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
oras: Makuhita ist sehr zäh. Selbst wenn es im Kampf mehrfach niedergeschlagen wurde, steht es immer wieder auf und greift seinen Gegner an. Bei jedem Mal speichert es mehr Energie in seinem Körper für seine Entwicklung.
Makuhita is tenacious—it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.
sm: Obwohl sie ursprünglich aus einer anderen Region kommen, sind Alola-Makuhita heute bekannter als ihre übrigen Artgenossen.
It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

rs: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
e: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It’s been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.
frlg: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.
dp: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
pt: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
hgss: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.
bw: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
b2w2: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
xy: Es stampft auf den Boden, um Energie zu generieren. Ein einziger Armschlag reicht aus, um einen 10 t schweren LKW durch die Luft zu wirbeln.
It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.
oras: Hariyama führt seinen berüchtigten Streckarm-Schlag überall aus. Ein Schlag von diesem Pokémon reicht aus, um einen Strommast zu zerlegen.
Hariyama practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
sm: Es ist für seine unglaubliche Stärke bekannt, lässt das Kämpfen mit dem Alter aber sein und trainiert stattdessen Makuhita.
It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

rs: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
e: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
frlg: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.
dp: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
pt: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
hgss: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.
bw: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
b2w2: It swings its large, nutrient-filled tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
xy: Dieses Pokémon lebt am Wasser. An Land bewegt es sich schnell, indem es auf seinem großen Schweif hüpft.
A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
oras: Azurill schleudert seinen Schweif wie ein Lasso weit aus und fliegt dann selbst hinterher. Ein Azurill hat es auf diese Weise geschafft, die Rekordweite von 10 m zurückzulegen.

Azurill spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
swsh: Die Kugel an seinem Schweif kann wie ein Gummiball hüpfen und steckt voller Nährstoffe, die Azurill zum Wachsen braucht.
The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.

rs: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
e: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
frlg: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.
dp: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.
pt: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
hgss: If two of these meet, they cannot get too close because their noses repel each other.
bw: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
b2w2: Its magnetic nose always faces north and draws iron objects to its body to protect itself better.
xy: Es schützt sich mit Objekten aus Eisen, die es mithilfe seiner immer nach Norden zeigenden magnetischen Nase anzieht.
Its magnetic nose always faces north and draws iron objects to its body to protect itself better.
oras: Nasgnet besitzt eine magnetische Nase, die immer nach Norden zeigt. Wenn sich zwei Nasgnet treffen, können sie sich einander nicht zuwenden, da ihre magnetischen Nasen sich gegenseitig abstoßen.
Nosepass’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
sm: Seine magnetische Nase ist unbeirrbar und erweist sich daher als ganz hervorragender Partner für Pokémon-Trainer auf Reisen.
The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.
pla: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

rs: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
e: A SKITTY’s adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
frlg: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.
dp: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
pt: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
hgss: It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.
bw: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
b2w2: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
xy: Es muss Dinge, die sich bewegen, einfach jagen. Es rennt oft im Kreis und jagt seinen eigenen Schweif.
It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
oras: Eneco ist fasziniert von Dingen, die sich bewegen, und jagt ihnen hinterher. Dieses Pokémon jagt häufig seinen eigenen Schweif, sodass ihm schwindlig wird.
Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

rs: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
e: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.
frlg: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.
dp: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
pt: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
hgss: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
bw: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
b2w2: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.
xy: Hasst schmutzige Orte. Behagt ihm ein Platz, fängt es sofort an, sein glänzendes Fell zu pflegen.
It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
oras: Enekoro liebt seine Eigenständigkeit. So kann es das tun, was es möchte, und kann selbst das Tempo bestimmen. Da dieses Pokémon schläft und isst, wenn es Lust dazu hat, ist sein Tagesablauf eher zufälliger Natur.
Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

rs: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
e: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
frlg: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
dp: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
pt: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
hgss: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
bw: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
b2w2: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
xy: Es versteckt sich im Dunkeln von Höhlen. Seine Augen sind Edelsteine.
It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
oras: Zobiris führt ein ruhiges, zurückgezogenes Leben tief im Innern einer Höhle. Es ist aber trotzdem sehr gefürchtet, da man sagt, es stehle die Seelen der Menschen, wenn seine Augen im Dunkeln furchterregend funkeln.
Sableye lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
sm: Seine Liebe zu Edelsteinen treibt es dazu, Rocara nachzustellen. Knarksel kommt ihm allerdings immer zuvor.
It’s a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.
swsh: Man sagt, es stehle die Seelen der Menschen, wenn seine Edelsteinaugen furchterregend funkeln. Viele fürchten es deswegen.
This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.

rs: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
e: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
frlg: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
dp: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
pt: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
hgss: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
bw: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
b2w2: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
xy: Mit seinem friedlichen Gesicht bringt es Gegner zur Selbstgefälligkeit und beißt anschließend mit seinem riesigen Kiefer gnadenlos zu.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
oras: Flunkifers sagenhafter Kiefer besteht aus umgewandelten Stahlhörnern. Sein unterwürfiger Gesichtsausdruck dient dazu, seinen Gegner in Sicherheit zu wiegen, sodass er unaufmerksam wird. Dann schnappt es zu!

Mawile’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, Mawile chomps it with its gaping jaws.
sm: Ein verschlagenes Pokémon, das sich niedlich gibt, um die Beute in Sicherheit zu wiegen. Dann verschlingt es diese mit seinem riesigen Kiefer.
A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.
swsh: Mit seinem friedlichen Gesicht wiegt es Gegner in Sicherheit und beißt dann mit seinem riesigen Kiefer zu. Danach gibt es kein Entkommen mehr.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

rs: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
e: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
frlg: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.
dp: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
pt: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
hgss: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.
bw: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
b2w2: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.
xy: Normalerweise lebt es in dunklen Bergen. Ist es hungrig, frisst es auch Eisenbahnschienen und Autos.
It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
oras: Dieses Pokémon hat einen Körper aus Stahl. Stollunior ernährt sich von Eisenerz aus den Bergen. Zuweilen richtet es großen Schaden an, weil es Brücken und Bahngleise auffrisst.
This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
swsh: Es frisst Eisenerz und manchmal auch Bahngleise. So bildet es einen Panzer aus Stahl, der seinen Körper schützt.
It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

rs: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
e: When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
frlg: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.
dp: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
pt: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
hgss: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
bw: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
b2w2: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.
xy: Ist verrückt nach Eisenerz. Bei Revierkämpfen stoßen Stollrak einander mit ihren Stahlkörpern.
It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
oras: Stollrak temperiert seinen Körper, indem es ausgesprochen nahrhaftes Quellwasser trinkt, bis es völlig aufgebläht ist. Dieses Pokémon baut sein Nest in der Nähe von Quellen, aus denen köstliches Wasser sprudelt.
Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
swsh: Stollrak leben in Bergen, die reich an Quellwasser und Eisenerz sind, weshalb sie oft mit Menschen in Konflikt gerieten.
Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

rs: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
e: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the AGGRON’s age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
frlg: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.
dp: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
pt: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
hgss: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.
bw: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
b2w2: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
xy: Ihre Reviere erstrecken sich über ganze Gebirge. Stolloss, die mit Narben übersät sind, sollte man besser meiden.
It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
oras: Stolloss nennt einen ganzen Berg sein Territorium. Gnadenlos schlägt es jeden in die Flucht, der sein Reich betritt. Dieses Pokémon behält sein Territorium jederzeit im Auge.
Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
swsh: Mit seinen spitzen Hörnern, die selbst massive Eisenplatten durchbohren können, rammt es seine Gegner und macht ihnen so den Garaus.
Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

rs: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
e: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
frlg: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.
dp: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
pt: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
hgss: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.
bw: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
b2w2: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
xy: Trainiert tief in den Bergen. Erhöht es seine spirituelle Kraft durch Meditation, kann es schweben.
It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
oras: Meditie unterzieht sich einem strikten mentalen Training tief in den Bergen. Wenn es meditiert, verliert es jedoch immer seine Konzentration. Deshalb wird sein Training niemals ein Ende haben.
Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

rs: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
e: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe’s actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.
frlg: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
dp: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.
pt: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
hgss: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.
bw: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
b2w2: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
xy: Es weicht Attacken elegant tänzerisch aus, um anschließend eine verheerende Attacke aus derselben Bewegung heraus zu lancieren.
It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
oras: Mittels Meditation erhöht Meditalis seine Körperenergie und schärft seinen sechsten Sinn. Dieses Pokémon verbirgt sich, indem es eins mit den Feldern und Bergen wird.
It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

rs: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
e: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
frlg: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
dp: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
pt: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
hgss: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
bw: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
b2w2: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
xy: Die Elektrizität, die es im Fell speichert, nutzt es, um seine Muskeln zu stimulieren.
Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
oras: Frizelbliz speichert Elektrizität in seiner langen Körperbehaarung. Dieses Pokémon stimuliert seine Beinmuskulatur durch Stromstöße. Dadurch ist es in der Lage, explosiv zu beschleunigen.
Electrike stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
sm: Durch die Reibung zwischen seinem Fell und der Luft entsteht Elektrizität. Wenn es rennt, verursacht es ein knisterndes Geräusch.
Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.
swsh: In seinem Fell speichert es statische Elektrizität für spätere Entladungen. Braut sich ein Sturm zusammen, entlädt es Funken.
It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

rs: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.
e: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
frlg: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
dp: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
pt: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
hgss: Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.
bw: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
b2w2: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
xy: Es zeigt sich selten den Menschen. Man sagt, dass es sein Nest baut, wo der Blitz eingeschlagen hat.
It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
oras: Voltenso entlädt ständig Elektrizität aus seiner Mähne. Es fliegen dabei Funken, die zuweilen zu Waldbränden führen. In einem Kampf erzeugt dieses Pokémon Gewitterwolken.
Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.
sm: Voltenso ist unter ungewöhnlichen Gewitterwolken zu finden. Man erzählt sich, dass es so schnell wie ein Blitz sei.
Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.
swsh: Da es seine Muskeln mit Elektrizität stimuliert, kann es sich sehr schnell bewegen. Auch Muskelkater heilt es sofort mit Strom.
It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

rs: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
e: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.
frlg: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.
dp: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
pt: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
hgss: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
bw: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
b2w2: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
xy: Es feuert Freunde mit Pompons an, die aus Funken bestehen. Es holt sich Energie aus Telegrafenmasten.
It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
oras: Plusle dient seinen Artgenossen als Cheerleader. Wenn ein Teamkamerad im Kampf erfolgreich ist, erzeugt es das prasselnde Geräusch von Funken, um so seine Freude zu zeigen.
Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

rs: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
e: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will promote circulation and boost vitality.
frlg: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.
dp: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
pt: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
hgss: Exposure to electricity from MINUN and PLUSLE promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
bw: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
b2w2: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
xy: Mit elektrischen Schlägen regen Plusle und Minun den Blutkreislauf an und lösen so Verspannungen.
Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
oras: Minun kümmert sich mehr um das Anfeuern seiner Partner als um seine eigene Sicherheit. Es nutzt die Elektrizität in seinem Körper dazu, einen Funkenregen zu erzeugen und seine Teamkameraden anzufeuern.
Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

rs: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
e: With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.
frlg: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.
dp: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.
pt: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.
hgss: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.
bw: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
b2w2: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
xy: Es kommuniziert mit anderen, indem es sein Hinterteil zum Leuchten bringt. Es liebt Illumises Duft.
It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
oras: Wenn es Nacht wird, beginnt Volbeats Schweif zu leuchten. Es kommuniziert mit anderen, indem es die Helligkeit und das Blinken dieses Lichts reguliert. Dieses Pokémon wird vom süßen Duft der Illumise angezogen.

With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.

rs: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
e: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.
frlg: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.
dp: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.
pt: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.
hgss: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
bw: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
b2w2: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
xy: Sein süßer Duft leitet Volbeat an, über 200 verschiedene Lichtmuster an den Nachthimmel zu malen.
Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
oras: Illumise zieht ganze Scharen Volbeat mit seinem süßlichen Duft an. Dann lässt es diesen hell leuchtenden Schwarm geometrische Figuren aus Licht an den Nachthimmel malen.
Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

rs: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.
e: A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.
frlg: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.
dp: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.
pt: The more healthy the ROSELIA, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.
hgss: ROSELIA that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.
bw: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.
b2w2: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
xy: Aus seinen Händen verströmt es jeweils ein anderes Gift. Je stärker Roselia duftet, desto gesünder ist es.
It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
oras: Roselia verschießt scharfe Stacheln auf jeden Feind, der versucht, die Blumen an seinen Armen zu stehlen. Der Duft dieses Pokémon beruhigt Lebewesen.
Roselia shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.
swsh: Seine Blüten verströmen einen entspannenden Duft. Je stärker dieser Duft ist, desto gesünder ist Roselia.
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.
pla: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

rs: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
e: This Pokémon’s stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.
frlg: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
dp: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
pt: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
hgss: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
bw: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
b2w2: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
xy: Sein Körper besteht fast nur aus Magen. Herz und Hirn sind winzig. Sein Magensaft verdaut alles.
It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
oras: Eigentlich besteht Schluppucks Körper nur aus einem Magen. Daher kann es etwas verschlingen, das beinahe seine Größe hat. Sein Magen enthält eine spezielle Flüssigkeit, die wirklich alles verdauen kann.
Virtually all of Gulpin’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

rs: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
e: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a SWALOT can’t digest is its own stomach.
frlg: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
dp: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
pt: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
hgss: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.
bw: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
b2w2: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
xy: Es verschluckt alles in einem Stück und sondert giftige Stoffe ab, mit denen es Gegner besprüht.
It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
oras: Wenn Schlukwech Beute sichtet, verspritzt es eine höchst giftige Substanz aus seinen Poren und besprüht damit sein Ziel. Wenn die Beute geschwächt ist, schluckt es sie mit seinem riesigen Maul im Ganzen herunter.
When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

rs: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.
e: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
frlg: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.
dp: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
pt: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
hgss: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.
bw: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
b2w2: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
xy: Schwärme von Kanivanha haben in Dschungelflüssen schon so manches Boot zerbissen und versenkt.
They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.
oras: Kanivanhas starke Kiefer und seine spitzen Zähne verfügen über die zerstörerische Kraft, Bootsrümpfe verschlingen zu können. Dieses Pokémon hat schon viele Boote versenkt.
Carvanha’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.
sm: Schwärme von Kanivanha schützen ihr Revier, indem sie sich mit gefletschten Zähnen gnadenlos auf Eindringlinge stürzen.
Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.
swsh: Kanivanha jagt Beute nicht im Alleingang, sondern wartet auf seine Artgenossen, um mit ihnen im Schwarm anzugreifen.
It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

rs: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
e: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.
frlg: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.
dp: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
pt: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
hgss: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.
bw: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
b2w2: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
xy: Seine Zähne durchdringen sogar Eisen. Es schwimmt mit 120 km/h und wird „Tyrann des Meeres“ genannt.
Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
oras: Tohaido trägt den Spitznamen „Tyrann des Meeres“ und ist sehr gefürchtet. Seine grausamen Zähne wachsen sofort nach, wenn sie ausgebrochen sind. Es kann sogar einen Öltanker zerreißen.
Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” Sharpedo is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
sm: Es jagt mit 120 km/h seine Beute und erlegt sie mithilfe seiner Zähne, die selbst Eisen durch- dringen. Sein Spitzname ist „Tyrann des Meeres“.
It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.
swsh: Wittert es Beute, schießt es Wasser aus seinem Hinterteil und jagt ihr mit einer Geschwindigkeit von 120 km/h hinterher.
As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

rs: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
e: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
frlg: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.
dp: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
pt: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
hgss: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.
bw: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
b2w2: It eats one ton of food every day. It plays by shooting stored seawater out its blowholes with great force.
xy: Es hüpft gerne wie ein Ball herum. Je mehr Meerwasser es trinkt, desto höher kann es springen.
It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.
oras: Wailmers Nasenlöcher liegen über seinen Augen. Dieses verspielte Pokémon erschreckt gern Menschen, indem es das Meerwasser, das es in seinem Körper speichert, mit aller Kraft herausprustet.
Wailmer’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
sm: Wailmer liebt es, Menschen zu erschrecken. Es trinkt so viel Meerwasser, dass es sich in einen Ball verwandeln und herumhüpfen kann.
It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.
swsh: Es prustet Meerwasser aus den Nasenlöchern, die über seinen Augen liegen. Außerdem frisst es täglich eine Tonne Lusardin.
It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

rs: WAILORD is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
e: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
frlg: It is among the largest of all Pokémon. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.
dp: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
pt: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
hgss: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.
bw: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
b2w2: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
xy: Springt es mit seinem gewaltigen Körper von einer Welle ab, kann es Gegner allein mit der Wucht des Aufpralls besiegen.
It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
oras: Wailord ist bisher das größte aller identifizierten Pokémon. Es schwimmt reglos auf dem offenen Meer und nimmt mit seinem enormen Maul riesige Mengen an Nahrung auf.
Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
sm: Wailord jagt seine Beute in der Gruppe. Mit seinem enormen Maul kann es ganze Schwärme von Lusardin auf einmal verschlingen.
Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.
swsh: Springt es mit seinem gewaltigen Körper von einer Welle ab, kann es Gegner allein mit der Wucht des Aufpralls besiegen.
It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

rs: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
e: A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
frlg: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.
dp: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
pt: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
hgss: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.
bw: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
b2w2: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
