xy: In seinem Rücken speichert es sehr heißes Magma. Regnet es, kühlt das Magma ab und es wird langsamer.
Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
oras: Camaub ist nicht besonders helle. Es nimmt nicht einmal wahr, wenn es getroffen wurde. Ein Hungergefühl allerdings kann es nicht einmal eine Sekunde lang aushalten. In seinem Körper brodelt glühend heißes Magma.
Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

rs: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
e: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.
frlg: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
dp: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
pt: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
hgss: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.
bw: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
b2w2: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
xy: Seine Vulkanhöcker brechen nur alle zehn Jahre aus oder wenn es richtig wütend ist.
The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
oras: Camerupt trägt einen Vulkan in seinem Körper. 10 000 °C heißes Magma fließt in ihm. Manchmal brechen die Höcker auf seinem Rücken aus und verspucken glühend heißes Magma.
Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

rs: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
e: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive’s horn.
frlg: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.
dp: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
pt: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
hgss: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
bw: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
b2w2: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
xy: Große Gruppen Qurtel siedeln sich in stillgelegten Bergwerken an und graben dort emsig nach Kohle.
You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
oras: Qurtel schaufelt sich auf der Suche nach Kohle durch die Berge. Wenn es welche findet, füllt es die Hohlräume seines Panzers mit Kohle und verbrennt diese. Wenn es angegriffen wird, stößt es dicken schwarzen Rauch aus.

Torkoal digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
sm: Kohle ist die Quelle seiner Energie. Ein Glück, dass in den von Qurtel bewohnten Bergen große Kohlevorkommen schlummern.
Coal is the source of Torkoal’s energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.
swsh: In seinem Panzer verbrennt es Kohle und gewinnt daraus Energie. Bei Gefahr sondert es Ruß ab.
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

rs: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
e: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn’t stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.
frlg: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.
dp: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
pt: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
hgss: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.
bw: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
b2w2: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.
xy: Es hüpft beständig umher, wobei es seinen Schweif als Feder verwendet. Nur so bleibt sein Herz aktiv.
It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
oras: Spoink hüpft auf seinem Schweif durch die Gegend. Die Erschütterung des Hüpfens bringt sein Herz zum Schlagen. Deshalb kann dieses Pokémon das Hüpfen nicht sein lassen, ansonsten würde sein Herz aufhören zu schlagen.
Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.

rs: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
e: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.
frlg: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.
dp: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
pt: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
hgss: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.
bw: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
b2w2: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.
xy: Mit schwarzen Perlen verstärkt es seine Psycho-Kräfte. Mit einem Tanz kontrolliert es seine Gegner.
It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.
oras: Groink benutzt die schwarzen Perlen an seinem Körper dazu, die psychischen Kraftwellen zu verstärken. Wenn es diese spezielle Fähigkeit nutzt, wird sein schnaubender Atem schwerfällig.
Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

rs: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.
e: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe’s aim.
frlg: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.
dp: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
pt: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
hgss: The chances of two SPINDA having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.
bw: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
b2w2: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
xy: Das Muster eines Pandir ist wie ein Fingerabdruck. Sein Taumeln senkt die gegnerische Zielsicherheit.
No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
oras: Jedes Pandir auf der Welt soll ein einzigartiges Fleckenmuster haben. Der schwankende Gang dieses Pokémon erweckt den Eindruck, es würde tanzen.
All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.
sm: Pandir hat einen unsicheren, schwankenden Gang, obwohl es sich große Mühe gibt, geradeaus zu gehen.
Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it’s walking in a straight line.

rs: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokémon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
e: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.
frlg: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.
dp: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
pt: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
hgss: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
bw: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
b2w2: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
xy: Es lebt in trockenen Wüstengebieten, wo es eine Trichterfalle baut und seelenruhig darauf wartet, dass Beute hinabrutscht.
It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.
oras: Knacklions Bau ist eine Art in den Sand gegrabener Kessel. Dieses Pokémon wartet geduldig darauf, dass Beute in seinen Bau hineinfällt. Seine gigantischen Kiefer verfügen über genügend Kraft, um einen Felsen zu zerquetschen.
Trapinch’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokémon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
sm: Knacklion kann eine Woche überleben, ohne zu essen. Es wartet geduldig in seinem Bau darauf, dass seine Beute zu ihm kommt.
It can live for a week without eating a thing. It waits patiently at the bottom of its nest for prey to appear.
swsh: Der Bau, den es sich in der Wüste errichtet, ist trichterförmig. Fällt man einmal hinein, gibt es kein Entkommen.
Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

rs: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
e: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA’s wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.
frlg: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.
dp: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
pt: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
hgss: It vibrates its wings vigorously, creating ultrasonic waves that cause serious headaches.
bw: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
b2w2: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
xy: Die Schallwellen, die es durch eine hohe Flügelschlagfrequenz erzeugt, verursachen heftige Kopfschmerzen.
The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
oras: Um seine Beute zu schwächen, erzeugt Vibrava Ultraschallwellen, indem es seine Flügel vibrieren lässt. Die Ultraschallwellen dieses Pokémon sind so stark, dass sie bei Menschen Kopfschmerzen verursachen können.
To make prey faint, Vibrava generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
sm: Vibravas Flügel sind zum Fliegen kaum geeignet. Es lässt sie vibrieren, um Ultraschallwellen zu erzeugen und so seine Gegner anzugreifen.
Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, producing ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.
swsh: Die Schallwellen, die es durch seine hohe Flügelschlagfrequenz erzeugt, verursachen heftige Kopfschmerzen.
The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

rs: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
e: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.
frlg: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
dp: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
pt: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
hgss: It is nicknamed “The Desert Spirit” because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.
bw: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
b2w2: Known as “The Desert Spirit,” this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.
xy: Es versteckt sich, indem es mit seinen Flügeln Wüstensand aufwirbelt. Rote Augenlider schützen es vor dem Sand.
It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
oras: Libelldra wird auch „Geist der Wüste“ genannt. Da seine flatternden Flügel eine Sandwolke aufwirbeln, ist dieses Pokémon beim Fliegen immer von einem Sandsturm umgeben.
Flygon is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
sm: Erzeugt mit seinem Flügelschlag Töne, die wie Gesang klingen. Der so bezirzte Gegner wird von einem Sandsturm umgeben und zu seiner Beute.
The flapping of its wings sounds something like singing. Those lured by the sound are enveloped in a sandstorm, becoming Flygon’s prey.
swsh: Da es sich stets im Zentrum des von ihm entfachten Sandsturms aufhält, bekommen Menschen es so gut wie nie zu Gesicht.
This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

rs: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
e: CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.
frlg: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
dp: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
pt: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
hgss: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
bw: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
b2w2: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
xy: Es wächst an trockenen Orten mit wenig Niederschlag. Nur einmal im Jahr bildet es eine gelbe Blüte.
It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
oras: Tuska lebt an trockenen Orten, z. B. in Wüsten. Es versprüht einen starken Duft aus seiner Blume, um Beute anzuziehen. Wenn sich Beute nähert, verschießt es scharfe Stacheln, um seinen Gegner zu überwältigen.

Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

rs: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
e: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
frlg: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.
dp: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
pt: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
hgss: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.
bw: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
b2w2: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
xy: Ein nachtaktives Pokémon, das Beute sucht, die durch die Tageshitze der Wüste bereits erschöpft ist.
It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
oras: Am Tage bleibt Noktuska reglos, damit es in der brennenden Wüstenhitze keine Feuchtigkeit verliert. Dieses Pokémon wird bei Nacht aktiv, wenn die Temperatur sinkt.
During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

rs: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
e: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
frlg: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.
dp: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.
pt: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
hgss: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.
bw: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
b2w2: For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
xy: Aus irgendeinem Grund setzt es sich gerne auf den Kopf von Menschen und tut so, als sei es ein Hut.
For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
oras: Wablu hat leichte, flauschige Flügel, die wie Schäfchenwolken aussehen. Dieses Pokémon hat keine Angst vor Menschen. Es landet auf ihren Köpfen und bleibt dort sitzen wie ein wattierter Hut.
Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
swsh: Seine watteartigen Flügel enthalten Luft und fühlen sich daher schön flauschig an. Wablu lässt keine Gelegenheit aus, sie zu pflegen.
Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

rs: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
e: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
frlg: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.
dp: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.
pt: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
hgss: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
bw: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
b2w2: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
xy: Es schwebt gemächlich durch den Himmel. Sein wunderschönes Summen gibt einem das Gefühl zu träumen.
It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
oras: Altaria tanzt und dreht sich in der Luft durch viele Schäfchenwolken. Indem es mit seiner kristallklaren Stimme Melodien singt, versetzt es seine Zuhörer in verträumtes Erstaunen.
Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
swsh: Es schwebt gemächlich durch die Lüfte und lässt dabei ein wunderschönes Summen ertönen, das alle in seinen Bann zieht, die es hören.
As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

rs: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
e: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any SEVIPER.
frlg: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.
dp: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
pt: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
hgss: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a SEVIPER nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.
bw: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
b2w2: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.
xy: Seit Generationen ist es mit Vipitis verfeindet. Seine scharfen Klauen sind seine stärksten Waffen.
It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
oras: Die Erinnerungen an den Kampf mit seinem Erzrivalen Vipitis haben sich in jede Zelle von Sengos Körper eingebrannt. Dieses Pokémon weicht feindlichen Angriffen unheimlich raffiniert und geschickt aus.
Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

rs: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword- edged tail.
e: SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals. It counters a ZANGOOSE’s dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.
frlg: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.
dp: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
pt: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
hgss: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any ZANGOOSE. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
bw: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
b2w2: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.
xy: Die flinken Angriffe von Sengo kontert es mit seinem messerscharfen Schweif, aus dem Gift austritt.
In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
oras: Vipitis lebt seit Generationen in Fehde mit Sengo. Die Narben auf seinem Körper sind Zeugen grausamer Kämpfe. Dieses Pokémon greift seine Gegner mit seinem scharfkantigen Schweif an.
Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.

rs: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
e: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.
frlg: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.
dp: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
pt: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
hgss: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.
bw: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
b2w2: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.
xy: Da es in Vollmondnächten aktiv wird, sagt man ihm nach, mit den Mondphasen in Verbindung zu stehen.
Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
oras: Lunastein wurde in der Nähe eines Meteoritenkraters entdeckt. Daher nehmen einige Menschen an, dass dieses Pokémon aus dem Weltall stammt. Diese Theorie konnte allerdings bisher noch nicht belegt werden.
Lunatone was discovered at a location where a meteoroid fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
swsh: Anscheinend steht die Zunahme seiner Kraft mit den Mondphasen in Verbindung, da es bei Vollmond aktiv wird.
The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.

rs: SOLROCK is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.
e: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon’s power. On sunny days, groups of SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb its light.
frlg: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.
dp: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
pt: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
hgss: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
bw: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
b2w2: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
xy: Da es seine Energie aus Sonnenlicht gewinnt, ist es tagsüber am stärksten. Wenn es sich dreht, leuchtet es.
Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
oras: Sonnfel ist eine neue Pokémon-Art, die angeblich aus dem Weltall kam. Es gleitet durch die Luft und bewegt sich leise. Im Kampf setzt dieses Pokémon sehr helles Licht ein.
Solrock is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.
swsh: Es rotiert um die eigene Achse und strahlt dabei sonnengleiches Licht aus, mit dem es den Gegner blendet.
When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

rs: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
e: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH’s body.
frlg: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.
dp: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
pt: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
hgss: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.
bw: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
b2w2: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
xy: Es bedeckt seinen Körper mit einer schleimigen Substanz und kann sich so aus Umklammerungen winden.
It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
oras: Schmerbes empfindliche Barthaare dienen ihm als hervorragendes Radarsystem. Dieses Pokémon versteckt sich im Schlamm, sodass nur noch seine Barthaare herausgucken, und wartet auf Beute.
Barboach’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
sm: Seine zwei Barthaare dienen als empfindliches Radarsystem. Selbst in schlammigem Wasser kennt es so die Position seiner Beute.
Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.
swsh: Sein schleimiger Körper ist schwer zu greifen. In einer Region sagt man, es sei aus gehärtetem Schlamm entstanden.
Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
pla: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

rs: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokémon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
e: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
frlg: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.
dp: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting off tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.
pt: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
hgss: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
bw: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
b2w2: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
xy: Sein Revier hat es im Sumpfland. Nähert sich ein Feind, zappelt es wie wild und erzeugt so Erdbeben.
It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
oras: Welsar legt viel Wert auf sein Territorium. Ein einzelnes Pokémon dieser Art nennt einen Teich sein Eigen. Wenn sich ein Feind nähert, schlägt es um sich und verursacht ein gewaltiges Erdbeben.
Whiscash is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokémon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
sm: Es frisst einfach alles, was ihm vor die Kiemen kommt. Normalerweise verharrt es im Schlamm und wartet auf Beute.
A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon baut sein Nest am Grund von Sümpfen. Es ist ein Vielfraß und verspeist Lebewesen aller Art.
It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.
pla: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

rs: CORPHISH were originally foreign Pokémon that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This Pokémon is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
e: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.
frlg: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.
dp: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
pt: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
hgss: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.
bw: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
b2w2: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
xy: Egal, wie schmutzig der Fluss ist, in dem sie leben, sie passen sich daran an und vermehren sich. Sie sind hart im Nehmen.
No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
oras: Krebscorps ist kein heimisches Pokémon, sondern wurde als Haustier importiert. Schließlich verwilderte es. Dieses Pokémon ist mittlerweile sehr robust und hat seine Population vergrößert.
Corphish were originally foreign Pokémon that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This Pokémon is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
sm: Da immer mehr Krebscorps von überforderten Trainern in die Freiheit entlassen werden, sieht man dieses Pokémon nun auch oft in Alola.
Individuals that have been set free by Trainers who could no longer raise them have become common, and they can now be found in Alola.
swsh: Egal, wie schmutzig der Fluss ist, in dem sie leben, sie passen sich daran an und vermehren sich. Sie sind hart im Nehmen.
No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

rs: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokémon, making them desolate places.
e: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran CRAWDAUNT that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.
frlg: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.
dp: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
pt: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
hgss: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.
bw: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
b2w2: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.
xy: Dieser Grobian ergreift andere Pokémon mit seinen Scheren und wirft sie aus seinem Teich.
It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
oras: Krebutack ist von Natur aus sehr gewalttätig, sodass es dauernd andere Lebewesen zum Kampf herausfordern muss. Andere Lebensformen lehnen es ab, mit diesem Pokémon in ein und demselben Teich zu leben.
Crawdaunt has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokémon, making them desolate places.
sm: Es ist ungestüm und liebt Kämpfe, doch sobald es seine Scheren verliert, wird es mutlos. Bis sie nachgewachsen sind, zittert es vor Angst.
Its temperament is rough and it loves to fight, but as soon as its pincers break off, it turns cowardly. It stays timid until they grow back.
swsh: Ein grobes Pokémon, das mit seinen riesigen Scheren wild um sich schlägt. Man sagt, dass es sehr schwer zu trainieren sei.
A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

rs: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
e: A BALTOY moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.
frlg: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
dp: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
pt: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
hgss: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some BALTOY have been seen spinning on their heads.
bw: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
b2w2: Discovered in ancient ruins, it moves by spinning around and forms a group when it finds others.
xy: Es bewegt sich, indem es auf seinem Fuß kreiselt. Vereinzelt sieht man Puppance, die kopfüber kreiseln.
It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
oras: Puppance bewegt sich, indem es sich auf seinem Fuß im Kreis dreht. In sehr alten Ruinen wurden primitive Wandmalereien entdeckt, die dieses Pokémon in Begleitung von Menschen zeigen.
Baltoy moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
sm: In Höhlen, in denen Urmenschen lebten, gibt es Wandmalereien von einem Pokémon, das wie Puppance aussieht.
Depictions of Pokémon similar to Baltoy have been found on the walls of caves where primitive humans lived.
swsh: Es bewegt sich, indem es auf seinem Fuß kreiselt. Vereinzelt sieht man auch Puppance, die dies kopfüber tun.
It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

rs: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.
e: A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon’s manipulation of psychic power.
frlg: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
dp: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
pt: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
hgss: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.
bw: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
b2w2: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
xy: Eine antike Lehmstatue, die durch ein mysteriöses Licht zum Leben erwacht ist.
An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
oras: Lepumentas sind aus Schlamm gefertigte Puppen, die von primitiven Menschen hergestellt und durch mysteriöse Strahlen zum Leben erweckt wurden. Diese Pokémon bewegen sich schwebend fort.
Claydol are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.
sm: Wenn es nass wird, schmilzt es. Fängt es an zu regnen, errichtet es mit seinen Psycho-Kräften eine schützende Hülle um seinen Körper.
If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.
swsh: Dieses rätselhafte Pokémon ist aus einer Lehmpuppe entstanden, die vor 20 000 Jahren von einem uralten Volk angefertigt wurde.
This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

rs: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
e: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.
frlg: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.
dp: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
pt: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
hgss: It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
bw: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
b2w2: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
xy: Vor 100 Millionen Jahren starb es aus. Es fängt seine Beute mit als Blüte getarnten Tentakeln.
It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
oras: Von Liliep nahm man an, es sei seit etwa 100 Millionen Jahren ausgestorben. Mit seinen wie Blütenblätter geformten Tentakeln heftet es sich an einen Felsen auf dem Meeresboden und fängt Beute.
Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
sm: In der Vorzeit lebte es im warmen Meer. Es tarnte sich als Seegras, um Beute aufzulauern und sie dann zu verschlingen.
In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon wurde aus einem Fossil wiederbelebt. Vor etwa 100 Millionen Jahren war es in warmen Meeren zu Hause.
This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.

rs: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
e: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. CRADILY can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.
frlg: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.
dp: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
pt: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
hgss: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.
bw: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
b2w2: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
xy: Es lebt in seichten Stellen warmer Meere. Bei Ebbe sucht es im Sand nach Beute.
It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
oras: Wielie sucht den Meeresboden nach Beute ab. Dieses Pokémon fährt seinen baumstammartigen Nacken aus und fängt mit seinen acht Tentakeln Beute.
Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
sm: Es lebte für gewöhnlich an seichten Stellen im Meer. Bei Ebbe kam es an Land, um nach Beute zu suchen.
Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.
swsh: Durch die kurzen Beine läuft Wielie nur langsam, doch um ferne Beute zu fangen, kann es Hals und Tentakel auf die dreifache Länge ausstrecken.
It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.

rs: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
e: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.
frlg: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
dp: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
pt: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
hgss: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.
bw: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
b2w2: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
xy: Es ist eine Art Vorfahre der Pokémon. Mit seinen erweiterten Scheren geht es zwischen den Felsen am Meeresgrund auf Beutefang.
It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
oras: Anorith wurde aus einem prähistorischen Fossil erzeugt. Dieses primitive Pokémon lebte einst in warmen Gewässern. Es klemmt seine Beute fest zwischen seine beiden riesigen Klauen ein.
Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
sm: Wenn man es aus einem Fossil wiederherstellt und ins Meer entlässt, geht es ihm dort nicht gut, da die Wasserqualität sich verändert hat.
When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don’t thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.
swsh: Es wurde aus einem Fossil wiederbelebt. Vor circa 100 Millionen Jahren war es im Meer zu Hause, wo es mit seinen beiden Klauen auf Jagd ging.
This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

rs: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
e: ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.
frlg: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.
dp: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
pt: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
hgss: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
bw: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
b2w2: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
xy: Es spießt die Beute mit seinen Scheren auf, ehe es sie verspeist. Den Körper umgibt ein robuster Panzer.
Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
oras: Von Armaldos hartem Panzer prallen alle Angriffe ab. Dieses Pokémon hat zwei mächtige Klauen, die es ausfahren oder einziehen kann. Es hat so viel Kraft, dass es damit eine Stahlplatte pulverisieren kann.
Armaldo’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
sm: Es lebte an Land und jagte im Meer nach Beute. Seine scharfen Klauen waren seine größte Waffe.
It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.
swsh: Nach seiner Entwicklung ging es an Land, sodass sich sein Unterkörper verstärkte. Ein Hieb seines Schweifs besitzt gewaltige Zerstörungskraft.
After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

rs: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
e: FEEBAS live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few TRAINERS raise it.
frlg: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.
dp: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.
pt: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
hgss: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.
bw: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
b2w2: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
xy: Es frisst einfach alles und kann daher auch in verschmutzter Umgebung leben. Niemand beachtet es.
It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.
oras: Barschwas Flossen waren schon immer zerfetzt. Wegen seines merkwürdigen Aussehens wird dieses Pokémon weitgehend ignoriert. Es kann sowohl im Meer als auch in Flüssen leben.
Feebas’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
sm: Dieses robuste Pokémon fühlt sich selbst in verschmutztem Wasser wohl. So schäbig und zerfetzt es ist, so unbeliebt ist es auch.
A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn’t popular.
swsh: Sein unvorteilhaftes Aussehen macht es zwar unbeliebt, doch seine erstaunliche Lebenskraft hat das Interesse der Forscher an ihm geweckt.
Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

rs: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
e: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.
frlg: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.
dp: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.
pt: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
hgss: It’s said that a glimpse of a MILOTIC and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
bw: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
b2w2: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
xy: Milotic ist atemberaubend schön. Man sagt, dass diejenigen, die es sehen, vergessen zu kämpfen.
Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.
oras: Milotic soll das schönste aller Pokémon sein. Es hat die Macht, Emotionen wie Wut und Feindseligkeit zu besänftigen und somit erbitterten Streit zu vermeiden.
Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
sm: Milotic soll das schönste aller Pokémon sein. Es hat schon so manchem Künstler als Quelle der Inspiration gedient.
Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
swsh: Milotic soll das schönste aller Pokémon sein. Es hat schon so manchem Künstler als Quelle der Inspiration gedient.
Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

rs: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
e: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
frlg: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.
dp: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
pt: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
hgss: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.
bw: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
b2w2: Temperature and weather affect its cellular structure, so this Pokémon changes form according to the weather.
xy: Formeo kann seine Gestalt ändern. Seine Zellen reagieren auf Temperaturschwankungen und Feuchtigkeit.
This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.
oras: Formeos Erscheinung ändert sich mit dem Wetter. Dieses Pokémon hat die Fähigkeit erworben, die mächtige Kraft der Natur zu nutzen, um seinen winzigen Körper zu schützen.
Castform’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
sm: Es ändert seine Erscheinung je nach Wetter. Seine Zellen reagieren anscheinend auf Temperatur- und Feuchtigkeitsschwankungen.
It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

rs: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
e: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A KECLEON reverts to its original colors if it is startled.
frlg: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.
dp: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
pt: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
hgss: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.
bw: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
b2w2: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
xy: Es kann nach Belieben seine Farbe ändern. Nur das gezackte Muster auf seinem Bauch bleibt gleich.
It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
oras: Kecleon kann die Farbe seines Körpers bei Bedarf verändern, um sich seiner Umgebung anzupassen. Es gibt allerdings eine Ausnahme: Das Zickzackmuster auf seinem Bauch kann es nicht verändern.
Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception—this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
sm: Es kann mit der Umgebung verschmelzen, indem es seine Farbe ändert. Wenn man es längere Zeit ignoriert, macht es sich schmollend unsichtbar.
It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.

rs: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
e: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.
frlg: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.
dp: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
pt: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
hgss: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
bw: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
b2w2: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.
xy: Man sagt, durch sein Horn ernähre es sich von Rachsucht und Neid. Erst nachts wird es richtig aktiv.
It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice-- or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
oras: Shuppet wird durch Gefühle wie Neid und Rachsucht angezogen. Wenn jemand starke Rachegelüste entwickelt, erscheinen diese Pokémon in Scharen und reihen sich unter der Dachrinne des Hauses dieser Person auf.

Shuppet is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
sm: Da es sich von Gefühlen wie Rachsucht, Neid und Eifersucht ernährt, sind die Menschen für die Existenz dieses Pokémon dankbar.
It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.

rs: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
e: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.
frlg: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.
dp: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
pt: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
hgss: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.
bw: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
b2w2: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge of being thrown away. It seeks the child who disowned it.
xy: Dieses Pokémon war eine Puppe, die weggeworfen wurde. Es sucht nun das Kind, das dies getan hat.
A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
oras: Banette belegt andere mit Flüchen, indem es Nadeln in seinen eigenen Körper sticht. Dieses Pokémon war ursprünglich eine mitleiderregende Plüschpuppe, die weggeworfen wurde.
Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
sm: Einst als Plüschpuppe weggeworfen, ist dieses hasserfüllte Pokémon auf der Suche nach dem Täter, um sich an ihm zu rächen.
It’s a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.

rs: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
e: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.
frlg: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.
dp: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
pt: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
hgss: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.
bw: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
b2w2: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
xy: Verbissen verfolgt es seine Beute überallhin. Doch sobald die Sonne aufgeht, ist die Jagd vorbei.
It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
oras: Zwirrlicht kann durch jede Wand gehen, egal, wie dick diese ist. Wenn dieses Pokémon sich ein Ziel gesucht hat, verfolgt es seinen Feind unnachgiebig bis zum Sonnenaufgang.
Duskull can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
swsh: Man sagt, es suche sich unartige Kinder und verschleppe sie nachts an einen unbekannten Ort.
If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.
pla: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

rs: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
e: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.
frlg: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
dp: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.
pt: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
hgss: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
bw: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
b2w2: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
xy: Blickt man direkt in den Feuerball in seinem Inneren, wird einem die Seele ausgesaugt.
Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
oras: Zwirrklops Körper ist komplett hohl. Es wird auch mit einem Schwarzen Loch verglichen. Dieses Pokémon nimmt alles in seinem Körper auf, es kommt jedoch nichts wieder heraus.

Dusclops’s body is completely hollow—there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
swsh: Sein Körper ist vollkommen hohl. Wenn es sein Maul öffnet, saugt es wie ein schwarzes Loch alles in sich auf.
Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
pla: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

rs: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
e: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.
frlg: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
dp: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.
pt: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
hgss: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.
bw: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
b2w2: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.
xy: Es nutzt seine großen Blätter als Flügel und verteilt die süßen Früchte, die an seinem Hals wachsen, an Kinder.
It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.
oras: Die Früchte am Hals von Tropius sind bei Kindern sehr beliebt. Dieses Pokémon liebt Früchte und isst sie ständig. Offensichtlich sind ihm wegen dieser Vorliebe selbst Früchte gewachsen.
The bunches of fruit around Tropius’s neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
sm: Die Früchte, die am Hals der in Alola lebenden Tropius hängen, sind die besten, denn sie sind süßer als die in anderen Regionen.
The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

rs: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
e: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.
frlg: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.
dp: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.
pt: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
hgss: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
bw: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
b2w2: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
xy: Mit seinem Saugnapf hängt es sich an Äste oder unter Vordächer. Es kennt sieben verschiedene Schreie.
It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
oras: Palimpalims Schreie hallen durch seinen hohlen Körper. Wenn dieses Pokémon wütend wird, erzeugen seine Schreie Ultraschallwellen, die seine Feinde buchstäblich wegfegen können.
Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
pla: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

rs: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.
e: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.
frlg: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.
dp: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
pt: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
hgss: It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.
bw: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
b2w2: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.
xy: Es spürt drohende Katastrophen und erscheint nur dann, wenn es andere vor der Gefahr warnen will.
It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
oras: Jedes Mal, wenn Absol sich den Menschen zeigt, endet dies in einer Katastrophe wie Erdbeben oder Sturmflut. Deswegen ist es auch als das Desaster-Pokémon bekannt.
Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.
sm: Aus Aberglauben war Absol einst als Unheilsbote verhasst und wurde in die tiefsten Berge vertrieben.
Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.
swsh: Schnell wie der Wind rauscht es über Felder und Berge. Sein gebogenes Horn ist sehr sensibel gegenüber herannahenden Naturkatastrophen.
Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

rs: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
e: A WYNAUT loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.
frlg: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
dp: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
pt: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
hgss: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
bw: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
b2w2: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
xy: Es zieht normalerweise im Rudel umher. Zum Schlafen drängen sie sich ganz eng in einer Höhle zusammen.
It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
oras: Isso hat immer ein breites, fröhliches Lächeln auf seinem Gesicht. Um festzustellen, ob es wütend ist, muss man seinen Schweif betrachten. Wenn es wütend ist, schlägt es damit auf den Boden.
Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
swsh: Isso bleiben immer im Rudel und schubsen einander spielerisch, um ihre Ausdauer zu trainieren.
It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

rs: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
e: They tend to move about in groups of around five SNORUNT. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
frlg: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.
dp: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.
pt: It is said that several SNORUNT gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
hgss: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.
bw: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
b2w2: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
xy: Gerüchten zufolge sammeln sich Schneppke unter riesigen Blättern und leben dort friedlich zusammen.
It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
oras: Schneppke lebt in Gebieten mit heftigem Schneefall. In Jahreszeiten, in denen es nicht schneit, wie im Frühling oder im Sommer, nimmt das Pokémon Reißaus, um in einer Höhle ein ruhiges Leben zwischen Stalaktiten und Stalagmiten zu führen.
Snorunt live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
sm: Schneppke hat sich rasant in Alola verbreitet. Es heißt, das Haus, in dem es lebt, werde über viele Generationen blühen und gedeihen.
Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.
swsh: Erscheint es mitten in der Nacht, so sagt man, steht starker Schneefall bevor. Es ernährt sich von Eis und Schnee.
It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.
pla: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

rs: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
e: A GLALIE has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.
frlg: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
dp: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
pt: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
hgss: It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.
bw: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
b2w2: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
xy: Um sich zu schützen, umgibt es seinen Körper mit einer Rüstung aus Eis.
To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
oras: Firnontor hat einen Körper aus Stein, den es mit einem Panzer aus Eis noch verstärkt. Dieses Pokémon kann die Luftfeuchtigkeit der Atmosphäre einfrieren und in jegliche Form verwandeln.
Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
sm: Man sagt, Firnontor sei aus dem Unmut verunglückter Bergsteiger geboren, der von einem Felsen Besitz ergriff.
Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.
swsh: Seinen Eiskörper bringt nichts zum Schmelzen, auch Feuer nicht. Es kann Feuchtigkeit in der Luft sofort in Eis verwandeln.
It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
pla: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

rs: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
e: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
frlg: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.
dp: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
pt: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
hgss: It crosses the oceans by rolling itself on drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm when the temperature is below freezing.
bw: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
b2w2: They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
xy: Es ist noch kein guter Schwimmer und bewegt sich rollend schneller fort. Ist es froh, klatscht es mit seinen Flossen.
They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
oras: Seemops kann schneller rollen als laufen. Wenn Gruppen dieses Pokémon zusammen essen, klatschen sie gleichzeitig, um ihre Freude zu zeigen. Deswegen sind ihre Mahlzeiten sehr laut.
Spheal is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
swsh: Der Körper von Seemops ist kugelrund und von einer dicken Speckschicht umgeben. Es kann schneller rollen als laufen.
This Pokémon’s body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It’s faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.
pla: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

rs: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
e: SEALEO live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.
frlg: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.
dp: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
pt: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
hgss: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
bw: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
b2w2: Be it Spheal or Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.
xy: Die Nerven in seiner Nase sind sehr empfindlich. Sieht es etwas Neues, berührt es es zuerst mit der Nase.
It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
oras: Seejong hat die Angewohnheit, alles, was es zum ersten Mal sieht, auf seiner Nasenspitze zu jonglieren. Dieses Pokémon hält sich bei Laune, indem es manchmal ein Seemops auf seiner Nase balanciert und hin- und herrollt.
Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a Spheal on its nose.
swsh: Seejong lebt auf Eisschollen. Wittert es beim Schwimmen Beute, spürt es sie auf und schnappt sie sich.
Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimming when they’re on the hunt, seeking out their prey by scent.
pla: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

rs: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This Pokémon’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
e: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.
frlg: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.
dp: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
pt: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
hgss: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.
bw: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
b2w2: Not only does its thick blubber keep it warm, it also protects it from attacks. It shatters ice with its prized tusks.
xy: Mit seinen Stoßzähnen bricht es durch Eis. Eine Speckschicht schützt es vor Kälte und Angriffen.
It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
oras: Walraisa hat zwei massive Stoßzähne, die mit einem Hieb Eisblöcke zertrümmern können, die bis zu 10 t wiegen. Es besitzt eine dicke Speckschicht, die es vor eisigen Temperaturen schützt.
Walrein’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing 10 tons with one blow. This Pokémon’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
swsh: Es bildet mit 20 bis 30 Artgenossen eine Herde. Wird diese angegriffen, verteidigt der Anführer sie unter Einsatz seines Lebens.
