Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals. When a threat appears, the herd’s leader will protect the group with its life.
pla: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

rs: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
e: A CLAMPERL slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.
frlg: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.
dp: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
pt: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
hgss: When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.
bw: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
b2w2: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
xy: Es entwickelt sich nur einmal im Leben, wobei es eine wundersame Perle erzeugt, die Psycho-Kräfte verstärkt.
When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.
oras: Perlus kräftige Schale dient nicht nur dem Schutz, es nutzt sie auch zum Fangen von Beute. Die Schale eines ausgewachsenen Perlu weist viele Kerben und Kratzer auf.
Clamperl’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection—it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
sm: Dieses fleischfressende Pokémon klemmt seine Beute mit seiner Schale fest und lässt sie erst los, wenn sie sich nicht mehr rührt.
Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.

rs: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
e: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.
frlg: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.
dp: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
pt: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
hgss: It lives deep in the pitch-dark sea. It attracts prey by moving its tail in mimicry of a small animal.
bw: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
b2w2: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
xy: Es lebt tief im Meer, wo Sonnenlicht nie vordringt. Beim Beutefang leuchtet sein fischartiger Schwanz, um Beute anzulocken.
It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.
oras: Aalabyss entging lange der Aufmerksamkeit des Menschen, da es in extremen Tiefen des Meeres lebt. Die Augen dieses Pokémon können selbst in den dunklen und trüben Tiefen des Meeres einwandfrei sehen.
Huntail’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
sm: Schwimmen ist nicht seine Stärke. Es schwingt seinen Schweif, um Beute anzulocken und verschluckt sie im Ganzen, wenn sie sich nähert.
It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.

rs: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
e: A GOREBYSS siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.
frlg: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.
dp: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
pt: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
hgss: Its pink body becomes more vivid with the rise of water temperatures in the springtime.
bw: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
b2w2: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
xy: Es lebt auf dem Grund des Meeres. Im Frühling wirkt die Farbe seines Körpers viel kräftiger.
It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
oras: Saganabyss lebt in extremen Tiefen des Südmeeres. Sein Körper ist so angelegt, dass er dem enormen Wasserdruck dieser unglaublichen Tiefe standhalten kann. Daher übersteht dieses Pokémon gewöhnliche Attacken unbeschadet.

Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
sm: Die Farbe seines Körpers ändert sich je nach Wassertemperatur. In Alola verfügt es über eine fast schon blendend grelle Färbung.
The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.

rs: RELICANTH is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
e: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.
frlg: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.
dp: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
pt: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
hgss: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.
bw: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
b2w2: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
xy: 100 Millionen Jahre lang blieb es unverändert. Es wurde bei einer Tiefsee-Tauchexpedition entdeckt.
It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.
oras: Relicanth ist eine Pokémon-Art, die seit 100 Millionen Jahren existiert, ohne jemals ihre Form zu verändern. Dieses prähistorische Pokémon hat ein zahnloses Maul und ernährt sich von Mikroorganismen.
Relicanth is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
sm: Relicanth existiert seit 100 Millionen Jahren in unveränderter Form. Dank seines Körperfetts hält es dem Wasserdruck der Tiefsee stand.
Its form has remained the same for one hundred million years. Its body is filled with fat, so it can withstand the water pressure of the deep sea.
swsh: Dank seiner steinharten Schuppen und mit Fett gefüllten Schwimmblasen kann es dem Wasserdruck der Tiefsee standhalten.
Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

rs: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
e: LUVDISC make the branches of CORSOLA their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a LUVDISC as a gift to express one’s feelings of love.
frlg: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.
dp: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
pt: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
hgss: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a LUVDISC to someone you love.
bw: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
b2w2: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
xy: Es lebt in warmen Meeren. Man sagt, dass Verliebte, die es sehen, mit ewiger Liebe gesegnet sind.
It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
oras: Liebiskus lebt in den seichten Gewässern der Tropen. Dieses herzförmige Pokémon verdankt seinen Namen der Tatsache, dass es hinter Liebespaaren herschwamm, die es in den Wellen des Ozeans beobachtet hatte.
Luvdisc live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
sm: Einsame Liebiskus verlieren den Lebensmut und vernachlässigen die Deckung. Diese Schwäche nutzen Pelipper, um sie sich zu schnappen.
If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes despondent, leaving itself open to attack. That is when Pelipper snatch them up.

rs: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
e: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.
frlg: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.
dp: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
pt: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
hgss: Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike head can smash boulders into pieces.
bw: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
b2w2: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
xy: Mit seinen robusten Nackenmuskeln und seinem stahlharten Kopf kann es sogar Felsen zertrümmern.
Its well-developed neck muscles and iron-like head can smash boulders into pieces.
oras: Kindwurm hat den Traum, fliegen zu können. In zahlreichen vergeblichen Versuchen stürzte es sich die Klippen herunter. Daher ist sein Kopf sehr robust und so hart wie Stahl geworden.
Bagon has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
sm: Es liegt wohl an den Erbinformationen in seinen Genen, dass es glaubt, eines Tages fliegen zu können.
Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.
swsh: In der Hoffnung, eines Tages fliegen zu können, stürzt es sich täglich von Klippen, um seinen Körper zu stählen.
Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.

rs: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
e: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.
frlg: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.
dp: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
pt: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
hgss: It surrounds its body in an iron-hard shell to accumulate enough power to evolve.
bw: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
b2w2: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
xy: Die Zellen seines Panzers fingen an, sich zu verändern. Er fällt ab, sobald sich das Pokémon entwickelt.
Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
oras: In Draschels panzerartiger Schale vollziehen seine Zellen eine Transformation, um einen völlig neuen Körper zu bilden. Die Schale dieses Pokémon ist ausgesprochen schwer, sodass seine Bewegungen träge wirken.
Inside Shelgon’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
sm: In Draschels Schale vollziehen seine Zellen in Vorbereitung auf seine Entwicklung eine explosionsartige Transformation.
The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.
swsh: Es hüllt seinen Körper in eine harte Schale, die Knochengewebe gleicht, und sammelt so Energie für seine Entwicklung.
This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.

rs: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
e: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
frlg: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
dp: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
pt: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
hgss: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.
bw: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
b2w2: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
xy: Wenn es wütend ist, gerät es außer Kontrolle. Es zerstört alles mit seinen Klauen und mit Feuer.
It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
oras: Es träumte sehr lange davon, dass ihm Flügel wachsen mögen. Dieser sehnliche Wunsch hat wohl eine plötzliche Mutation in den Zellen dieses Pokémon hervorgerufen, sodass ihm plötzlich prächtige Flügel wuchsen.

Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
sm: Wenn es wütend ist, kann es nicht mehr klar denken und zerstört alles um sich herum. Das tut es bis zur völligen Erschöpfung.
When angered, it loses all sense of itself and destroys everything around it. The destruction will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.
swsh: Diesem ungewöhnlichen Pokémon sind im Zuge seiner Entwicklung Flügel gewachsen, nur weil es den sehnlichen Wunsch hatte, fliegen zu können.
Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.

rs: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
e: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
frlg: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
dp: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
pt: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
hgss: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
bw: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
b2w2: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.
xy: Es fliegt, indem es eine magnetische Kraft erzeugt, durch die es der natürlichen Anziehungskraft der Erde trotzt.
The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
oras: Anstelle von Blut fließt eine starke magnetische Energie durch Tanhels Körper. Dieses Pokémon kommuniziert mit anderen, indem es kontrollierte magnetische Impulse aussendet.
Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout Beldum’s body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
sm: Seine Zellen sind magnetisch geladen. Es kommuniziert mit anderen, indem es magnetische Impulse aussendet.
Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.
swsh: Mit der Magnetkraft, die es an seinem Hinterteil erzeugt, zieht es Gegner ruckartig zu sich heran, um sie mit seinen scharfen Krallen aufzuspießen.
From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.

rs: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.
e: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
frlg: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.
dp: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
pt: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
hgss: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
bw: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
b2w2: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.
xy: Das Pokémon besteht aus zwei Tanhel. Es bekommt selbst dann keinen Kratzer, wenn ein Jet es streift.
It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
oras: Wenn zwei Tanhel miteinander verschmelzen, entsteht daraus Metang. Die Gehirne der Tanhel werden mit einem magnetischen Nervensystem verbunden. Dadurch erzeugt es starke psychokinetische Energie.

When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.
sm: Zwei Tanhel haben sich vereinigt und so ihre Psycho-Kräfte verdoppelt. Ihre Denkfähigkeit bleibt dabei aber unverändert.
When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.
swsh: Durch Magnetismus verschmolzen zwei Tanhel miteinander. Da es nun zwei Gehirne besitzt, haben sich seine Psycho-Kräfte verdoppelt.
Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

rs: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
e: METAGROSS has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.
frlg: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
dp: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
pt: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
hgss: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
bw: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
b2w2: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
xy: Dank seiner vier vernetzten Hirne kann es Gegner besser als ein Supercomputer mit komplizierten Formeln analysieren.
With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
oras: Metagross hat insgesamt vier Gehirne. Diese können schwierige Berechnungen schneller durchführen als ein Supercomputer. Dieses Pokémon kann durch die Lüfte schweben, indem es seine vier Beine einklappt.
Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
sm: Mit seinen spitzen Beinkrallen und dem massigen Körper drückt es seine Beute zu Boden und zerkaut sie dann mit seinen Zähnen am Bauch.
It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.
swsh: Metagross, die auf verschneiten Bergen leben, sind besonders aktiv, da Temperaturen unter dem Gefrierpunkt ihren Magnetismus verstärken.
Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

rs: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
e: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by adding new rocks.
frlg: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
dp: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
pt: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
hgss: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.
bw: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
b2w2: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
xy: Sein Körper besteht aus Stein. Bricht im Kampf etwas heraus, wird es durch Stein wieder ersetzt.
Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
oras: Regirock wurde vor langer Zeit von Menschen weggeschlossen. Wenn der Körper dieses Pokémon im Kampf Schaden nimmt, sucht es nach passenden Steinen, um sich selbst zu reparieren.
Regirock was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
swsh: Sein Körper besteht vollständig aus Steinen. Wenn Teile davon abbröckeln, ersetzt Regirock diese einfach durch neue Steine.
Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.

rs: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
e: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.
frlg: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.
dp: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
pt: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
hgss: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
bw: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
b2w2: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
xy: Es heißt, es habe Jahrtausende lang im ewigen Eis geschlummert. Selbst Magma schmilzt es nicht.
It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
oras: Regices tiefgefrorener Körper entstand während der Eiszeit. Es kann nicht einmal durch Feuer geschmolzen werden. Dieses Pokémon kontrolliert eisige Luft von -200 °C.
Regice’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
swsh: Regice kontrolliert bis zu -200 ºC kalte Luft, mit der es alles und jeden in seiner Nähe im Handumdrehen gefrieren lässt.
With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

rs: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.
e: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.
frlg: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.
dp: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
pt: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
hgss: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.
bw: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
b2w2: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
xy: Im Laufe der Jahrtausende, die es unterirdisch lebte, wurde sein Körper durch Druck und Wärme hart.
Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
oras: Registeel hat einen Körper, der härter ist als jede Art von Metall. Sein Körper scheint hohl zu sein. Niemand hat eine Ahnung, was dieses Pokémon wohl frisst.
Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.
swsh: Es besteht aus einer seltsamen Substanz, die robuster als jedes Metall, jedoch zugleich auch weich und elastisch ist.
Registeel’s body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

rs: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
e: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.
frlg: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
dp: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
pt: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
hgss: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
bw: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
b2w2: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
xy: Es kommuniziert durch Telepathie. Sein Daunenkleid bricht das Licht, sodass es unsichtbar wird.
It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
oras: Latias ist in höchstem Maße empfindlich gegenüber den Emotionen der Menschen. Wenn es einen Anflug von Feindseligkeit wahrnimmt, werden seine Federn zerzaust und es stößt schrille Schreie aus, um seinen Gegner einzuschüchtern.
Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

rs: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
e: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.
frlg: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
dp: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
pt: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
hgss: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
bw: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
b2w2: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
xy: Ein hochintelligentes Pokémon. Wenn es im Flug seine Flügel nach hinten legt, ist es schneller als ein Jet.
A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
oras: Latios kann seinem Gegenüber ein Bild von etwas, das es einmal gesehen hat, in den Kopf projizieren. Dieses Pokémon ist intelligent und es versteht die menschliche Sprache.
Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.

rs: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This Pokémon saved people who were suffering from droughts.
e: KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
frlg: This Pokémon is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.
dp: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
pt: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
hgss: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.
bw: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
b2w2: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
xy: Der Legende nach erschuf sein Regen das Meer. Es und Groudon lieferten sich einen langen Kampf.
A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
oras: Mithilfe von Naturenergie kann es eine Protomorphose durchführen und so seine ursprüngliche Form zurückerlangen. Dadurch kann es Stürme erzeugen und das Meer vergrößern.
Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

rs: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the Pokémon that raised lands and expanded continents. This Pokémon took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
e: GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.
frlg: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.
dp: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
pt: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
hgss: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with KYOGRE.
bw: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
b2w2: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
xy: Sein Feuer erschuf einst das Land. Es und Kyogre lieferten sich einen langen Kampf.
Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
oras: Es heißt, Groudon sei die Personifizierung des Landes. Legenden zufolge hat es in seinem Bestreben, sich die Naturenergie anzueignen, viele Male gegen Kyogre gekämpft.
Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

rs: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This Pokémon appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
e: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON were to fight.
frlg: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.
dp: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
pt: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
hgss: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
bw: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
b2w2: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
xy: Es lebt in der Ozonschicht hoch über den Wolken und kann vom Boden aus nicht gesehen werden.
It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
oras: Es heißt, Rayquaza lebe bereits seit mehreren hundert Millionen Jahren. Legenden zufolge hat es den einstigen Konflikt zwischen Groudon und Kyogre beendet.
Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.

rs: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokémon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
e: JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.
frlg: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.
dp: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
pt: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
hgss: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
bw: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
b2w2: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
xy: Wenn Jirachi erwacht, erfüllt es die Wünsche, die man auf die Zettel an seinem Kopf geschrieben hat.
Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
oras: Einer Legende nach erfüllt Jirachi jeden Wunsch, der auf einen Notizzettel an seinem Kopf geschrieben wird. Wenn dieses Pokémon Gefahr wittert, kämpft es bereits, bevor es überhaupt aufgewacht ist.
A legend states that Jirachi will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokémon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
swsh: Durch den Klang einer reinen Singstimme kann es ein Mal alle 1 000 Jahre für genau sieben Tage aus seinem Schlaf erwachen.
Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

rs: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.
e: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
frlg: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
dp: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
pt: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
hgss: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
bw: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
b2w2: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
xy: Ein außerirdischer Virus kam mit einem Meteor auf die Erde. Seine DNA mutierte. So entstand Deoxys.
An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
oras: Die DNS eines Weltraumvirus hat eine spontane Mutation erfahren, da sie einem Laserstrahl ausgesetzt wurde. Daraus entstand Deoxys. Das kristallartige Organ auf der Brust dieses Pokémon ist sein Gehirn.
The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.

dp: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
pt: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.
hgss: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
bw: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
b2w2: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
xy: Im Sonnenlicht betreibt sein ganzer Körper Photosynthese. Sein Panzer besteht aus hartem Lehm.
Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
oras: Im Sonnenlicht betreibt sein ganzer Körper Photosynthese. Sein Panzer besteht aus hartem Lehm.
Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
pla: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

dp: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
pt: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
hgss: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
bw: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
b2w2: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
xy: Es lebt in der Nähe von Wasser in Wäldern. Tagsüber verlässt es diese, um ein Sonnenbad zu nehmen.
It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
oras: Es lebt in der Nähe von Wasser in Wäldern. Tagsüber verlässt es diese, um ein Sonnenbad zu nehmen.
It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
pla: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

dp: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
pt: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA’s back and spend their entire life there.
hgss: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic TORTERRA dwelled.
bw: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
b2w2: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
xy: In alten Zeiten malten die Menschen sich aus, die Erde ruhe auf dem Rücken eines riesigen Chelterrar.
Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
oras: In alten Zeiten malten die Menschen sich aus, die Erde ruhe auf dem Rücken eines riesigen Chelterrar.
Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
pla: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

dp: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
pt: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
hgss: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
bw: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
b2w2: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
xy: Das Feuer an seinem Hinterteil wird durch Gase im Bauch genährt. Selbst Regen löscht es nicht.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
oras: Das Feuer an seinem Hinterteil wird durch Gase im Bauch genährt. Selbst Regen löscht es nicht.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
pla: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

dp: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
pt: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
hgss: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.
bw: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
b2w2: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
xy: Es kontrolliert die Stärke des Feuers auf seinem Schweif geschickt, um Gegner auf Distanz zu halten.
It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
oras: Es kontrolliert die Stärke des Feuers auf seinem Schweif geschickt, um Gegner auf Distanz zu halten.
It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
pla: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

dp: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
pt: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
hgss: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
bw: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
b2w2: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
xy: Seine Krone aus Feuer ist Zeichen seines feurigen Wesens. Niemand ist schneller im Kampf als dieses Pokémon.
Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
oras: Seine Krone aus Feuer ist Zeichen seines feurigen Wesens. Niemand ist schneller im Kampf als dieses Pokémon.
Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
pla: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

dp: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
pt: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
hgss: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
bw: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
b2w2: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
xy: Einmischung kann es gar nicht leiden. Es ist bockig und fasst nur schwer Zutrauen zu seinem Trainer.
It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
oras: Einmischung kann es gar nicht leiden. Es ist bockig und fasst nur schwer Zutrauen zu seinem Trainer.
It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
pla: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

dp: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
pt: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
hgss: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
bw: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
b2w2: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
xy: Es lebt allein, entfernt von anderen. Jedes von ihnen denkt, es sei das Bedeutendste unter ihnen.
It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
oras: Es lebt allein, entfernt von anderen. Jedes von ihnen denkt, es sei das Bedeutendste unter ihnen.
It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
pla: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

dp: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
pt: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
hgss: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.
bw: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
b2w2: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
xy: Es schwimmt so schnell wie ein Rennboot. Seine Flügel haben scharfe Seiten und können Packeis schneiden.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
oras: Es schwimmt so schnell wie ein Rennboot. Seine Flügel haben scharfe Seiten und können Packeis schneiden.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
pla: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

dp: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
pt: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
hgss: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
bw: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
b2w2: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
xy: Ihr Schwarm ist stets groß. Obwohl es kleine Pokémon sind, schwingen sie ihre Flügel mit enormer Kraft.
They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
oras: Ihr Schwarm ist stets groß. Obwohl es kleine Pokémon sind, schwingen sie ihre Flügel mit enormer Kraft.
They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
pla: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

dp: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
pt: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.
hgss: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
bw: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
b2w2: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
xy: Es neigt dazu, sich in großen Gruppen zu bewegen. Zwischen ihnen kommt es zu heftigen Kämpfen.
They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
oras: Es neigt dazu, sich in großen Gruppen zu bewegen. Zwischen ihnen kommt es zu heftigen Kämpfen.
They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
pla: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

dp: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
pt: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
hgss: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
bw: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
b2w2: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
xy: Die Muskeln in seinen Flügeln und Beinen sind stark. Es kann im Flug sogar ein anderes Pokémon tragen.
The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
oras: Die Muskeln in seinen Flügeln und Beinen sind stark. Es kann im Flug sogar ein anderes Pokémon tragen.
The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
pla: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

dp: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
pt: A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.
hgss: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.
bw: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
b2w2: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
xy: Es hat Nerven wie Drahtseile, nichts kann es erschüttern. Es ist agiler und aktiver, als es scheint.
With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
oras: Es hat Nerven wie Drahtseile, nichts kann es erschüttern. Es ist agiler und aktiver, als es scheint.
With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
pla: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

dp: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
pt: A river dammed by BIBAREL will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
hgss: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
bw: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
b2w2: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
xy: Emsig durchbeißt es mit seinen scharfen Vorderzähnen Wurzeln und Äste und baut daraus sein Nest.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
oras: Emsig durchbeißt es mit seinen scharfen Vorderzähnen Wurzeln und Äste und baut daraus sein Nest.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
pla: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

dp: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
pt: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
hgss: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
bw: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
b2w2: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
xy: Diese Pokémon unterhalten sich, indem sie ihre Antennen aneinanderschlagen. Der Ton ist ihr Kennzeichen.
It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
oras: Diese Pokémon unterhalten sich, indem sie ihre Antennen aneinanderschlagen. Der Ton ist ihr Kennzeichen.
It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
pla: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

dp: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
pt: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
hgss: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.
bw: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
b2w2: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
xy: Wenn es ruft, verschränkt es seine messerartigen Arme vor der Brust. Es komponiert aus dem Stegreif.
It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
oras: Wenn es ruft, verschränkt es seine messerartigen Arme vor der Brust. Es komponiert aus dem Stegreif.
It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
pla: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

dp: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
pt: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
hgss: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.
bw: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
b2w2: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
xy: Es erzeugt Elektrizität durch das Strecken und Zusammenziehen seiner Muskeln. Bei Bedrohung glüht es.
The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
oras: Es erzeugt Elektrizität durch das Strecken und Zusammenziehen seiner Muskeln. Bei Bedrohung glüht es.
The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
swsh: Durch Muskelkontraktionen erzeugt es Strom. Heftiges Zittern ist bei Sheinux ein Anzeichen dafür, dass es sehr viel Elektrizität generiert.
This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
pla: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

dp: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
pt: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
hgss: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.
bw: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
b2w2: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
xy: Seine Krallen geben Elektrizität ab, die stark genug ist, jemanden bewusstlos zu machen.
Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
oras: Seine Krallen geben Elektrizität ab, die stark genug ist, jemanden bewusstlos zu machen.
Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
swsh: Verbindet es seinen Schweif mit dem eines Artgenossen, absorbiert es einen Teil von dessen Elektrizität und teilt stärkere Stromschläge aus.
By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio’s electricity and power up its own electric blasts.
pla: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

dp: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
pt: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
hgss: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
bw: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
b2w2: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
xy: Leuchten seine Augen golden auf, kann es Beute, die sich versteckt, sehen. Es kann durch Wände sehen.
When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.
oras: Leuchten seine Augen golden auf, kann es Beute, die sich versteckt, sehen. Es kann durch Wände sehen.
When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey—even those taking shelter behind a wall.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon verfügt über einen Röntgenblick. So kann es im Nu Beute aufspüren, selbst wenn sich diese hinter dicken Wänden versteckt.
Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.
pla: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

dp: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
pt: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
hgss: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
bw: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
b2w2: Sensitive to changing temperatures, the bud blooms when it’s warm, releasing toxic pollen.
xy: Bei Sonnenlicht öffnet es seine Knospe und gibt Pollen ab. Es lebt in der Nähe von sauberem Wasser.
When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
oras: Bei Sonnenlicht öffnet es seine Knospe und gibt Pollen ab. Es lebt in der Nähe von sauberem Wasser.
When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
swsh: Es verstreut giftigen Pollen. Je sauberer das Wasser war, mit dem es gegossen wurde, desto stärker ist der Giftstoff.
The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.
pla: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

dp: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
pt: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
hgss: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.
bw: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
b2w2: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
xy: Es lockt seine Beute mit süßem Duft an, um sie danach mit seinen dornigen Ranken zu peitschen oder zu würgen.
Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
oras: Es lockt seine Beute mit süßem Duft an, um sie danach mit seinen dornigen Ranken zu peitschen oder zu würgen.
Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
swsh: Mit dem süßlichen Duft seiner Blüten betört es seine Gegner, bevor es sie mit dornigen Ranken heftig auspeitscht.
After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.
pla: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

dp: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
pt: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
hgss: CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.
bw: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
b2w2: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
xy: Es wurde aus einem ballartigen, eisernen Fossil geschaffen. Es schlägt Beute mit einem Kopfstoß.
It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
oras: Es wurde aus einem ballartigen, eisernen Fossil geschaffen. Es schlägt Beute mit einem Kopfstoß.
It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
sm: Vor Urzeiten lebte es im Dschungel. Mit seinem Kopfstoß setzt es sich gegen Aerodactyl zur Wehr.
It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.
pla: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

dp: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
pt: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
hgss: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
bw: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
b2w2: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
xy: Sein dicker Schädelknochen trotzt jedem Angriff. Gleichzeitig stoppt er jedoch sein Hirnwachstum.
Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
oras: Sein dicker Schädelknochen trotzt jedem Angriff. Gleichzeitig stoppt er jedoch sein Hirnwachstum.
Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
sm: Durch häufige Kopfstöße ist sein Schädel hart und dick geworden. Seine Hirnmasse litt darunter und ist kleiner als bei Koknodon.
The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos’s.
pla: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

dp: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
pt: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
hgss: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.
bw: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
b2w2: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
xy: Es reibt sein Gesicht an Baumstämmen, um es zu polieren. Es ist leicht, es von hinten anzugreifen.
It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
oras: Es reibt sein Gesicht an Baumstämmen, um es zu polieren. Es ist leicht, es von hinten anzugreifen.
It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
sm: Es wurden viele Fossilien dieses Pokémon gefunden und nur bei sehr wenigen war das Gesicht beschädigt oder fehlte ganz.
Many fossils of this Pokémon have been found, but almost none have shown signs of damage to the face.
pla: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

dp: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
pt: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
hgss: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.
bw: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
b2w2: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
xy: Stellen sie sich Seite an Seite, kann kein Gegner hindurchbrechen. So schützen sie auch ihre Jungen.
When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
oras: Stellen sie sich Seite an Seite, kann kein Gegner hindurchbrechen. So schützen sie auch ihre Jungen.
When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
sm: Alle möglichen Angriffe von vorn kann es abwehren, aber von hinten ist es schutzlos.
While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.
pla: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

dp: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
pt: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
hgss: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.
bw: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
b2w2: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
xy: Um sich vor dem eisigen Winterwind zu schützen, legt es sich unter einen Umhang aus Ästen und Laub.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
oras: Um sich vor dem eisigen Winterwind zu schützen, legt es sich unter einen Umhang aus Ästen und Laub.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
pla: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

dp: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
pt: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
hgss: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
bw: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
b2w2: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
xy: Die Umgebung, in der es sich entwickelt, bestimmt sein Aussehen. Es formt seinen Körper mithilfe der umliegenden Materialien.
Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
oras: Die Umgebung, in der es sich entwickelt, bestimmt sein Aussehen. Es formt seinen Körper mithilfe der umliegenden Materialien.
Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

dp: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
pt: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from COMBEE.
hgss: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.
bw: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
b2w2: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
xy: Es liebt Honig und stiehlt den Honig, der von Wadribie gesammelt wurde.
It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
oras: Es liebt Honig und stiehlt den Honig, der von Wadribie gesammelt wurde.
It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
pla: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

dp: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
pt: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
hgss: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.
bw: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
b2w2: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.
xy: Dieses Trio ist von Geburt an zusammen. Fleißig bringt es Blütenhonig zu Honweisel.
The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
oras: Dieses Trio ist von Geburt an zusammen. Fleißig bringt es Blütenhonig zu Honweisel.
The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
swsh: Dieses Trio ist immer zusammen, aber jedes von ihnen hat leicht andere Vorlieben, was Blütenhonig angeht.
The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.
pla: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

dp: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
pt: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
hgss: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.
bw: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
b2w2: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
xy: Es beherbergt Jung-Pokémon in seinem Rumpf, die es mithilfe von verschiedenen Pheromonen frei herumkommandieren kann.
It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
oras: Es beherbergt Jung-Pokémon in seinem Rumpf, die es mithilfe von verschiedenen Pheromonen frei herumkommandieren kann.
It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
swsh: Es hat die Kontrolle über seine Nachkommen. Diese würden im Kampf ihr Leben aufs Spiel setzen, um es vor Feinden zu schützen.
It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.
pla: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

dp: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
pt: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
hgss: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
bw: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
b2w2: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
xy: Es bildet ein Fellknäuel, der vor statischer Energie knistert. Es speichert die Energie in Bäumen.
It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
oras: Es bildet ein Fellknäuel, der vor statischer Energie knistert. Es speichert die Energie in Bäumen.
It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
pla: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

dp: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
pt: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
hgss: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.
bw: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
b2w2: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
xy: Es schwimmt, indem es seine beiden Schweife wie eine Schiffsschraube rotieren lässt.
It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
oras: Es schwimmt, indem es seine beiden Schweife wie eine Schiffsschraube rotieren lässt.
It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
pla: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

dp: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
pt: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
hgss: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.
bw: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
b2w2: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
xy: Es treibt mithilfe einer Art Rettungsring auf dem Wasser und hilft dem, der zu ertrinken droht.
It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
oras: Es treibt mithilfe einer Art Rettungsring auf dem Wasser und hilft dem, der zu ertrinken droht.
It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
pla: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

dp: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
pt: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. STARLY try to peck it off.
hgss: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.
bw: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
b2w2: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
xy: Sonnenlicht färbt es rot. Verliert das kleine Bällchen Nährstoffe, welkt es und die Entwicklung beginnt.
Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
oras: Sonnenlicht färbt es rot. Verliert das kleine Bällchen Nährstoffe, welkt es und die Entwicklung beginnt.
Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
swsh: Sein nährstoffreiches Bällchen erfreut sich bei Vogel-Pokémon großer Beliebtheit. Es ist ständig auf der Flucht, damit es nicht gefressen wird.
It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.
pla: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

dp: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
pt: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
hgss: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
bw: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
b2w2: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
xy: Bei Sonnenschein entfaltet seine Knospe ihre Blütenblätter und es springt lebhaft umher.
During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
oras: Bei Sonnenschein entfaltet seine Knospe ihre Blütenblätter und es springt lebhaft umher.
During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
swsh: Als Knospe verhält es sich ruhig und bewegt sich kaum, während es geduldig auf Sonnenschein wartet.
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.
pla: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

dp: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
pt: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
hgss: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.
bw: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
b2w2: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
xy: Nicht seinen Körper zusammendrücken, sonst sickert eine seltsame lilafarbene Flüssigkeit aus!
Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
oras: Nicht seinen Körper zusammendrücken, sonst sickert eine seltsame lilafarbene Flüssigkeit aus!
Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
sm: Es lebt hauptsächlich in Küstengebieten. Seine Form und Farbe ändern sich je nach Lebensraum und Futter.
For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.
swsh: Sein Aussehen hängt von seiner Umgebung ab. Man geht davon aus, dass es diese Form in warmen Meeren annimmt.
This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.
pla: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

dp: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
pt: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
hgss: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
bw: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
b2w2: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
