xy: Wird es von einem natürlichen Feind angegriffen, flieht es, indem es ein lila Sekret über die Haut ausstößt.
When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
oras: Wird es von einem natürlichen Feind angegriffen, flieht es, indem es ein lila Sekret über die Haut ausstößt.
When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
sm: Es hat starke Regenerationskräfte. Selbst wenn Fisch-Pokémon ein Stück von ihm abbeißen, wächst es innerhalb weniger Stunden nach.
It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.
swsh: Auf der Suche nach Futter kommt es bisweilen auch an Land. Wo es entlangkriecht, hinterlässt es eine klebrige Schleimspur.
Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.
pla: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

dp: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
pt: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.
hgss: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.
bw: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
b2w2: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
xy: Sie leben in großen Kolonien und verbinden ihre Schweife in Freundschaft.
They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
oras: Sie leben in großen Kolonien und verbinden ihre Schweife in Freundschaft.
They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
sm: Sie streiten sich mit Gruppen von Quartermak um die bequemsten Bäume. Etwa die Hälfte dieser Revierkämpfe gewinnen sie.
In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.
pla: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

dp: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
pt: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
hgss: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.
bw: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
b2w2: These Pokémon are called the “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.
xy: Ein Pokémon, entstanden aus den Gefühlen von Menschen und Pokémon. Es mag feuchte Jahreszeiten.
A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
oras: Ein Pokémon, entstanden aus den Gefühlen von Menschen und Pokémon. Es mag feuchte Jahreszeiten.
A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
sm: Es heißt, dass es kleine Kinder an die Hand nehme und ins Jenseits zerre. Schwere Kinder sind ihm eine Last.
Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife. It dislikes heavy children.
swsh: Es nähert sich oft Kindern, womöglich auf der Suche nach Freunden. Wenn diese zu wild spielen, ergreift es aber die Flucht.
Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.
pla: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

dp: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
pt: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
hgss: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
bw: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
b2w2: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.
xy: Es trägt Menschen und Pokémon im Flug. Da es sich aber nur vom Wind tragen lässt, weiß man nie, wo es hingeht.
It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
oras: Es trägt Menschen und Pokémon im Flug. Da es sich aber nur vom Wind tragen lässt, weiß man nie, wo es hingeht.
It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
sm: Einst stieg ein Mann auf ein Drifzepeli und brach zu einer Reise auf. Er wurde nie wieder gesehen.
There was once an incident in which a man took a trip riding a Drifblim, only to go missing.
swsh: Man sagt, es bestehe aus den Seelen derer, die voller Groll verstorben sind. Es treibt lautlos im Zwielicht dahin.
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
pla: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

dp: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
pt: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
hgss: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.
bw: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
b2w2: By extending its rolled-up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.
xy: Seine Ohren sind immer aufgerollt. Mit ihnen kann es selbst große Felsbrocken zertrümmern.
Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
oras: Seine Ohren sind immer aufgerollt. Mit ihnen kann es selbst große Felsbrocken zertrümmern.
Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
sm: Seine Gliedmaßen sind schwach, doch wenn es seine aufgerollten Ohren mit geballter Kraft hervorschnellen lässt, pulverisiert es jeden Fels.
Its arms and legs are weak, but when it rolls its ears up tight and then unleashes them with its full force, it can smash boulders to dust.
swsh: Sind seine beiden Ohren aufgerollt, deutet das darauf hin, dass es ihm körperlich oder psychisch nicht gut geht und es Zuwendung braucht.
If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.
pla: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

dp: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
pt: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
hgss: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.
bw: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
b2w2: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
xy: Es ist extrem vorsichtig. Wenn es Gefahr wittert, macht es sich mit flinken Sprüngen aus dem Staub.
Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
oras: Es ist extrem vorsichtig. Wenn es Gefahr wittert, macht es sich mit flinken Sprüngen aus dem Staub.
Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
sm: Es wechselt zweimal im Jahr seine Wolle. Daraus lassen sich Schals oder Mützen herstellen, die ihre Träger mollig warmhalten.
Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.
swsh: Schlapor behält seine Umgebung stets im Auge. Wenn Gefahr im Verzug ist, setzt es sich mit vernichtenden Tritten zur Wehr.
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.
pla: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

dp: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
pt: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
hgss: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.
bw: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
b2w2: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
xy: Es spricht Beschwörungen. Viele lösen Schmerzen aus, manche aber bringen Glück.
It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
oras: Es spricht Beschwörungen. Viele lösen Schmerzen aus, manche aber bringen Glück.
It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
sm: Es erscheint aus dem Nichts, flüstert Beschwörungen, spricht Flüche aus und erzeugt furchteinflößende Trugbilder.
It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.
pla: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

dp: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
pt: If one utters a deep cry, many MURKROW gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
hgss: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.
bw: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
b2w2: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
xy: Sein tiefer Ruf lockt andere Kramurx herbei. Man nennt es daher „Beschwörer der Nacht“.
If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
oras: Sein tiefer Ruf lockt andere Kramurx herbei. Man nennt es daher „Beschwörer der Nacht“.
If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
sm: Dieses nachtaktive Pokémon kann mit einem einzigen Ruf über 100 seiner untergebenen Kramurx versammeln.
A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.
pla: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

dp: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
pt: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
hgss: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
bw: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
b2w2: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
xy: Es schlägt mit Krallen zu oder schnurrt, je nachdem, ob es gerade wütend oder zutraulich ist.
It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
oras: Es schlägt mit Krallen zu oder schnurrt, je nachdem, ob es gerade wütend oder zutraulich ist.
It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
pla: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

dp: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
pt: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
hgss: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
bw: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
b2w2: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
xy: Behagt ihm die Behausung eines anderen Pokémon, bleibt Shnurgarst einfach da und nistet sich dort ein.
It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
oras: Behagt ihm die Behausung eines anderen Pokémon, bleibt Shnurgarst einfach da und nistet sich dort ein.
It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
pla: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

dp: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
pt: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
hgss: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
bw: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
b2w2: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
xy: Jedes Mal, wenn es hüpft, entsteht ein klingender Laut. Seine hohen Schreie machen die Gegner taub.
Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
oras: Jedes Mal, wenn es hüpft, entsteht ein klingender Laut. Seine hohen Schreie machen die Gegner taub.
Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
pla: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

dp: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
pt: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
hgss: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.
bw: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
b2w2: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
xy: Versprüht eine Substanz aus seinem Hinterleib, die in einem großen Radius andere Pokémon fernhält.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
oras: Versprüht eine Substanz aus seinem Hinterleib, die in einem großen Radius andere Pokémon fernhält.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
swsh: Aus seinem Hinterleib sprüht es Gegnern eine fürchterlich stinkende Flüssigkeit ins Gesicht. Dabei hat es eine Reichweite von bis zu 5 m.
From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.
pla: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

dp: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
pt: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
hgss: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.
bw: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
b2w2: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
xy: Über seine Schweifspitze versprüht es eine übelriechende Substanz. Die Reichweite liegt bei über 50 m.
It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
oras: Über seine Schweifspitze versprüht es eine übelriechende Substanz. Die Reichweite liegt bei über 50 m.
It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
swsh: In seinem Magen speichert es eine stinkende Flüssigkeit, die es im Kampf aus seinem Schweif sprüht. Ihr Geruch hängt von seiner Nahrung ab.
In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.
pla: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

dp: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
pt: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
hgss: Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.
bw: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
b2w2: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.
xy: Früher glaubten die Menschen, dem Muster auf seinem Rücken wohne eine mysteriöse Kraft inne.
Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.
oras: Früher glaubten die Menschen, dem Muster auf seinem Rücken wohne eine mysteriöse Kraft inne.
Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.
swsh: Es erscheint in alten Ruinen. Sein Muster ist ein Rätsel, da es nicht aus einer in Galar beheimateten Kultur stammt.
It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn’t come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.
pla: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

dp: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
pt: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
hgss: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.
bw: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
b2w2: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
xy: Man verehrt sie schon seit Urzeiten als Regenmacher. Manchmal findet man eines von ihnen im Boden vergraben.
In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
oras: Man verehrt sie schon seit Urzeiten als Regenmacher. Manchmal findet man eines von ihnen im Boden vergraben.
In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
swsh: Man verehrt es als Regenmacher. Wird es wütend, droht es mit einer unheimlichen Stimme, die wie der Ton einer Glocke klingt.
Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.
pla: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

dp: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
pt: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
hgss: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.
bw: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
b2w2: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
xy: Es bevorzugt trockene Gebiete. Es gibt über die Augen Wasser ab, um den Wasserhaushalt zu regulieren.
It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
oras: Es bevorzugt trockene Gebiete. Es gibt über die Augen Wasser ab, um den Wasserhaushalt zu regulieren.
It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
sm: Es mag kein Wasser und lebt an trockenen Orten. Da es in seiner Umgebung nur wenig grüne Pflanzen gibt, sticht es deutlich heraus.
It does not deal well with water, so it lives in dry locales. Since its surroundings tend to lack greenery, it stands out noticeably.
swsh: Es sondert sowohl Schweiß als auch Tränen über seine Augen ab. Sein Schweiß schmeckt leicht salzig, seine Tränen ein bisschen bitter.
It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.
pla: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

dp: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
pt: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
hgss: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
bw: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
b2w2: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
xy: Es ahmt seinen Gegner nach. Während dieser noch verblüfft dreinsieht, macht es sich aus dem Staub.
In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
oras: Es ahmt seinen Gegner nach. Während dieser noch verblüfft dreinsieht, macht es sich aus dem Staub.
In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
sm: Ahmt die Bewegungen und Gesichtsausdrücke anderer so gut es kann nach. Leider lassen seine Fähigkeiten noch zu wünschen übrig.
It does its absolute best to mimic the movements and expressions of its opponents, but it’s still not very good at it.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon ahmt alles nach, was es sieht. Es übt, indem es fleißig die herrlichen Tanzschritte von Pantifrost imitiert.
It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.
pla: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

dp: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
pt: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
hgss: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
bw: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
b2w2: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
xy: In seinem Beutel trägt es einen runden, eiförmigen Stein, den es Freunden gibt.
It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
oras: In seinem Beutel trägt es einen runden, eiförmigen Stein, den es Freunden gibt.
It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
sm: In seinem Beutel trägt es einen runden, weißen Stein. Freundet man sich mit ihm an, kann es vorkommen, dass man ihn geschenkt bekommt.
It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.
swsh: Es imitiert Chaneira und legt einen eiförmigen Stein in den Beutel an seinem Bauch. Dieser Stein ist sein größter Schatz.
Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.
pla: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

dp: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
pt: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
hgss: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
bw: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
b2w2: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
xy: Es versucht Attacken zu entgehen, indem es den Ruf des Gegners nachahmt und einen Artgenossen mimt.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
oras: Es versucht Attacken zu entgehen, indem es den Ruf des Gegners nachahmt und einen Artgenossen mimt.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
pla: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

dp: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
pt: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
hgss: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.
bw: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
b2w2: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
xy: Ein Pokémon, das aus 108 Geistern besteht. Es ist an einen Spalt in einem mysteriösen Stein gebunden.
A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
oras: Ein Pokémon, das aus 108 Geistern besteht. Es ist an einen Spalt in einem mysteriösen Stein gebunden.
A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
swsh: Es besteht aus 108 Geistern. Allerdings scheinen sich auch einige bösartige daruntergemischt zu haben.
Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.
pla: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

dp: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
pt: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
hgss: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
bw: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
b2w2: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
xy: Es lebt in Höhlen, die Erdwärme ausgesetzt sind. Es springt heraus und beißt, wenn Feinde sich nähern.
It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
oras: Es lebt in Höhlen, die Erdwärme ausgesetzt sind. Es springt heraus und beißt, wenn Feinde sich nähern.
It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
sm: Es lebt in Höhlen, die Erdwärme ausgesetzt sind. Falls es trotzdem kalt wird, rückt es eng mit seinen Freunden zusammen.
It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will huddle close with others of its kind.
swsh: Es mag enge Löcher in Höhlenwänden, die der Erdwärme ausgesetzt sind. Selbst wenn draußen ein Schneesturm wütet, friert es dort nicht.
Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.
pla: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

dp: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
pt: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
hgss: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.
bw: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
b2w2: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
xy: Es liebt funkelnde Dinge und sucht nach Schätzen in Höhlen, die es dann in seinem Nest hortet.
It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
oras: Es liebt funkelnde Dinge und sucht nach Schätzen in Höhlen, die es dann in seinem Nest hortet.
It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
sm: Ab und zu häutet es sich und verliert Schuppen. Medizin, die solche Schuppen enthält, macht müde Körper munter.
In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.
swsh: Aus den Fortsätzen an beiden Seiten seines Kopfes stößt es Ultraschallwellen aus, um sich in stockfinsteren Höhlen zurechtzufinden.
This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.
pla: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

dp: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
pt: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
hgss: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.
bw: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
b2w2: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
xy: Spannt es seinen Körper und seine Flügel, sieht es aus wie ein Jet. Es fliegt mit Schallgeschwindigkeit.
When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
oras: Spannt es seinen Körper und seine Flügel, sieht es aus wie ein Jet. Es fliegt mit Schallgeschwindigkeit.
When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
sm: Es fliegt mit der Geschwindigkeit eines Jets. Wenn es sich auf einen Schwarm Vogel-Pokémon stürzt, schlingt es ihn im Ganzen hinunter.
It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.
swsh: Knackrack lebt in vulkanischen Gebirgen. Es fliegt so schnell wie ein Jet durch die Lüfte und macht dabei unentwegt Jagd auf Beute.
Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.
pla: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

dp: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
pt: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
hgss: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.
bw: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
b2w2: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
xy: Unter seinem langen Fell versteckt es Nahrung. Aber es vergisst, dass es sie dort versteckt hat.
It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
oras: Unter seinem langen Fell versteckt es Nahrung. Aber es vergisst, dass es sie dort versteckt hat.
It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
sm: Es braucht eine tägliche Nahrungsmenge, die seinem Körpergewicht entspricht. Der Geschmack ist ihm dabei egal.
It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it’s indifferent.
swsh: Es ist völlig darauf fixiert, so viel wie möglich zu fressen. Der Geschmack spielt dabei keine Rolle. Auch verdorbene Nahrung macht ihm nichts aus.
Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its only concern. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.
pla: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

dp: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
pt: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
hgss: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
bw: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
b2w2: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
xy: Es kommuniziert mit seinen Artgenossen über Wellen, die je nach Gefühlslage eine andere Form annehmen.
It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
oras: Es kommuniziert mit seinen Artgenossen über Wellen, die je nach Gefühlslage eine andere Form annehmen.
It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
sm: Es sieht sowohl die Gefühle von Menschen und Pokémon als auch die ihn umgebende Natur in Form von Wellen, die Aura genannt werden.
It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.
swsh: Es besitzt so viel Ausdauer, dass es die ganze Nacht rennen könnte. Wer mit ihm spazieren gehen will, kann nur schwer mit ihm Schritt halten.
It’s exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.
pla: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

dp: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
pt: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
hgss: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.
bw: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
b2w2: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
xy: Es nimmt die Aura seines Gegners wahr. So kann es dessen Gedanken und Bewegungen erkennen.
By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
oras: Es nimmt die Aura seines Gegners wahr. So kann es dessen Gedanken und Bewegungen erkennen.
By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
sm: Es kann Auren nicht nur wahrnehmen, sondern auch manipulieren. Diese Fähigkeit nutzt es beim Kämpfen.
Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.
swsh: Es jagt seine Beute, indem es eine Kraft manipuliert, die Aura genannt wird. Dadurch kann es sogar große Felsen pulverisieren.
It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
pla: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

dp: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
pt: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
hgss: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.
bw: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
b2w2: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.
xy: Es lebt in ausgetrockneten Gebieten. Statt zu schwitzen, sondert sein Körper Sand ab.
It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
oras: Es lebt in ausgetrockneten Gebieten. Statt zu schwitzen, sondert sein Körper Sand ab.
It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
swsh: Es bewegt sich mit geöffnetem Maul und verschluckt seine Beute mit jeder Menge Sand, den es durch seine Nasenlöcher wieder ausstößt.
It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.
pla: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

dp: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
pt: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
hgss: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
bw: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
b2w2: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
xy: Das weit aufgerissene Maul demonstriert seine Stärke. Es attackiert mit gebündeltem Sand.
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
oras: Das weit aufgerissene Maul demonstriert seine Stärke. Es attackiert mit gebündeltem Sand.
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
swsh: Manchmal bleiben in den Öffnungen in seinem Körper Steine stecken. Lithomith entfernen diese Steine, deswegen genießen sie seinen Schutz.
Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.
pla: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

dp: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
pt: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
hgss: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.
bw: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
b2w2: It lives in arid regions and can go without food for a year while waiting for prey.
xy: Es greift seine Beute mit den Krallen an seinem Schweif und vergiftet sie. Dann wartet es ab...
It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
oras: Es greift seine Beute mit den Krallen an seinem Schweif und vergiftet sie. Dann wartet es ab...
It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon vergräbt sich im Sand und lauert dort regungslos seiner Beute auf. Es ist artverwandt mit Thermopod.
After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.
pla: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

dp: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
pt: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
hgss: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.
bw: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
b2w2: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
xy: Es bringt seine Gegner mit starkem Gift zur Strecke, obwohl es weiß, dass es stark genug ist, um sie zu zerfetzen.
It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
oras: Es bringt seine Gegner mit starkem Gift zur Strecke, obwohl es weiß, dass es stark genug ist, um sie zu zerfetzen.
It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
swsh: Sein Gift ist stark, aber es setzt es nur selten ein. Ist es richtig wütend, schlägt es mit einer Wucht zu, die selbst Autos zu Schrott verarbeitet.
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.
pla: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

dp: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
pt: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
hgss: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.
bw: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
b2w2: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.
xy: In seinen Backen sammelt sich Gift. Es versucht, Beute zu überraschen und mit Giftfingern zu schnappen.
Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
oras: In seinen Backen sammelt sich Gift. Es versucht, Beute zu überraschen und mit Giftfingern zu schnappen.
Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
swsh: Es schüchtert Gegner mit Geräuschen ein, die es mit seinen Giftbeuteln erzeugt. Gelingt ihm dies, erledigt es sein Ziel mit einem Giftangriff.
It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.
pla: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

dp: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
pt: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
hgss: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.
bw: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
b2w2: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.
xy: Verfügt über einen Giftsack an seiner Kehle. Quakt es, schäumt das Gift und wird so noch stärker.
It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
oras: Verfügt über einen Giftsack an seiner Kehle. Quakt es, schäumt das Gift und wird so noch stärker.
It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
swsh: Es nähert sich springend seinem Gegner und bohrt seine giftigen Klauen in ihn hinein. Schon ein kleiner Kratzer lässt den Gegner K.O. gehen.
It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.
pla: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

dp: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
pt: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
hgss: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.
bw: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
b2w2: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.
xy: Sein süßlich riechender Speichel zieht Beute an, die es frisst. Es braucht einen Tag, sie zu fressen.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
oras: Sein süßlich riechender Speichel zieht Beute an, die es frisst. Es braucht einen Tag, sie zu fressen.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
pla: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

dp: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
pt: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
hgss: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.
bw: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
b2w2: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
xy: Die Linie an seiner Seite kann Sonnenlicht speichern. Nachts leuchtet es sehr intensiv.
The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
oras: Die Linie an seiner Seite kann Sonnenlicht speichern. Nachts leuchtet es sehr intensiv.
The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
sm: Der rosafarbene Teil seiner Haut speichert Sonnenlicht und leuchtet. Es wird angenommen, dass dies der Tarnung dient.
It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.
pla: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

dp: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
pt: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with LANTURN.
hgss: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.
bw: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
b2w2: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
xy: Es lebt tief auf dem Meeresboden. Das blinkende Muster auf seinen vier Rückenflossen zieht Beute an.
It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
oras: Es lebt tief auf dem Meeresboden. Das blinkende Muster auf seinen vier Rückenflossen zieht Beute an.
It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
sm: Mit seinem blinkenden Muster lockt es Beute an. Leider zieht es hierdurch auch seine Fressfeinde an.
With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.
pla: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

dp: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
pt: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.
hgss: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.
bw: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.
b2w2: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
xy: Ihre Rücken sind je nach Region unterschiedlich gemustert. Oft mischen sie sich unter Remoraid-Schwärme.
The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
oras: Ihre Rücken sind je nach Region unterschiedlich gemustert. Oft mischen sie sich unter Remoraid-Schwärme.
The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
sm: Ein sehr zahmes, zutrauliches Pokémon. Touren, bei denen man Mantirps begegnen kann, sind eine beliebte Freizeitaktivität an Küstenorten.
It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.
swsh: Vielleicht liegt es an der niedrigen Temperatur des Meeres, aber die Mantirps der Galar-Region bewegen sich etwas schwerfälliger als andere.
Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.
pla: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

dp: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
pt: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
hgss: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
bw: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
b2w2: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
xy: Im Winter steigt es bis zum Fuß der Berge herab. Im Frühjahr kehrt es auf den Gipfel zurück.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
oras: Im Winter steigt es bis zum Fuß der Berge herab. Im Frühjahr kehrt es auf den Gipfel zurück.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
swsh: Es lebt auf verschneiten Bergen und steckt seine Füße in den Schnee, um über sie Wasser und Kälte zu absorbieren.
It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.
pla: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

dp: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
pt: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
hgss: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
bw: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
b2w2: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
xy: Es bedeckt weite Gebiete mit Schnee, indem es Blizzards auslöst. Man nennt es „Das Eismonster“.
It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
oras: Es bedeckt weite Gebiete mit Schnee, indem es Blizzards auslöst. Man nennt es „Das Eismonster“.
It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
swsh: Es schwingt seine großen Arme wie Hämmer und vertreibt damit Gruppen von Flampion, die es auf Shnebedeck abgesehen haben.
If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.
pla: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

dp: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
pt: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
hgss: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
bw: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
b2w2: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.
xy: Es lebt in schneereichen Gebieten. Snibunna senden einander Signale, indem sie Zeichen in Rinde ritzen.
It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
oras: Es lebt in schneereichen Gebieten. Snibunna senden einander Signale, indem sie Zeichen in Rinde ritzen.
It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
sm: Sie sind immer zu viert oder fünft unterwegs. Bei der Jagd arbeiten sie zusammen, indem sie Zeichen in Felsen und Bäume ritzen.
They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.
swsh: Sie jagen ihre Beute in Gruppen. Im Team erledigen sie selbst große Ziele wie Mamutel mit Leichtigkeit.
They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.
pla: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

dp: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
pt: A group tried to use scientific means to make MAGNEZONE evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
hgss: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed MAGNETON’s molecular structure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.
bw: A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
b2w2: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
xy: Gelegentlich erzeugen sie so starke Magnetfelder, dass sie sich gegenseitig anziehen und einander immobilisieren.
Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
oras: Gelegentlich erzeugen sie so starke Magnetfelder, dass sie sich gegenseitig anziehen und einander immobilisieren.
Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
sm: Seine drei Bestandteile erzeugen ein Magnetfeld. Es kommt oft vor, dass am Himmel fliegende Magnezone für Ufos gehalten werden.
Three units generate magnetism. There have been many mistaken reports of UFO sightings when Magnezone flies through the night sky.
swsh: Man sagt, es werde von einem Wesen aus dem All kontrolliert und mit der Antenne auf seinem Kopf empfange es von ihm Signale.
Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it’s being controlled by some mysterious being.
pla: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

dp: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
pt: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
hgss: Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.
bw: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
b2w2: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.
xy: Es umklammert Dinge mit seiner dehnbaren Zunge. Kommt man ihm zu nahe, wird man eingespeichelt.
It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
oras: Es umklammert Dinge mit seiner dehnbaren Zunge. Kommt man ihm zu nahe, wird man eingespeichelt.
It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
sm: Es gibt Wettbewerbe dazu, welches Schlurplek seine Zunge am weitesten herausstrecken kann. Der Rekord liegt bei 25 m.
A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.
swsh: Seine sonderbare Zunge kann sich bis auf ein Vielfaches seiner Körpergröße ausdehnen. Niemand weiß, wie das möglich ist.
Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.
pla: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

dp: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
pt: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
hgss: From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
bw: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
b2w2: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
xy: Es feuert Kleinstein aus seinen Handflächen. Durch seinen Schützer erträgt es sogar Vulkanausbrüche.
From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
oras: Es feuert Kleinstein aus seinen Handflächen. Durch seinen Schützer erträgt es sogar Vulkanausbrüche.
From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
swsh: Es bestückt die Vertiefungen in seinen Händen mit Felsen oder Kiesling und feuert sie daraus ab. In jeder Hand hat es Platz für drei Geschosse.
It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.
pla: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

dp: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
pt: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
hgss: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.
bw: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
b2w2: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it’s fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.
xy: Es umwickelt Beute, indem es seine Arme, die aus Ranken bestehen, verlängert.
It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
oras: Es umwickelt Beute, indem es seine Arme, die aus Ranken bestehen, verlängert.
It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
swsh: Jüngsten Erkenntnissen zufolge bestehen seine zwei Arme, die es beliebig verlängern kann, aus gebündelten Ranken.
Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
pla: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

dp: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
pt: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
hgss: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
bw: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
b2w2: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.
xy: Bei voller Ladung zucken feurige, blassweiße Funken zwischen seinen zwei Hörnern hin und her.
As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
oras: Bei voller Ladung zucken feurige, blassweiße Funken zwischen seinen zwei Hörnern hin und her.
As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
sm: Es berührt Gegner mit seinen Schweifspitzen und entlädt dann starke Elektrizität. So kann es sie im Nullkommanichts verkohlen.
It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.
swsh: Wie viel Strom es erzeugt, ist abhängig von seinem Puls. Im Kampf steigt Elevolteks elektrische Spannung schlagartig an.
The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
pla: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

dp: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
pt: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
hgss: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.
bw: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
b2w2: When shooting 3,600 degree F fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
xy: Aus den Enden seiner Arme schießen Feuerbälle mit 2 000 °C. Es lebt in Vulkankratern.
It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
oras: Aus den Enden seiner Arme schießen Feuerbälle mit 2 000 °C. Es lebt in Vulkankratern.
It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
sm: Es lebt in Vulkankratern. Angeblich gibt es pro Vulkan immer nur ein Magbrant-Paar.
They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano.
swsh: Holt es tief Luft, werden die Flammen in seinem Bauch stärker und erreichen eine Temperatur von 2 000 ºC.
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
pla: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

dp: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
pt: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
hgss: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
bw: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
b2w2: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
xy: Es heißt, Togekiss erscheine in friedlichen Zeiten und verteile alle möglichen Wohltaten.
As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
oras: Es heißt, Togekiss erscheine in friedlichen Zeiten und verteile alle möglichen Wohltaten.
As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
swsh: Es zeigt sich nie an Orten, wo Streit und Zwietracht herrschen. In letzter Zeit wird es kaum noch gesehen.
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.
pla: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

dp: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
pt: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
hgss: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
bw: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
b2w2: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
xy: Seine bevorzugte Strategie besteht darin, seine Gegner aus dem Flug blitzartig zur Strecke zu bringen.
It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
oras: Seine bevorzugte Strategie besteht darin, seine Gegner aus dem Flug blitzartig zur Strecke zu bringen.
It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
pla: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

dp: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
pt: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
hgss: When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
bw: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
b2w2: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.
xy: An klaren Tagen erzeugt Folipurba saubere Luft, indem es Photosynthese betreibt.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
oras: An klaren Tagen erzeugt Folipurba saubere Luft, indem es Photosynthese betreibt.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
sm: Seine Zellstruktur ähnelt jener von Pflanzen. Durch Photosynthese kann es ohne Nahrungsaufnahme Energie gewinnen.
Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.
swsh: Die Bewohner Galars mögen den eigentümlichen Geruch, den seine Blätter verströmen. Als Parfüm ist er sehr beliebt.
Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popular perfume made using that scent.
pla: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

dp: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
pt: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
hgss: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.
bw: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
b2w2: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.
xy: Erzeugt ein Diamantstaubgestöber durch das Einfrieren der Luft um sich herum.
By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
oras: Erzeugt ein Diamantstaubgestöber durch das Einfrieren der Luft um sich herum.
By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
sm: Es kann seine Körpertemperatur frei regulieren. Indem es die Wasserbestandteile der Luft gefrieren lässt, wirbelt es Diamantstaub auf.
It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.
swsh: Glaziola erzeugt ein Diamantstaubgestöber, um Beute mit seiner Schönheit so zu verzaubern, dass es sie unbemerkt einfrieren kann.
Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it.
pla: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

dp: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
pt: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
hgss: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
bw: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
b2w2: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.
xy: Es hängt kopfüber von einem Ast und beobachtet seine Beute. Bei Gelegenheit stürzt es sich auf sie.
It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
oras: Es hängt kopfüber von einem Ast und beobachtet seine Beute. Bei Gelegenheit stürzt es sich auf sie.
It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
pla: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

dp: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
pt: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
hgss: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
bw: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
b2w2: When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared.
xy: Es existiert schon seit Urzeiten. Mamutel wurde sogar schon in 10 000 Jahre altem Eis gefunden.
A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
oras: Es existiert schon seit Urzeiten. Mamutel wurde sogar schon in 10 000 Jahre altem Eis gefunden.
A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
swsh: Sie sind schon auf 10 000 Jahre alten Wandmalereien abgebildet. Es gab Zeiten, in denen man sie für ausgestorben hielt.
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.
pla: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

dp: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
pt: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
hgss: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...
bw: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
b2w2: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
xy: Zusätzliche Software wurde installiert, um das Pokémon zu verbessern. Seitdem benimmt es sich seltsam.
Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
oras: Zusätzliche Software wurde installiert, um das Pokémon zu verbessern. Seitdem benimmt es sich seltsam.
Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
sm: Zusätzliche Software wurde installiert, um das Pokémon zu verbessern. Etwas ging jedoch schief und seitdem benimmt es sich seltsam.
In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.
swsh: Seit eine neue Software installiert wurde, die es zu interdimensionalen Reisen befähigen sollte, wurde sein Verhalten instabil.
Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.
pla: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

dp: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
pt: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
hgss: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
bw: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
b2w2: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
xy: Da es selbst die leisesten Gedanken seines Gegners lesen kann, kann es immer zuerst angreifen.
Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
oras: Da es selbst die leisesten Gedanken seines Gegners lesen kann, kann es immer zuerst angreifen.
Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon wird als Krieger angesehen. Die Klingen an seinen Ellbogen benutzt es nur, um etwas zu beschützen.
True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.
pla: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

dp: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
pt: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
hgss: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.
bw: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
b2w2: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
xy: Es gibt starken Magnetismus ab. Es steuert drei kleine Einheiten, die sich Mininasen nennen.
It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
oras: Es gibt starken Magnetismus ab. Es steuert drei kleine Einheiten, die sich Mininasen nennen.
It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
sm: Durch seinen starken Magnetismus macht es Elektrogeräte in seiner Nähe kaputt.
It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.
pla: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

dp: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
pt: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
hgss: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.
bw: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
b2w2: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
xy: Man sagt, dass es verlorene Seelen in seinem biegsamen Körper nach Hause geleite.
It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
oras: Man sagt, dass es verlorene Seelen in seinem biegsamen Körper nach Hause geleite.
It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
swsh: Niemand weiß, ob es einen eigenen Willen hat. Über Radiowellen empfängt es Befehle aus dem Jenseits, Menschen und Pokémon zu entführen.
At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
pla: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

dp: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
pt: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
hgss: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.
bw: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
b2w2: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
xy: Sein eisiger Atem mit -50 °C friert Gegner ein. Was aussieht wie sein Körper, ist tatsächlich hohl.
It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
oras: Sein eisiger Atem mit -50 °C friert Gegner ein. Was aussieht wie sein Körper, ist tatsächlich hohl.
It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
sm: Menschen und Pokémon, die ihm gefallen, friert es mit eisiger Luft ein. Dann nimmt es sie mit in seinen Bau und stellt sie dort aus.
When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.
swsh: Es ist aus dem Gram einer Frau entstanden, die auf schneebedeckten Bergen umgekommen ist. Am liebsten isst es gefrorene Seelen.
After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.
pla: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

dp: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
pt: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
hgss: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
bw: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
b2w2: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
xy: Dieses Pokémon wurde lange Zeit erforscht, um als Energiequelle für einen besonderen Motor zu dienen.
Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
oras: Dieses Pokémon wurde lange Zeit erforscht, um als Energiequelle für einen besonderen Motor zu dienen.
Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
swsh: Die Erfindung eines jungen Tüftlers hat zu der Herstellung verschiedener Geräte geführt, die das Potenzial von Rotom nutzen können.
One boy’s invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom’s unique capabilities.
pla: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
