dp: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
pt: When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
hgss: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.
bw: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
b2w2: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
xy: „Das wissende Wesen“. Es soll die Erinnerungen derer löschen, die ihm in die Augen sehen.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
oras: „Das wissende Wesen“. Es soll die Erinnerungen derer löschen, die ihm in die Augen sehen.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
pla: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

dp: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
pt: When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
hgss: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.
bw: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
b2w2: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
xy: „Das fühlende Wesen“. Es lehrt die Menschen die Ideale von Trauer, Schmerz und Freude.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
oras: „Das fühlende Wesen“. Es lehrt die Menschen die Ideale von Trauer, Schmerz und Freude.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
pla: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

dp: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
pt: When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
hgss: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.
bw: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
b2w2: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
xy: „Das starke Wesen“. Es schläft auf dem Grund eines Sees und hält so die Welt in Balance.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
oras: „Das starke Wesen“. Es schläft auf dem Grund eines Sees und hält so die Welt in Balance.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
pla: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

dp: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
pt: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.
hgss: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.
bw: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
b2w2: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
xy: Ein Pokémon, das in Legenden zu finden ist. Man sagt, als Dialga geboren wurde, begann der Lauf der Zeit.
A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
oras: Ein Pokémon, das in Legenden zu finden ist. Man sagt, als Dialga geboren wurde, begann der Lauf der Zeit.
A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
pla: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

dp: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
pt: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath.
hgss: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
bw: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
b2w2: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
xy: Man sagt, es lebe in einem Spalt in einer Paralleldimension. Es wird in der Mythologie erwähnt.
It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
oras: Man sagt, es lebe in einem Spalt in einer Paralleldimension. Es wird in der Mythologie erwähnt.
It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
pla: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

dp: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
pt: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
hgss: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
bw: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
b2w2: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
xy: Es lebt in vulkanischen Höhlen. Mit seinen kreuzförmigen Klauen kann es sogar an der Decke laufen.
It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
oras: Es lebt in vulkanischen Höhlen. Mit seinen kreuzförmigen Klauen kann es sogar an der Decke laufen.
It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
pla: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

dp: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
pt: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
hgss: It is believed to have shaped REGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL out of clay, ice, and magma.
bw: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
b2w2: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
xy: Man sagt, es habe Pokémon aus einem Eisberg, Felsen und Magma nach seinem Abbild geschaffen.
It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
oras: Man sagt, es habe Pokémon aus einem Eisberg, Felsen und Magma nach seinem Abbild geschaffen.
It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
swsh: Überall auf der Welt kursieren Legenden, denen zufolge Regigigas Pokémon nach seinem Abbild geschaffen habe.
All over the world, there are legends that tell of Regigigas creating other Pokémon in its own image.
pla: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

dp: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
pt: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
hgss: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
bw: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
b2w2: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
xy: Es lebt in einer Zerrwelt, die auf der Kehrseite der unseren liegt und die sich aller Logik entzieht.
This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
oras: Es lebt in einer Zerrwelt, die auf der Kehrseite der unseren liegt und die sich aller Logik entzieht.
This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
pla: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

dp: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
pt: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
hgss: Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
bw: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
b2w2: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
xy: Seine Flügel geben schimmernde Partikel ab, die wie ein Schleier herabrieseln. Man sagt, es verkörpere die Mondsichel.
Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
oras: Seine Flügel geben schimmernde Partikel ab, die wie ein Schleier herabrieseln. Man sagt, es verkörpere die Mondsichel.
Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
pla: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

dp: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
pt: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
hgss: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
bw: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
b2w2: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
xy: Steigt die Meerestemperatur, bläst es seinen Schwimmbeutel auf und treibt in Schwärmen auf dem Wasser.
When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
oras: Steigt die Meerestemperatur, bläst es seinen Schwimmbeutel auf und treibt in Schwärmen auf dem Wasser.
When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
pla: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

dp: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
pt: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
hgss: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
bw: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
b2w2: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
xy: Es wird mit einer wundersamen Kraft geboren, die eine Bindung zu jedem anderen Pokémon möglich macht.
It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
oras: Es wird mit einer wundersamen Kraft geboren, die eine Bindung zu jedem anderen Pokémon möglich macht.
It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
pla: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

dp: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
pt: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
hgss: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
bw: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
b2w2: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
xy: Es vertreibt Eindringlinge aus seinem Revier, indem es sie in Schlaf versetzt und mit Alpträumen quält.
It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
oras: Es vertreibt Eindringlinge aus seinem Revier, indem es sie in Schlaf versetzt und mit Alpträumen quält.
It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
pla: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

dp: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
pt: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
hgss: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
bw: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
b2w2: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
xy: Es kann die Luft von Giften reinigen und Ödland in ein üppig blühendes Blumenfeld verwandeln.
It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
oras: Es kann die Luft von Giften reinigen und Ödland in ein üppig blühendes Blumenfeld verwandeln.
It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
pla: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

dp: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
pt: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
hgss: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
bw: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
b2w2: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing then shaped the world.
xy: In den Legenden Sinnohs heißt es, es sei aus einem Ei geschlüpft und hätte die gesamte Welt geschaffen.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
oras: In den Legenden Sinnohs heißt es, es sei aus einem Ei geschlüpft und hätte die gesamte Welt geschaffen.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
pla: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

bw: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
b2w2: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.
xy: Ein siegverheißendes Pokémon. Man sagt, Trainer, die ein Victini in ihrem Team haben, seien unschlagbar.
This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
oras: Ein siegverheißendes Pokémon. Man sagt, Trainer, die ein Victini in ihrem Team haben, seien unschlagbar.
This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

bw: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
b2w2: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
xy: Im Sonnenlicht erhöht sich das Tempo seiner Bewegungen. Es ist mit seinen Schlingen geschickter als mit den Händen.
Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
oras: Im Sonnenlicht erhöht sich das Tempo seiner Bewegungen. Es ist mit seinen Schlingen geschickter als mit den Händen.
Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

bw: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
b2w2: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
xy: Huscht beinahe gleitend über den Boden und täuscht Gegner mit agilen Manövern, bis es mithilfe seiner Efeurute obsiegt.
It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
oras: Huscht beinahe gleitend über den Boden und täuscht Gegner mit agilen Manövern, bis es mithilfe seiner Efeurute obsiegt.
It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

bw: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
b2w2: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
xy: Im Kampf zeigt es nur Gegnern, die seinem edlen Blick standhalten, seine wahre Kraft.
It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
oras: Im Kampf zeigt es nur Gegnern, die seinem edlen Blick standhalten, seine wahre Kraft.
It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.

bw: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
b2w2: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
xy: Weicht flink gegnerischen Angriffen aus und schießt Flammen aus dem Rüssel, mit denen es gern auch mal Nüsse röstet.
It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
oras: Weicht flink gegnerischen Angriffen aus und schießt Flammen aus dem Rüssel, mit denen es gern auch mal Nüsse röstet.
It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

bw: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
b2w2: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
xy: Je mehr es frisst, desto stärker werden die Flammen in seinem Magen. Dies führt zu rapiden Energieschüben.
The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
oras: Je mehr es frisst, desto stärker werden die Flammen in seinem Magen. Dies führt zu rapiden Energieschüben.
The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

bw: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
b2w2: A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.
xy: Steckt mit dem Feuer um sein Kinn seine Fäuste in Brand und holt zu feurigen Fausthieben aus. Zeigt großen Teamgeist.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
oras: Steckt mit dem Feuer um sein Kinn seine Fäuste in Brand und holt zu feurigen Fausthieben aus. Zeigt großen Teamgeist.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

bw: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
b2w2: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
xy: Die Muschel an seinem Bauch dient ihm nicht nur als Waffe, sondern auch als Messer, mit dem es Beeren aufschneidet.
The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
oras: Die Muschel an seinem Bauch dient ihm nicht nur als Waffe, sondern auch als Messer, mit dem es Beeren aufschneidet.
The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
pla: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

bw: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
b2w2: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
xy: Es eignet sich durch strenges Training elegant ineinander übergehende Attacken mit seinen zwei Muscheln an.
Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
oras: Es eignet sich durch strenges Training elegant ineinander übergehende Attacken mit seinen zwei Muscheln an.
Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
pla: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

bw: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
b2w2: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
xy: Ehe man sichs versieht, hat es schon das Langschwert aus seinen Vorderbeinen gezogen und seinen Gegner besiegt.
In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
oras: Ehe man sichs versieht, hat es schon das Langschwert aus seinen Vorderbeinen gezogen und seinen Gegner besiegt.
In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
pla: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

bw: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
b2w2: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
xy: Hortet in seinen Backentaschen Futter, um tagelang Wache stehen zu können, und gibt Kameraden über seine Rute Signale.
Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
oras: Hortet in seinen Backentaschen Futter, um tagelang Wache stehen zu können, und gibt Kameraden über seine Rute Signale.
Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

bw: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
b2w2: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
xy: Es kann mit einer körpereigenen Substanz seine Augen und seinen Torso aufleuchten lassen, um Gegner zu erschrecken.
Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
oras: Es kann mit einer körpereigenen Substanz seine Augen und seinen Torso aufleuchten lassen, um Gegner zu erschrecken.
Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

bw: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
b2w2: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.
xy: Das lange Fell um sein Gesicht fungiert als Hightech-Radar, mit dem es fein säuberlich seine Umgebung abtastet.
The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
oras: Das lange Fell um sein Gesicht fungiert als Hightech-Radar, mit dem es fein säuberlich seine Umgebung abtastet.
The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
sm: Es jault nicht, weswegen es bei Trainern, die in Apartmenthäusern wohnen, sehr beliebt ist.
Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.
swsh: Es ist zwar tapfer, aber auch vorsichtig. Mit dem weichen Fell, das sein Gesicht bedeckt, nimmt Yorkleff Informationen über seine Umgebung auf.
This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

bw: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
b2w2: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
xy: Dieses äußerst treue Pokémon geht nicht nur seinem Trainer zur Hand, sondern hilft auch anderen Pokémon.
This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
oras: Dieses äußerst treue Pokémon geht nicht nur seinem Trainer zur Hand, sondern hilft auch anderen Pokémon.
This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
sm: Sein dunkles Fell ist sehr widerstandsfähig und wächst schnell. Dadurch sind die Kosten für das Trimmen sehr hoch.
Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.
swsh: Es ist sehr intelligent und zutraulich. Einer Theorie zufolge soll Terribark das erste Pokémon gewesen sein, das an der Seite von Menschen gelebt hat.
Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

bw: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
b2w2: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.
xy: Es rettet Menschen, die aufgrund eines Schneesturmes im Gebirge festsitzen. Sein langes Fell schützt es vor Kälte.
It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
oras: Es rettet Menschen, die aufgrund eines Schneesturmes im Gebirge festsitzen. Sein langes Fell schützt es vor Kälte.
It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
sm: Es ist ein kluges, sanftmütiges und tapferes Pokémon. Für Mitglieder von Rettungstruppen stellt es einen zuverlässigen Partner dar.
Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.
swsh: Bissbark scheint gerne unter Menschen zu leben. Wenn man ein wildes Exemplar fängt, dauert es nur etwa drei Tage, bis dieses zutraulich wird.
These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

bw: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
b2w2: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.
xy: Es lenkt die Menschen durch sein süßes Verhalten ab, um sie zu bestehlen. Ist es wütend, kratzt es gern mal.
Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
oras: Es lenkt die Menschen durch sein süßes Verhalten ab, um sie zu bestehlen. Ist es wütend, kratzt es gern mal.
Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
swsh: Es bestiehlt liebend gerne Leute, um sich an ihrer Frustration zu erfreuen. Mit Kleptifux verbindet es eine tiefe Rivalität.
It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

bw: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
b2w2: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
xy: Sein anmutiges Auftreten verdankt es den Muskeln, die es entwickelt hat. Es prescht lautlos durch die Nacht.
Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
oras: Sein anmutiges Auftreten verdankt es den Muskeln, die es entwickelt hat. Es prescht lautlos durch die Nacht.
Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
swsh: Man wird schnell von seinem schönen Fell und seiner Anmut verleitet, aber es ist ein sehr launisches und gewalttätiges Pokémon.
Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

bw: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
b2w2: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
xy: Schwächelnden Pokémon gibt es ein paar der Kräuter auf seinem Kopf ab und hilft ihnen so wieder auf die Beine.
It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
oras: Schwächelnden Pokémon gibt es ein paar der Kräuter auf seinem Kopf ab und hilft ihnen so wieder auf die Beine.
It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

bw: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
b2w2: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
xy: Wer sich mit diesem temperamentvollen Pokémon anlegt, bekommt seinen mit Dornen bestückten Schweif zu spüren.
It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
oras: Wer sich mit diesem temperamentvollen Pokémon anlegt, bekommt seinen mit Dornen bestückten Schweif zu spüren.
It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

bw: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
b2w2: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
xy: Ein kultiviertes Pokémon, das Beeren vor dem Verzehr stets anbrät. Es bietet den Menschen gerne seine Hilfe an.
Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
oras: Ein kultiviertes Pokémon, das Beeren vor dem Verzehr stets anbrät. Es bietet den Menschen gerne seine Hilfe an.
Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

bw: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
b2w2: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
xy: Es entfacht in seinem Körper ein Feuer und verkohlt Gegner mit Funken aus seinem Kopf und Schweif.
A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
oras: Es entfacht in seinem Körper ein Feuer und verkohlt Gegner mit Funken aus seinem Kopf und Schweif.
A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

bw: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
b2w2: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
xy: Das Büschel auf seinem Kopf enthält eine sehr nahrhafte Flüssigkeit, mit der es über seinen Schweif Pflanzen wässert.
The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
oras: Das Büschel auf seinem Kopf enthält eine sehr nahrhafte Flüssigkeit, mit der es über seinen Schweif Pflanzen wässert.
The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

bw: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
b2w2: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
xy: Es schießt mit so hohem Druck Wasser aus seinem Schweif, dass selbst Betonwände den Kürzeren ziehen.
The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
oras: Es schießt mit so hohem Druck Wasser aus seinem Schweif, dass selbst Betonwände den Kürzeren ziehen.
The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

bw: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
b2w2: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
xy: Es erscheint vor schlafenden Menschen und Pokémon und frisst ihre Alpträume.
This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
oras: Es erscheint vor schlafenden Menschen und Pokémon und frisst ihre Alpträume.
This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
swsh: Tief in der Nacht erscheint es am Kopfende von Betten. Während es einen Traum frisst, schimmert das Muster auf seinem Körper.
Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

bw: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
b2w2: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.
xy: Der Dunst, der aus seiner Stirn tritt, enthält die Träume unzähliger Menschen und Pokémon.
The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
oras: Der Dunst, der aus seiner Stirn tritt, enthält die Träume unzähliger Menschen und Pokémon.
The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
swsh: Wenn es schwärzlichen Dunst ausströmt, sollte man sich ihm nicht nähern, denn sonst werden Alpträume wahr.
When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

bw: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
b2w2: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
xy: Wartet oft vergeblich auf Anweisungen, obwohl es bereits einen Befehl erhalten hat. Ein sehr zerstreutes Pokémon.
This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
oras: Wartet oft vergeblich auf Anweisungen, obwohl es bereits einen Befehl erhalten hat. Ein sehr zerstreutes Pokémon.
This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
swsh: Es taucht dort auf, wo Menschen leben. Beim Füttern muss man vorsichtig sein, da sich sonst schnell hunderte von ihnen versammeln können.
Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

bw: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
b2w2: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
xy: Viele Leute glauben, dass es tief in seinem heimatlichen Wald ein Land der Harmonie gibt, wo man keine Kriege kennt.
Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
oras: Viele Leute glauben, dass es tief in seinem heimatlichen Wald ein Land der Harmonie gibt, wo man keine Kriege kennt.
Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
swsh: Navitaub kann einigermaßen schnell fliegen. Es findet immer zu seinem Trainer und seinem Nest zurück, egal, wie weit entfernt es von ihnen ist.
It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

bw: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
b2w2: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.
xy: Männchen schrecken Gegner ab, indem sie ihren Kopfschmuck schütteln. Weibchen verfügen über bessere Flugfertigkeiten.
Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
oras: Männchen schrecken Gegner ab, indem sie ihren Kopfschmuck schütteln. Weibchen verfügen über bessere Flugfertigkeiten.
Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
swsh: Sie verfügen über exzellente Flugfertigkeiten. Weibchen können länger fliegen, aber dafür erreichen Männchen ein höheres Flugtempo.
Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

bw: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
b2w2: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
xy: Es erscheint, wenn Gewitterwolken den Himmel verdunkeln. Es fängt mit seiner Mähne Blitze und hortet ihre Energie.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
oras: Es erscheint, wenn Gewitterwolken den Himmel verdunkeln. Es fängt mit seiner Mähne Blitze und hortet ihre Energie.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

bw: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
b2w2: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
xy: Ein stürmischer Geselle. Wenn es wütend ist, feuert es über seine Mähne in alle Richtungen Stromsalven ab.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
oras: Ein stürmischer Geselle. Wenn es wütend ist, feuert es über seine Mähne in alle Richtungen Stromsalven ab.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

bw: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
b2w2: The hexagonal-shaped hole is its ear. It has a tendency to walk in the direction the sound is coming from.
xy: Hat ein sechseckiges Ohr. Sein durch das Erdreich gepresster Körper steht Stahl in Sachen Härte in nichts nach.
Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
oras: Hat ein sechseckiges Ohr. Sein durch das Erdreich gepresster Körper steht Stahl in Sachen Härte in nichts nach.
Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
sm: Es wurde tief unter der Erde geboren. Mit befreundeten Kleinstein und Rocara stellt es Vergleiche an, wessen Körper am härtesten sei.
Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.
swsh: Sein Körper ist hart wie Stahl, aber nach einem längeren Aufenthalt im Wasser weicht er wohl ein wenig auf.
It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.

bw: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
b2w2: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
xy: Energie, die ungehindert aus seinem Körper austrat, hat sich an ihm zu orangefarbenen Kristallen verfestigt.
Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
oras: Energie, die ungehindert aus seinem Körper austrat, hat sich an ihm zu orangefarbenen Kristallen verfestigt.
Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
sm: Bei seinen orangefarbenen Kristallen handelt es sich um verfestigte Energie. Bereits ein Splitter könnte 100 Kipplastern als Treibstoff reichen.
Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
swsh: Wenn die orangen Kristalle anfangen zu leuchten, ist Vorsicht vor spontanen Energieentladungen geboten.
If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.

bw: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
b2w2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
xy: Es verarbeitet Sonnenstrahlen in seinem Energiekern zu Lichtkugeln weiter, um sie im Kampf auf seinen Gegner abzufeuern.
The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
oras: Es verarbeitet Sonnenstrahlen in seinem Energiekern zu Lichtkugeln weiter, um sie im Kampf auf seinen Gegner abzufeuern.
The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
sm: Es verarbeitet Sonnenstrahlen zu Energiekugeln von ungeheurer Stärke. Nachts sowie bei Regen kann es diese jedoch nicht abfeuern.
The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.
swsh: Aufgrund seiner Stärke arbeitet es zusammen mit Menschen und Patinaraja öfter mal als Aushilfe auf Baustellen oder in Bergwerken.
This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

bw: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
b2w2: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
xy: Wohnt in dunklen Wäldern und Höhlen. Es sendet Ultraschallwellen mit seiner Nase aus, um die Gegend abzutasten.
Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
oras: Wohnt in dunklen Wäldern und Höhlen. Es sendet Ultraschallwellen mit seiner Nase aus, um die Gegend abzutasten.
Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
swsh: Herzförmige Flecken an der Decke einer Höhle sind ein sicheres Zeichen dafür, dass sie von Fleknoil behaust wird.
While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

bw: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
b2w2: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
xy: Beim Abfeuern seiner Ultraschallwellen, mit denen es selbst Beton zertrümmern kann, wedelt es eifrig mit dem Schweif.
It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
oras: Beim Abfeuern seiner Ultraschallwellen, mit denen es selbst Beton zertrümmern kann, wedelt es eifrig mit dem Schweif.
It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
swsh: Hat es besonders starke Ultraschallwellen ausgestoßen, wird es so müde, dass es für eine Weile nicht fliegen kann.
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

bw: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
b2w2: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
xy: Es führt seine beiden Klauen zusammen, dreht sich rapide um die eigene Achse und gräbt sich ratzfatz durch das Erdreich.
It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
oras: Es führt seine beiden Klauen zusammen, dreht sich rapide um die eigene Achse und gräbt sich ratzfatz durch das Erdreich.
It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
swsh: Es führt seine beiden Klauen zusammen, dreht sich rapide um die eigene Achse und stürzt sich auf seine Beute.
It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

bw: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
b2w2: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.
xy: Seine zu Stahl weiterentwickelten Bohrer kriegen selbst Eisenplatten klein. Im Tunnelbau ist es ein absolutes Ass.
It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
oras: Seine zu Stahl weiterentwickelten Bohrer kriegen selbst Eisenplatten klein. Im Tunnelbau ist es ein absolutes Ass.
It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
swsh: Viele Tunnel, die aussehen, als wären sie natürlich entstanden, gehen wohl eigentlich auf Stalobor zurück, die sich durch die Erde gegraben haben.
It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

bw: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
b2w2: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
xy: Über die Fühler an seinen Ohren kann es ertasten, wie es einer Person geht oder wann ein Pokémon aus seinem Ei schlüpft.
Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
oras: Über die Fühler an seinen Ohren kann es ertasten, wie es einer Person geht oder wann ein Pokémon aus seinem Ei schlüpft.
Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon verfügt über ein außerordentlich gutes Gehör. Es kann sogar das Kullern eines Kiesels aus 2 km Entfernung vernehmen.
Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino’s ears.

bw: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
b2w2: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
xy: Trägt stets einen Holzbalken bei sich. Es taucht hier und da auf Baustellen auf und hilft dort den Arbeitern aus.
These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
oras: Trägt stets einen Holzbalken bei sich. Es taucht hier und da auf Baustellen auf und hilft dort den Arbeitern aus.
These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
swsh: Es hilft gern auf Baustellen aus. Bleiben diese bei Regen geschlossen, macht es seinem Ärger Luft, indem es seinen Holzbalken schwingt.
It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

bw: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
b2w2: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
xy: Diese durchtrainierten Muskelprotze sind im Umgang mit Stahlträgern versiert und können damit ganze Häuser abreißen.
With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
oras: Diese durchtrainierten Muskelprotze sind im Umgang mit Stahlträgern versiert und können damit ganze Häuser abreißen.
With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
swsh: Strepoli und Maschock treffen sich regelmäßig zum Muskelvergleich. Wer schlecht abschneidet, lässt sich danach eine Weile nicht mehr blicken.
It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

bw: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
b2w2: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
xy: Man nimmt an, dass es der Menschheit vor ca. 2 000 Jahren das Betonmischen beigebracht hat.
It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
oras: Man nimmt an, dass es der Menschheit vor ca. 2 000 Jahren das Betonmischen beigebracht hat.
It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
swsh: Beton, der von Meistagrif angerührt wurde, ist härter und robuster als jeder andere Beton, selbst wenn die Inhaltsstoffe identisch sind.
Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

bw: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
b2w2: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
xy: Erzeugt mit seinen Wangen für Menschen unhörbare Schallwellen, um Artgenossen vor Gefahr zu warnen.
By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
oras: Erzeugt mit seinen Wangen für Menschen unhörbare Schallwellen, um Artgenossen vor Gefahr zu warnen.
By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
swsh: Man sagt, wenn auf Wasseroberflächen schöne Kräuselwellen zu sehen sind, liege das an Schallquap, die unter Wasser schrill rufen.
Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

bw: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
b2w2: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
xy: Wenn es die Beulen auf seinem Kopf zum Schwingen bringt, tobt je nach Umgebung entweder das Wasser oder die Erde bebt.
When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
oras: Wenn es die Beulen auf seinem Kopf zum Schwingen bringt, tobt je nach Umgebung entweder das Wasser oder die Erde bebt.
When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
swsh: Es schwächt seine Beute mit Kopfschmerzen erregenden Schallwellen und umschlingt sie anschließend mit seiner klebrigen Zunge.
It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

bw: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
b2w2: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
xy: Wenn es die Beulen an seinen Fäusten zum Schwingen bringt, kann es doppelt so fest zuschlagen und Felsen zertrümmern.
It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
oras: Wenn es die Beulen an seinen Fäusten zum Schwingen bringt, kann es doppelt so fest zuschlagen und Felsen zertrümmern.
It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
swsh: Die Beulen, die seinen ganzen Körper bedecken, können Erschütterungen auf Erdbebenstärke erzeugen. Es ist artverwandt mit Glibunkel.
The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

bw: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
b2w2: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
xy: Zurrt es seinen Gürtel fest, gewinnt es an Kraft. Wilde Exemplare flechten sich ihren Gürtel in Handarbeit aus Ranken.
When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
oras: Zurrt es seinen Gürtel fest, gewinnt es an Kraft. Wilde Exemplare flechten sich ihren Gürtel in Handarbeit aus Ranken.
When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
swsh: Es verfügt über ein exzellentes Repertoire an Wurftechniken. Sein Gürtel färbt sich dunkler, je mehr Schweiß er bei Kämpfen in sich aufsaugt.
It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.

bw: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
b2w2: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
xy: Es lebt zurückgezogen in den Bergen und trainiert Tag und Nacht, um seinen Karateschlag zu perfektionieren.
Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
oras: Es lebt zurückgezogen in den Bergen und trainiert Tag und Nacht, um seinen Karateschlag zu perfektionieren.
Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
swsh: Es strebt unentwegt nach Stärke. Wer in den Bergen ein Karadonis beim Training erblickt, sollte sich ganz leise aus dem Staub machen.
If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.

bw: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
b2w2: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
xy: Schneidert sich ein Kleid, indem es sich Blätter zurechtbeißt und sie mit Klebefäden aus seinem Mund zusammennäht.
This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
oras: Schneidert sich ein Kleid, indem es sich Blätter zurechtbeißt und sie mit Klebefäden aus seinem Mund zusammennäht.
This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

bw: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
b2w2: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
xy: Es wandelt herabgefallenes Laub in Nährstoffe um. In Wäldern, wo es Folikon gibt, fühlen sich Pflanzen pudelwohl.
Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
oras: Es wandelt herabgefallenes Laub in Nährstoffe um. In Wäldern, wo es Folikon gibt, fühlen sich Pflanzen pudelwohl.
Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

bw: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
b2w2: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
xy: Begegnet es einem jungen Pokémon, näht es ihm mit den klebrigen Fäden aus seinem Mund ein Kleid aus Blättern.
Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
oras: Begegnet es einem jungen Pokémon, näht es ihm mit den klebrigen Fäden aus seinem Mund ein Kleid aus Blättern.
Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

bw: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
b2w2: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey’s location and state.
xy: Mit seinen Ruten und den Fühlern an seinem Kopf tastet es die Umgebung ab. Ein überaus aggressiver Geselle.
It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
oras: Mit seinen Ruten und den Fühlern an seinem Kopf tastet es die Umgebung ab. Ein überaus aggressiver Geselle.
It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
swsh: Es ist zwar artverwandt mit Thermopod, aber jedes Mal, wenn sich die beiden über den Weg krabbeln, streiten sie erbittert miteinander.
Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

bw: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
b2w2: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.
xy: Von einem harten Schutzpanzer umgeben. Es greift seine Gegner an, indem es mit Karacho wie ein Rad in sie hineinrollt.
Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
oras: Von einem harten Schutzpanzer umgeben. Es greift seine Gegner an, indem es mit Karacho wie ein Rad in sie hineinrollt.
Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
swsh: Rollum dreht sich mit hoher Geschwindigkeit und rammt seine Gegner. Dabei erreicht es Geschwindigkeiten von bis zu 100 km/h.
This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

bw: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
b2w2: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
xy: Lähmt seine Beute, indem es sie mit den Zacken an seinem Hals aufspießt. Mit einer Ladung Gift gibt es ihr den Rest.
It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
oras: Lähmt seine Beute, indem es sie mit den Zacken an seinem Hals aufspießt. Mit einer Ladung Gift gibt es ihr den Rest.
It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
swsh: Kriegt es seine Beute mit den Krallen an seinem Hals zu fassen, wirft es sie zu Boden und rammt die giftigen Spitzen der Krallen in sie hinein.
Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.

bw: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
b2w2: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.
xy: Wird es angegriffen, verstreut es zur Täuschung Watte. Es flieht, während der Gegner nach dem wahren Waumboll sucht.
When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
oras: Wird es angegriffen, verstreut es zur Täuschung Watte. Es flieht, während der Gegner nach dem wahren Waumboll sucht.
When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
sm: Begegnen sie Freunden, hängen sie eng aufeinander. Wenn sich zu viele versammeln, sehen sie aus wie eine Gewitterwolke.
When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.
swsh: Sie schützen sich, indem sie Watte verstreuen. Manche werden vom Wind bis ans andere Ende der Welt getragen.
It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

bw: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
b2w2: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
xy: Sie erscheinen mit Orkanböen und spielen den Leuten Streiche, indem sie in Häusern Möbel verrücken oder Watte verstreuen.
They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
oras: Sie erscheinen mit Orkanböen und spielen den Leuten Streiche, indem sie in Häusern Möbel verrücken oder Watte verstreuen.
They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
sm: Über Luftzüge dringt es in Häuser ein, verstreut in allen Zimmern Watte und macht sich dann lächelnd davon.
It rides on the wind and slips into people’s homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.
swsh: Es verstreut Watte, um Leute zu ärgern. Es hört damit auf, wenn es nass wird, weil es dann zu schwer ist und sich nicht mehr bewegen kann.
It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

bw: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
b2w2: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
xy: Die Blätter auf seinem Kopf schmecken furchtbar bitter, doch sie helfen ausgezeichnet gegen Erschöpfung.
The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
oras: Die Blätter auf seinem Kopf schmecken furchtbar bitter, doch sie helfen ausgezeichnet gegen Erschöpfung.
The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
sm: Die Blätter auf seinem Kopf sind furchtbar bitter, helfen aber bei Erschöpfung. Als Tee zubereitet, sind sie noch wirksamer.
Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
swsh: Lilminip hält sich unweit von sauberem Wasser auf. Ein Aufguss der Blätter auf seinem Kopf wird auch als Mittel gegen Käfer-Pokémon eingesetzt.
Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.
pla: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

bw: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
b2w2: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
xy: Der Duft des Blumenschmucks auf seinem Kopf wirkt beruhigend. Damit der Schmuck nicht verwelkt, muss man es gut pflegen.
The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
oras: Der Duft des Blumenschmucks auf seinem Kopf wirkt beruhigend. Damit der Schmuck nicht verwelkt, muss man es gut pflegen.
The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
sm: Egal, wie viel Mühe und Geld investiert wird, sein Blumenschmuck ist wild gewachsen immer schöner als von Menschenhand gezüchtet.
No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
swsh: Man sagt, dass selbst erstklassige Gärtner Schwierigkeiten damit haben, die Blume auf Dressellas Kopf zum Blühen zu bringen.
It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.
pla: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

bw: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
b2w2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
xy: Sie gelten als Delikatesse. Aufgrund ihrer brutalen Natur liegen rot und blau gestreifte Exemplare immer im Clinch.
Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
oras: Sie gelten als Delikatesse. Aufgrund ihrer brutalen Natur liegen rot und blau gestreifte Exemplare immer im Clinch.
Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
sm: Ein wildes und brutales Pokémon. Rot gestreifte und blau gestreifte Barschuft tragen ständig Kämpfe um ihr Territorium aus.
Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
swsh: Sie sind bei Anglern beliebt, weil sie ihnen harte Kämpfe liefern. Sie werden oft illegal in Teichen ausgesetzt, wodurch sie sich schneller verbreiten.
Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.
pla: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

bw: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
b2w2: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.
xy: Wenn es sich durch den Sand gräbt, ragen nur noch Nase und Augen hervor. Die schwarze Haut dient als Augenschutz.
It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
oras: Wenn es sich durch den Sand gräbt, ragen nur noch Nase und Augen hervor. Die schwarze Haut dient als Augenschutz.
It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
sm: Es bewegt sich verborgen im Sand mithilfe von Schwimmbewegungen fort. So versteckt es sich vor Gegnern und bleibt immer schön warm.
It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.
swsh: Da die Wüste nachts abkühlt, vergräbt es sich tief im Sand und schläft dort, bis die Sonne wieder aufgeht.
The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

bw: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
b2w2: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.
xy: Bildet mit mehreren Artgenossen ein Rudel. Eine Membran schützt seine Augen vor Sandstürmen.
They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
oras: Bildet mit mehreren Artgenossen ein Rudel. Eine Membran schützt seine Augen vor Sandstürmen.
They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
sm: Es bildet mit mehreren Artgenossen ein Rudel. Meistens führen Weibchen die Gruppe an und Männchen müssen Nahrung beschaffen.
They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
swsh: Da es dank seiner besonderen Augen selbst im Dunkeln gut sieht, kann es auch nachts auf die Jagd gehen, ohne sich zu verirren.
Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

bw: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
b2w2: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
xy: Ein äußerst grausames Pokémon. Es greift jeden, der ihm unter die Augen kommt, mit seinen scharfen Reißzähnen an.
Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
oras: Ein äußerst grausames Pokémon. Es greift jeden, der ihm unter die Augen kommt, mit seinen scharfen Reißzähnen an.
Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
sm: Seine Augen sind so außergewöhnlich, dass es sogar in einem Sandsturm kleinste Beute aus 50 km Entfernung entdecken kann.
Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
swsh: Es wird auch als „Tyrann der Wüste“ bezeichnet. Mit seinem mächtigen Kiefer durchbeißt es selbst dicke Eisenplatten mit Leichtigkeit.
This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

bw: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
b2w2: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100° F.
xy: Früher nutzte man die heißen Ausscheidungen von Flampion, um sich den Körper zu wärmen.
Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
oras: Früher nutzte man die heißen Ausscheidungen von Flampion, um sich den Körper zu wärmen.
Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
swsh: Das Feuer in seinem Inneren ist die Quelle seiner Kraft. Wird die Flamme zu klein, schläft es auf der Stelle ein.
It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

bw: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
b2w2: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
xy: Nimmt es in einem heißen Kampf Schaden, wird es hart wie Stein und fällt in eine Trance, um seinen Verstand zu schärfen.
When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
oras: Nimmt es in einem heißen Kampf Schaden, wird es hart wie Stein und fällt in eine Trance, um seinen Verstand zu schärfen.
When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon ist ausgesprochen energisch. Ein einziger Hieb mit seinen gewaltigen Armen macht selbst Lastwagen dem Erdboden gleich.
The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

bw: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
b2w2: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.
xy: Verjagt Vogel-Pokémon, die auf seine Blüten aus sind, mit einem flotten Tänzchen und lauter Untermalung.
It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
oras: Verjagt Vogel-Pokémon, die auf seine Blüten aus sind, mit einem flotten Tänzchen und lauter Untermalung.
It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
swsh: Es erzeugt Laute, die dem Klang von Maracas ähneln, und weiß sich Vogel-Pokémon mit flotten Rhythmen vom Leib zu halten.
With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

bw: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
b2w2: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
xy: Höhlt sich einen brauchbaren Stein aus, um darin zu wohnen. Geht er zu Bruch, ruht es nicht, bis es einen neuen findet.
It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
oras: Höhlt sich einen brauchbaren Stein aus, um darin zu wohnen. Geht er zu Bruch, ruht es nicht, bis es einen neuen findet.
It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
swsh: Lithomith sucht sich einen Stein, der ihm gefällt, und höhlt ihn aus, um darin zu wohnen. Es ist ein natürlicher Feind von Kiesling und Klonkett.
When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

bw: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
b2w2: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
xy: Es ist hart genug im Nehmen, um mitsamt seines schweren Felsens mehrere Tage durch trockene Gebiete zu wandern.
It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
oras: Es ist hart genug im Nehmen, um mitsamt seines schweren Felsens mehrere Tage durch trockene Gebiete zu wandern.
It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
swsh: Dieses Pokémon mag trockene Gebiete und verkriecht sich bei Regen unter seinem Felsen. Es zeigt stark ausgeprägtes Territorialverhalten.
This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.

bw: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
b2w2: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
xy: Es zieht seine gummiartige Haut bis zum Hals hinauf und nimmt eine Abwehrhaltung ein, um sich vor Schaden zu schützen.
Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
oras: Es zieht seine gummiartige Haut bis zum Hals hinauf und nimmt eine Abwehrhaltung ein, um sich vor Schaden zu schützen.
Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
sm: Zurrokex trotten in Gruppen von einigen Exemplaren durch die Gegend. Wer mit ihnen Augenkontakt herstellt, erhält Kopfnüsse.
They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
swsh: Zurrokex deuten Blickkontakt als Einladung, ihr Gegenüber mit Kopfnüssen anzugreifen. Vorsicht ist also geboten.
If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

bw: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
b2w2: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
xy: Es wehrt Angriffe mit seiner alten Haut ab und kontert mit Tritten. Sein Ego entspricht der Größe seines Kamms.
It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
oras: Es wehrt Angriffe mit seiner alten Haut ab und kontert mit Tritten. Sein Ego entspricht der Größe seines Kamms.
It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
sm: Diesem ungestümen Pokémon liegen Freunde, Familie und Revier sehr am Herzen.
This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
swsh: Selbst seine halbherzigen Tritte sind stark genug, um die Betonpfeiler eines Meistagrif zu zertrümmern.
As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.

bw: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
b2w2: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
xy: Einst war es der Wächter einer Stadt aus uralten Zeiten. Wer sich in sein Revier wagt, lernt seine Psycho-Kräfte kennen.
The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
oras: Einst war es der Wächter einer Stadt aus uralten Zeiten. Wer sich in sein Revier wagt, lernt seine Psycho-Kräfte kennen.
The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
swsh: Es fliegt mithilfe seiner Psycho-Kräfte. Einige sagen, es war einst der Wächter einer Stadt aus uralten Zeiten. Andere sagen, es war sein Bote.
Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.

bw: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
b2w2: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
xy: Es entsteht aus den Seelen von längst begrabenen Menschen und kann sich immer noch an deren Vergangenheit erinnern.
These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
oras: Es entsteht aus den Seelen von längst begrabenen Menschen und kann sich immer noch an deren Vergangenheit erinnern.
These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
swsh: Makabaja irren Nacht für Nacht durch Ruinen. Die Masken, die sie umhertragen, sind angeblich ihre ehemaligen Menschengesichter.
It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

bw: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
b2w2: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
xy: Angeblich verschlingt es jeden, der sich ihm auch nur nähert. Besonders gern frisst es Klumpen aus reinem Gold.
It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
oras: Angeblich verschlingt es jeden, der sich ihm auch nur nähert. Besonders gern frisst es Klumpen aus reinem Gold.
It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
swsh: Echnatoll haben einen Körper aus glitzerndem Gold. Man geht davon aus, dass sie sich nicht mehr an ihr Leben als Menschen erinnern können.
This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

bw: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
b2w2: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.
xy: Schwamm bereits vor 100 Millionen Jahren durch die Meere. Ab und zu führt es die Jagd auch an Land.
About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
oras: Schwamm bereits vor 100 Millionen Jahren durch die Meere. Ab und zu führt es die Jagd auch an Land.
About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
sm: Eine Untersuchung seiner Skelettstruktur hat ergeben, dass es in Tiefen von bis zu 1 000 m abtauchen kann.
Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.
swsh: Dieser Meeresbewohner der Urzeit kann sich außerhalb der See nur kriechend fortbewegen, aber für seine Beute kommt es trotzdem an Land.
